a purpose-coherent specification pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a document, three mockups, a spreadsheet of cases and an exported ticket list. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

the boundary that defines this row: whether the document commits work to an order for an audience (this row) or specifies what one feature must do (business_operations.product-requirements). One deck routinely opens with a roadmap slide and continues into specification detail, and NEITHER ROW SHOULD RESOLVE THE MIXED DECK FROM STRUCTURE - it is needs_llm on both sides, in matching terms. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

which audience a roadmap was cut for - internal, board, customer, partner - which is the difference between an ordinary file and a commercially sensitive one, and which is usually only stated on one slide.

separating a product roadmap from a project schedule, a delivery plan, a budget phasing and a strategy paper, all of which put work or money against periods. The discriminator is not altitude and must never be argued as altitude: a company-wide themes-by-quarter deck is still this row's, and business_operations.strategy-plan states the same conclusion from its side.

recognising a SUPERSEDED roadmap - last quarter's version is structurally identical to this quarter's and no longer states anything true. Recorded as a HANDLING HAZARD, not as evidence: supersession is detected through the universal version-family machinery plus content, so it cannot be a ground for this row's node test (see never_alone) and it appears here only so that a model never reports an expired plan as current.

whether an apparent roadmap is the holder's own plan or ANOTHER organisation's published roadmap saved for reference. The discriminator is CUSTODY, not shape - a publication apparatus and no internal approval or audience marking - adopted from business_operations.strategy-plan's rival-strategy fixture and applied here in the same terms.

a purpose-coherent planning-cycle pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a deck, a scoring spreadsheet, a scope list, a board capture and a set of replanning notes. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating a project plan from a strategy or annual plan, a research project plan, a construction programme, or a study protocol - all four state objectives, phases, milestones and owners in the same voice. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
deciding whether a bounded effort is a work project at all, or one person's own initiative, a course assignment, or a home renovation kept in the same spreadsheet idiom.
an unlabeled plan written as free prose in a note, or a whiteboard photograph of a milestone wall.

a purpose-coherent delivery pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a charter, a schedule export, four status decks, a blank issue form and a signed acceptance page. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
whether a status report belongs to this project's own record or to the portfolio row that consumes it, when both carry the same project name.
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating an organisational retrospective from a clinical morbidity-and-mortality review, a workplace accident investigation, a regulatory audit finding, an academic reflective essay, or a personal journal entry - each is a past-tense causal account with actions. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

deciding whether a document names a person as an ACTOR in a timeline or as a SUBJECT of criticism - the distinction that separates this row from an employee-relations file and that governs how carefully the file must be handled.
an unstructured retro: free prose, a chat transcript, or a photograph of sticky notes in three columns.
whether a section inside a closure report is the retrospective, when the surrounding document is a project artifact.

a purpose-coherent review pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a timeline export, a metrics chart, a chat log, a draft write-up and an actions sheet. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating an organisational risk register from a project RAID log, a workplace risk assessment, an information-security risk treatment plan, a clinical risk register, a financial risk exposure schedule or a supplier risk questionnaire - all seven use likelihood, impact and owner columns. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
deciding whether a continuity plan belongs to the organisation as a whole, to one site, or to one system, when the document names all three.
an unlabeled spreadsheet whose columns are numbered rather than named, or a risk discussion written as free prose in a board paper.

a purpose-coherent risk pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a register export, a heat map image, a continuity plan, a test report and a blank assessment form. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating an organisational strategy from a product strategy, a marketing plan, a research programme proposal, a grant application's case for support, a nonprofit's strategic plan or an individual's own career plan - all state objectives, a horizon and a rationale. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
deciding whether a document is a strategy or the MINUTES of a strategy discussion, when the file is a set of notes from an offsite.
an unlabeled deck of slides that argues a direction without ever using a planning word, and a scanned flip-chart from a strategy day.
whether a business case authorises a project (this row) or reports on one already running (delivery), when both cite the same effort and the same numbers.

a purpose-coherent planning pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a draft narrative, a financial model, a market slide, a benefits sheet and a blank approval form. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating a support case export from a CRM opportunity export, a bug tracker export, an employee-relations case list, a clinical or legal caseload, or a complaints register - all are identifier-plus-person-plus-status tables and only their vocabulary differs. Getting this wrong is how a caseload of patients or clients would be read as a helpdesk queue. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
deciding whether a troubleshooting document is internal knowledge-base content (this row) or customer-facing product documentation.
a single support email thread saved out of a mailbox, with no ticket identifier and nothing to distinguish it from ordinary correspondence.
whether an escalation runbook belongs to support or to the engineering on-call rotation it shares names with.

a purpose-coherent support pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a ticket export, an SLA chart, three screenshots and a draft article. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating the supplier-relationship reading from the sourcing event that chose them, the signed contract that binds them, the invoices that pay them and the register entry that risk keeps on them - all five name the same entity, often in the same folder, and the boundary between this row and its two siblings is the weakest in the family. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

deciding which SIDE of a relationship a document is on: a supplier's own quarterly review deck about their performance is, to their customer, vendor management, and to the supplier themselves it is account management of a customer. The same PDF is both, to two different holders.
an insurance certificate or a compliance attestation with no covering context, which could equally be the holder's OWN certificate rather than a supplier's.

a purpose-coherent supplier pack whose members are individually unremarkable - an onboarding form, two certificates, a questionnaire, a scorecard and a signed policy. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

readings: an unlabelled prose document that argues a person's fit for a named role - 00 lists exactly this judgement among the model's allowed determinations: it 'may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain'

an OCR'd portal screenshot: deciding it is an application-status or job-portal page rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is admissions - a screenshot reading 'Your Columbia University application has been submitted' - and the recruiting portal is the same shape with an employer in place of a school
whether a heterogeneous set of files is purpose-coherent as ONE recruiting process rather than several - 00's named example of the outcome is 'a career packet EY Internship Application'
an unusual professional artifact whose document kind has no labelled slot - 00 names 'unusual professional artifacts' among the reasons rules alone are insufficient

deciding WHICH of two named organizations is the client and which is the holder's own firm, when no labelled slot marks the roles - a letterhead-less DOCX naming both in body prose. This is the judgement 00 requires be made at all ('The system must separate roles that happen to contain the same entity type'), and it is precisely the judgement rules cannot make from a gazetteer, because both strings are organizations. Abstention is the correct output when the roles are not marked; 00's general instruction covers it - 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification'

deciding whether an unlabelled prose document is a proposal addressed to a prospective client or an internal memo about the same industry. 00 lists this class of determination among the model's allowed ones: it 'may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain'

judging whether a heterogeneous set - a proposal deck, a signed scope document, an analysis workbook, a final report and a folder of meeting notes - is purpose-coherent as ONE engagement. 00 allows exactly this: the model 'may identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet', and warns the pattern that makes it necessary: 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent'

reading an OCR'd screenshot of a client portal, shared workspace or ticket queue and deciding it is engagement material rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is the admissions confirmation screenshot; the model must be free to conclude no association exists, and 00 says so for isolated captures: 'The model must be allowed to conclude that no meaningful association exists'
an unusual professional artifact whose document kind has no labelled slot at all - 00 names 'unusual professional artifacts' among the reasons fixed patterns are insufficient

a decoratively laid-out certificate whose issuer, credential and dates all sit in free text or OCR with no labelled slot - the case rules cannot resolve safely, and 00 names this class of file among the reasons the hybrid engine exists ('unusual professional artifacts')

deciding whether the organization named on a certificate is the issuing authority or the holder's employer, on an employer-run internal certification. The model must cite the text that makes it the issuer and must return unknown otherwise; an employer name read as an issuer is the finance and employment-records seam below

an OCR'd portal capture: judging that it is a licence-status or registry page rather than a generic account page. 00's worked parallel is admissions - a screenshot reading 'Your Columbia University application has been submitted' - and the model is explicitly allowed to determine that an OCR'd screenshot is 'an application portal rather than a generic image'; a licensure registry is the same shape with a board in place of a school

whether a set of certificates, renewal notices and dues receipts is purpose-coherent as one credential's lifecycle rather than several unrelated records - a group-coherence question, and 00 lists 'one course, project, application, recruiting process, photo event, or submission packet' among the single organizing reasons a group may have
a credential whose vocabulary the deterministic pattern catalogue does not cover, including a non-English licence or a trade credential whose renewal language has no labelled slot

a training certificate that is also a study-compliance record, where the credential reading and the research reading are both supported. 00's rule decides the outcome rather than the model's preference: 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification'

whether a resume-shaped document is the holder's own or another person's — the single judgement this whole template rests on, and the one no rule can make from the document alone, because the two files are identical in kind, structure and vocabulary. 00 names this class among the reasons rules are insufficient: "vague filenames, indirect language, multilingual documents, screenshots, unlabeled forms, unusual professional artifacts, and user-specific workflows", and names the determination itself among the model's allowed ones — it "may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain"
unlabelled debrief or calibration prose that discusses several people without naming a requisition, a role or, sometimes, anyone at all — the file whose only evidence is its rhetoric

whether a heterogeneous set of files is one requisition's pipeline or several requisitions bundled in one export — a group-coherence question, not a per-file one, and 00 restricts the model to exactly that: "an LLM receives only compact evidence packets for files or groups that remain ambiguous, have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation"

an OCR'd applicant-tracking board or pipeline page: deciding it is a hiring-system capture rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is the admissions portal capture, and the hiring board is the same shape with a pipeline of other people's names in place of one's own status

whether an evaluation document's subject is the holder, an employee the holder manages, or a candidate, when the subject slot is unresolved. The neighbouring employment-records row already rules that an unresolved subject abstains on both sides; the model's job here is to say which it is when the evidence supports one, never to guess. This is also the point where 00's redaction posture applies before the call: "It should not send full documents where a short heading or OCR excerpt is enough to resolve the question."

an unlabelled prose letter that could be a resignation, a reference, a grievance or a thank-you note — no letterhead, no form field, no labelled slot. 00 lists exactly this judgement among the model's allowed determinations: it 'may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain'.

an OCR'd HR-portal capture: deciding it is a benefits-enrolment or review-cycle page rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is admissions — a screenshot reading 'Your Columbia University application has been submitted' — and the HR portal is the same shape with an employer in place of a school.

whether a heterogeneous set of files is purpose-coherent as ONE tenure at ONE employer rather than several jobs, or rather than one recruiting process. 00's phrase for the shape is that documents can be 'content-incoherent but purpose-coherent', and 'Purpose must be a first-class facet.'

an 'unusual professional artifact' — 00's own phrase for why rules alone are insufficient — whose document kind has no labelled slot: a secondment memo, a works-council notice, a role-change confirmation buried in a thread.

The load-bearing interpretive call of this whole row: deciding whether a design source file, deck or drawing is CURATED work being shown, or live production material that merely looks the same. 00 puts exactly this class of judgement inside the model's allowed determinations - it 'may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain' - and 00 gives the reason rules alone cannot: real collections contain 'unusual professional artifacts'.

Whether a heterogeneous set (a PDF, a layered source file, a reel, a drawing sheet) is purpose-coherent as ONE showcase. This is 00's purpose shape restated on this situation: 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent', assembled from 'measurable clues' rather than from a vague question to the model.

An unlabelled deck: showcase, client deliverable, or internal status deck. All three carry slide titles, images and speaker notes; only the framing separates them, and 00 keeps that call for language interpretation.

An OCR'd portfolio-platform capture: deciding it is a publish or submission confirmation for the holder's own work rather than a generic image or someone else's page. 00's worked parallel is the admissions screenshot; the model must be able to conclude that no meaningful association exists.

an unlabelled prose document that argues a person's fit for a role it never names, from a sender it never names — the cover letter whose only evidence is its rhetoric. 00 lists this judgement among the model's allowed determinations: it "may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain"

an OCR'd portal or correspondence screenshot: deciding it is an application-status page or a decision notice rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is admissions — a screenshot reading "Your Columbia University application has been submitted" — and the recruiting portal is the same shape with an employer in place of a school

whether a heterogeneous set of files is purpose-coherent as ONE recruiting process rather than several at the same company, or several companies in one download. 00's named outcome of that judgement is "a career packet EY Internship Application", and it is a group-coherence question, not a per-file one

whether a document is the holder's own job-search material or someone else's — a reference the holder wrote, a candidate's resume the holder is screening, a colleague's CV kept for a template. The words are identical and only the role is different; 00 names "unusual professional artifacts" among the reasons rules alone cannot carry this
whether two near-identical resumes are a version family or two tailored variants aimed at different processes — a distinction the filename stem cannot make and the content barely can

PRECONDITION: this is patient-identifying material by default, so a model step runs only after P7 classification and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”. A local model under local-only mode is the default reading of every line below.
an unlabelled clinical narrative with no signature block and no patient block - a dictated note pasted into a plain text file, a handwritten note photographed and OCR'd.

separating the holder's OWN health record from a record the holder wrote about someone else, when a clinician is also a patient of the same system and the two document families look identical. This is the central determination for this schema and the model must abstain rather than guess - “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”.

separating a real case from a TEACHING case: a de-identified vignette, an exam question, an anonymised case report. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”. Clinical vocabulary is dense and identical on both sides.

a purpose-coherent professional packet whose members are individually unremarkable - a credentialing bundle carrying an identity document, a certificate, a CV, a reference letter, and a case log. 00's shape for exactly this: “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
a document in a language whose labelled-slot and professional-body vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.

separating a real case conference from a journal club, a teaching round, a departmental business meeting, or a research review that shares the agenda-and-attendance shape exactly.

whether initial-shaped or number-shaped case identifiers refer to real patients or to a de-identified teaching set. The model must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

a purpose-coherent meeting pack whose members are individually unremarkable - an agenda, several imaging exports, a spreadsheet, a blank outcomes form. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

separating a real incident record from a training scenario, a simulation debrief, a policy example, or an audit case sample that reproduces the reporting form exactly.

separating an incident that concerns the HOLDER's care from one the holder merely investigated, witnessed, or received as departmental circulation. The model must abstain rather than assert: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
an unstructured account - a personal reflective note, a contemporaneous aide-memoire, an email chain with no form and no reference.

a purpose-coherent claim bundle whose members are individually unremarkable: records, statements, a policy schedule, correspondence, an invoice. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

an unlabelled narrative with no headings and no signature block - a dictated note pasted into a text file, a scanned handwritten continuation sheet.

whether a chart-shaped document is a REAL chart or a completed teaching template, a portfolio exemplar, or an exam station script - all of which reproduce the same headings faithfully. The model must abstain rather than assert: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

whether a product-and-quantity table is a dispensary stock record, a ward stock request, a wholesaler invoice, or a retail inventory count - all four are the same shape and only the accountability language separates them.

the central judgement of this row and the one it most often gets wrong: whether an administrative document is clinical administration or generic business administration. distinguishing a real letter from a template, an exemplar, a portfolio sample, or a completed teaching exercise reproducing the letter structure.

separating a clinical referral from an administrative onward-send - a records request, a chase, an invoice covering letter - that shares the addressee-and-patient shape. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

a directory of markdown files with no settings directory and no resolved link graph: a personal vault, a project's documentation folder, an exported team wiki that belongs to an employer, or a pile of saved articles

a single note carrying wiki-link syntax with no marked root anywhere above it: a member that escaped its vault, a note written in a vault-flavoured editor that never had one, or an article about note-taking that quotes the syntax
whether a note under a marked root is the user's own writing or a clipped article kept for reading, which decides between a vault member and reading material
whether two marked roots are one vault that was copied and drifted, or two genuinely separate vaults with overlapping note titles

a writing sample: the same bytes are a thesis chapter, seminar paper or manuscript and an application document, and only the surrounding evidence says whether a submission happened. 00 licenses exactly this dual reading — "An academic abstract submitted as part of a university application can retain project = PVA/RDP and document type = abstract while also carrying purpose = university application and target university = UChicago" — so the model's job is to add the application reading without dropping the research one, or to return unknown.

a statement of purpose with no institution named anywhere, which is the common first draft: the model must judge from the prompt's own language whether this is application prose at all, and 00's Wash U.docx is the precedent — "That heading is strong evidence for the College Applications domain" although the filename reveals nothing.

faculty-outreach correspondence before any application exists — a prospective-student inquiry to a professor is neither an application document nor recruiting; the model must be free to conclude that no application fact is supported yet.
an academic CV versus a job-market CV versus a resume, where the same file supports admissions and recruiting and the addressee is stated nowhere in the document.
OCR of a programme portal that must be judged "an application portal rather than a generic image".

a heterogeneous dossier whose shared property is the submission: 00 allows the model to "identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet", which is the content-incoherent / purpose-coherent case, and the dossier here is more heterogeneous than an undergraduate packet's because it mixes research writing, employment history and financial certification.

a document naming several institutions where the addressed one must be picked out — 00's adversarial suite names "multiple institutions in one application essay" as a known failure mode, and a graduate statement of purpose naming an undergraduate institution, a current lab and a target department is that file.

an unlabelled child-written essay whose only admission signal is a prompt-shaped heading. This is 00's Wash U.docx shape, where the filename reveals nothing and "That heading is strong evidence for the College Applications domain"
an OCR'd capture that must be judged as "an application portal rather than a generic image"

a heterogeneous packet whose only shared property is the submission — 00 allows the model to "identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet", which is exactly the content-incoherent / purpose-coherent case here, where a form, a transcript, a health record and an income statement sit together

a document naming several schools where the addressed one must be picked out — 00's adversarial suite names "multiple institutions in one application essay" as a known failure mode, and an entrance-test score report's recipient list is the K-12 version of it

the offer-to-enrolment seam: after an acceptance letter, an enrollment contract for the same school in the same year reads almost identically to the admission packet it ends, but it is academic.k12-schooling's material and its facts are about a school the child now attends

whether a teacher-evaluation form is held by the applicant's family (this template) or by the recommending teacher who wrote it (academic.recommendation-letters-written) — the document is the same object seen from two roles, and only its surrounding evidence separates them
a multilingual or unfamiliar admission form whose labelled slots the deterministic slot vocabulary does not cover

judging that a heterogeneous set serves one workflow at all. This is the situation 00 built the model step for: "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent", and the model "may identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet". 00 also states why a similarity engine cannot do it: "A content-similarity system will tend to split them; a human may intentionally keep them together because they were submitted as one application package."

returning the purpose fact itself, which 00 gates on direct evidence rather than on the set's existence: "The LLM may return purpose = university application submission only if the dossier includes direct application evidence, such as admissions language, a portal, a checklist, or a clearly targeted essay."

reading a multilingual packet whose filenames reveal nothing and whose documents are not in the interface language. 00 protects this case explicitly at the extraction layer — "The system should not use unreliable global language-quality checks that incorrectly punish multilingual or mathematics-heavy documents" — and the interpretation that follows is language work rules cannot do.

deciding, over an accepted branch, whether the material is one flat purpose packet or one institution's packet. 00 leaves the decision with the user and calls the template a proposal: "The template is a recommendation mechanism, not a rule that erases purposeful heterogeneity."
judging an OCR'd capture as a submission checklist or upload confirmation rather than a generic image — 00: "A screenshot is always a screenshot of something", and only its OCR decides which.

an unlabelled personal essay whose only signal is that its prompt asks about financial need, community service, leadership, or hardship. The model must decide whether it is addressed to a sponsor, to an admissions office, or is coursework, and must cite the sentence that says so — 'It must return unknown where support is insufficient.'

an OCR-derived capture that must be judged as a sponsor's application portal rather than a generic image — 00's own framing of the task is to recognize 'application portal rather than a generic image'

a heterogeneous set whose only shared property is the submission itself. 00 lets the model 'identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet', which is this situation's normal case: 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.'

a fellowship document naming both a funding program and a host university, where only one of them is the addressee. 00's adversarial suite already names the neighbouring failure — 'multiple institutions in one application essay' — and this is its sponsor-plus-host variant.

deciding whether an award-shaped document is an application the holder submitted or a record of money already received, when the outcome word is absent and only an amount and an organization are present

an unlabelled prose document whose only application signal is its prompt heading — 00's Wash U.docx, where "That heading is strong evidence for the College Applications domain" although the filename reveals nothing
an OCR'd capture that must be judged as "an application portal rather than a generic image"

a document naming several institutions where the addressed one must be picked out; 00's adversarial suite names "multiple institutions in one application essay" as a known failure mode, and this template needs exactly one addressee to be the right situation at all

deciding, over an accepted branch, whether the material is one institution's packet or the flat purpose-coherent packet. 00 puts this choice with the user and calls the template a recommendation: "The template is a recommendation mechanism, not a rule that erases purposeful heterogeneity."

an unlabelled prose document whose only application signal is its prompt heading — 00's Wash U.docx, where 'That heading is strong evidence for the College Applications domain' although the filename reveals nothing
an OCR'd capture that must be judged as 'an application portal rather than a generic image'

a heterogeneous set whose only shared property is the submission itself; 00 allows the model to 'identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet', which is exactly the content-incoherent / purpose-coherent case
a document naming several institutions where the addressed one must be picked out — 00's adversarial suite names 'multiple institutions in one application essay' as a known failure mode
an unlabelled prose letter about a site that could be a client instruction, a contractor's claim, a neighbour's objection or a surveyor's advice, with no reference line and no letterhead.

a photograph of a wall with no caption: an as-built record, a defect, a survey of an existing condition, or somebody's phone picture of their own kitchen — the image alone does not say which, and a wrong guess files a private home photo in a professional job.
a spreadsheet of costed lines that could be a builder's quotation, a developer's appraisal, an owner's budget or an accountant's cost report, where no header names the world.
a document that reads as a lease, a licence, a heads of terms or a memorandum, where which one it is decides whether the protected legal side or the estate-management side is the honest home.
deciding which SIDE of a transaction the holder is on when a document reads identically from both — the discriminator is a role, and roles live in prose more often than in slots.

a photograph of a room with no caption: a marketing shot, an inventory photograph, a defect record or the occupier's own picture of their home. This is the row's hardest recurring case and the one where a wrong answer is most intrusive.
a draft particulars document, which reads as prose about a house and may equally be a description written by the owner, a competitor's listing saved for reference, or an AI-generated draft.
deciding whether the holder is the agent, the vendor, the landlord or an applicant browsing — the same particulars PDF reaches all four and only the surrounding evidence separates them.
separating a live instruction from a comparable kept for evidence, where the document is byte-identical and only the reason for keeping it differs.
a letter to leaseholders that could be a routine notice, a consultation, a demand, a breach allegation or the opening of a dispute — the difference changes both the group and the sensitivity posture.
minutes that could be a residents' association meeting, a management company board meeting or an AGM, which decides whether the residents' side or the professional side owns them.
deciding whether the holder is the managing agent, a director of the residents' company, or one leaseholder keeping their own copies — the same demand and the same minutes reach all three.
an insurance schedule that could cover a block, a single flat's contents, or a landlord's portfolio.
an unlabelled letter from a council that could be a planning decision, a council-tax matter, an enforcement notice or a highways issue — all arrive on the same letterhead about the same address.
a design and access, heritage or flood-risk statement, which reads as an essay and whose only application evidence may be a single reference line.
distinguishing an ENFORCEMENT communication from an ordinary decision, which changes the sensitivity posture and may make the protected legal side co-activate.
deciding whether the holder is the applicant, the agent, the objecting neighbour or the authority — the same letter reaches all four.

deciding whether an authority document sits inside a live CASE or stands alone. This is the narrowing this row accepted on deepening: a decision notice with an acknowledgement, a condition-discharge exchange and an inspection sequence around it is this row; the same notice alone in a householder's folder is not, and “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files”.
an unlabelled document that reads as a lease, an agreement for lease, a licence, a tenancy at will or heads of terms — which one it is decides whether the protected legal side owns the file.
correspondence about a break notice, where whether it is a valid exercise, a query or a dispute changes both the group and the sensitivity.
deciding whether the holder is the landlord, the tenant, the managing agent or an adviser to one of them — the same schedule reaches all four and the role is what makes the file mean anything.
a photograph of a shopfront or an office interior with no caption: a schedule of condition image, a dilapidations image, a marketing shot or a fit-out record.

a letter about delay, disruption or a defect that could be a contractual claim, a courtesy update or the opening of a dispute — the difference decides whether the protected legal side should co-activate.
a programme exported to PDF with no title block and no job reference, indistinguishable from any other Gantt.
an unlabelled photograph of a completed room: as-built evidence, a defect record, or a marketing shot for the agency row.
deciding whether an appointment is a construction contract or a professional services agreement, where the vocabulary is shared and the filing world differs.

deciding whether a completion certificate is a practical-completion certificate closing a building contract (this row) or a statutory building-regulations completion certificate (construction_property.building-control from the applicant's side, and finance.household-property when the holder is the owner of their own home). The word is identical and the issuing apparatus is not.

deciding whether a handover pack assembled for one site is this row's closing artefact or a construction_property.drawings-revisions issue - a transmittal of as-builts to a client reads as both, and the discriminator is whether the pack is complete-and-final or one issue in a controlled sequence.
a spreadsheet of costed lines with no header naming the world: a developer's appraisal, a builder's quotation, an owner's budget or an accountant's cost report all look the same at cell level.
an investment memorandum written as prose, whose numbers live in the narrative rather than in cells.

deciding whether an appraisal concerns a scheme the holder is actually pursuing or one they looked at and declined — which decides whether it is a live record or reading material, and which no rule will answer.
separating a development appraisal from an investment valuation of an existing income-producing building, where the yield vocabulary is shared.
a scanned or photographed sheet whose title block is cropped, rotated or illegible, where the only remaining evidence is the drawn content.
a PDF export of a model view with no border and no title block — a real deliverable that looks like a visualisation.
deciding whether a sheet is design information for construction or a marketing floor plan drawn from the same model, where the drawn content is nearly identical and only the annotation differs.
reading a revision-history description well enough to know whether a change was substantive or a title-block correction — which is what a human actually wants to know and what no rule will supply.
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

which side of the payment cycle the file sits on. The same valuation exists in the payer's file as a certificate and in the payee's as an application, with substantially identical numbers; only purpose separates them. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
separating a draft final account still under negotiation from the agreed one, when both are spreadsheets with identical tabs, no version token in the filename, and different totals.
deciding whether an unlabeled spreadsheet of additions and omissions is a final account, a variation register, or an internal cost report - three different situations with the same columns.
recognising that a settlement letter or an email exchange, not any document called an account, is the operative agreement that closed the account.
a photographed day-work sheet that has been priced up in the same image - part timesheet, part valuation substantiation.

a valuation pack whose members are individually unremarkable - a summary, a measure, a variation schedule, photographs and a delay narrative - and coherent only by purpose. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
separating a check-in from a check-out when both are unlabelled exports from the same inventory system with the same layout and the same photographs.

whose document it is. The clerk who wrote it, the agent who commissioned it, the landlord who relies on it and the tenant who received it all hold the same PDF. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
deciding whether an unlabelled set of room photographs with no report is an inventory at all, or a marketing shoot, or progress photography, or somebody's moving-day snapshots.
reading a deduction argument out of a check-out report where the operative content is a free-text comment column rather than the gradings.
recognising a schedule of condition attached to a commercial lease as this situation rather than as part of the lease instrument itself.

an inventory pack that is purpose-coherent and content-incoherent: a report, a photo appendix, meter photographs, a signed acknowledgement and a key receipt. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

separating a delivery note from the supplier's invoice for the same load. They carry the same supplier, the same lines and often the same reference, and only one of them is a demand for payment. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
reading a handwritten shortage or damage annotation off a photographed note, where the printed lines OCR cleanly and the thing that matters does not.
deciding whether a photograph of a pallet on a pavement is delivery evidence, progress photography, or a damage claim - the same image serves all three and only context decides.
recognising a merchant's monthly statement as an accounting document rather than a delivery record, when it lists the same delivery-note numbers.
a delivery pack that is purpose-coherent and content-incoherent: a note, two certificates, a photograph and a signed sheet. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

deciding whether an ordering document is a routine site call-off (this row's ordering half), a competitively sourced purchase order (business_operations.procurement-sourcing), or a release against an executed supply agreement (business_operations.contract-administration). All three print the letters PO. Only the surrounding apparatus - a solicitation and an award, or a signed agreement reference, or a materials schedule and a site - separates them, and where none is present the model must abstain: “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

whether a document ended the hire. An email saying 'you can collect the 3-tonne on Friday' may be the operative off-hire, and the formal notice may never exist. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

separating hired plant from owned plant. A firm's own excavator generates inspection records, service sheets and defect photographs that are identical in form and belong to an asset register, not to a hire.
deciding whether a photograph of a damaged machine is a claim, an inspection, or ordinary progress photography.
reading an idle-time or standing-charge dispute out of a hire statement, where the charge lines look identical to working ones.
a hire pack that is purpose-coherent and content-incoherent: an agreement, an inspection certificate, a docket run and a photograph. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

separating a competitively sourced equipment award from the resulting hire lifecycle. A request for quotation, bid comparison and award recommendation belong to business_operations.procurement-sourcing; the awarded agreement begins this row only when it creates an asset-specific, time-charged on-hire/off-hire relationship.
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

the same device, the same day, two purposes: a site manager's phone holds the progress walk and a photograph of their lunch, and only content decides. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

separating a progress record from a defect record, a delivery record, an inventory record and a damage claim - all site photography, all from the same phone, distinguished only by what the image shows and what group it joins.
reading a caption or an embedded annotation as the thing that gives an image its meaning, when the filename is IMG_ and nothing else.
deciding whether a set of images without EXIF - stripped by a messaging app on the way from a subcontractor - is a progress set at all.
recognising a photo-report PDF as a derived document of an image set that also exists loose in the corpus.
PRECONDITION: any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy, and must abstain rather than guess: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

which side sent it. A homeowner's folder and a builder's folder both contain the same quote PDF; in one it is a received offer and in the other it is the firm's own output. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
separating a quotation (a firm offer capable of acceptance) from an estimate (an indication) when the document says neither and simply prints a number.
deciding whether a priced spreadsheet is a quote to a client or an internal cost plan the quote was built from - the second must not be sent anywhere, and the two look identical.
recognising an emailed price in the body of a message, with no attachment, as the operative quote.
a photographed handwritten quote on a trade letterhead, where OCR yields a total and a name and nothing structural.
reading acceptance out of a reply - a one-line email saying go ahead is what converts the document, and nothing in the quote itself records it.

PRECONDITION: a diary names individual workers, records their attendance and sometimes their conduct, and may narrate an injury, so any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating a DIARY from a MEETING RECORD. Both are dated narratives of what was said and agreed on a site. The honest discriminant is the trigger — a diary is written because the day happened, a site-meeting minute is written because a meeting was convened, and it carries an attendee list, numbered action items and a next-meeting date.

an unlabelled day-sheet: a scanned handwritten A5 page with a date, some trade names and a weather word, and no form furniture at all. This is the commonest real diary and the hardest file in the row.

separating a diary entry that is merely a record from one written as CLAIM MATERIAL — the same page, in the same book, with the same handwriting, becomes the exhibit in a delay claim. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

a purpose-coherent claim bundle whose members are individually unremarkable — a run of diary pages, a weather report, a programme extract and two photographs, assembled for one argument. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row holds named individuals' injuries, health surveillance and disciplinary events, which is the most sensitive material in the whole construction family. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating a GENERIC template pack — a downloaded or purchased RAMS document with placeholders and a supplier's footer — from a SITE-SPECIFIC one that has been edited for a real task at a real address. The generic one is reference material; the site-specific one is a record. They are the same document ninety percent by word count.

separating a safety document held because the holder WROTE it from one held because a subcontractor SUBMITTED it. The pack is identical and the filing consequence is not; this is the same two-roles-in-one-parties-block problem the canonical field list has no key for.
an unlabelled prose risk assessment: a page of paragraphs describing hazards with no matrix and no form furniture — common in small trades and the hardest file in this row.
separating an incident report about a WORKER from one about a MEMBER OF THE PUBLIC or a client, which changes who the affected data subject is without changing the form.

a purpose-coherent audit or pre-qualification pack whose members are individually unremarkable — a policy, three RAMS, an insurance certificate, a training matrix and an accident statistic sheet, assembled for one submission. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: survey material carries precise locations, and some of it — an asbestos register, a services search — has consequences for real occupants, so any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.”

the central determination for this row: separating a SURVEY OF WHAT EXISTS from a DESIGN OF WHAT IS PROPOSED. Both are scaled drawings from the same practice with the same title-block furniture, and the discriminant is usually a single word in the title (existing / as-existing / survey versus proposed / GA / for construction) — which is exactly the kind of ambiguity a model is for.

separating this row from construction_property.survey-valuation: a structural engineer's inspection report reads as both a measured investigation and a professional opinion, and where a document carries an addressee, a limitation of liability and a conclusion, the opinion reading wins.

an unlabelled site sketch: a photographed hand-measured floor plan with dimensions written on it and nothing else — the commonest real survey in the small-trade world and the hardest file in this row.

separating an as-built or record survey taken AFTER works from a pre-works survey. The deliverable is identical and the purpose is opposite. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

a purpose-coherent survey pack whose members are individually unremarkable — a coordinate file, a drawing, a photograph set, a borehole log and a services search, commissioned together for one site. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: defect registers name individual tradespeople as responsible parties and, in residential work, name the occupant whose home is faulty. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.”

the central determination for this row: separating a DEFECT (something built wrong, to be put right under an existing obligation) from a VARIATION (something the client now wants differently, to be paid for). The two are argued about precisely because the same item is presented as each by the two sides, and the register row often reads identically.
separating a contractor's own snagging list from the CLIENT's list of the same building. Same items, same rooms, opposite authorship, and the canonical field list has no key for the role.
an unlabelled defect note: a photograph with a scrawled arrow, or a three-line email saying the kitchen door binds, with no item number and no register around it.
separating a defects register from a maintenance or repairs log. Both are located, statused fault lists; only one sits under a completion obligation with an end date.

a purpose-coherent handover file whose members are individually unremarkable — a completion certificate, a register, a photograph set, an operating manual and a warranty. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row holds another firm's prices, its insurance details, its people's competence cards and sometimes the record of its failure. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: which SIDE the holder is on. A subcontract order, a payment application and a payment notice are the same documents in every subcontractor's file and every main contractor's file, with the roles reversed and nothing in the document saying whose filesystem it is. This is the same hole business_operations.contract-administration records for buying versus selling.

separating a SUBCONTRACT (labour and works, under the main contract, with a payment-notice regime) from a SUPPLY ORDER (materials delivered, paid on invoice). The paperwork rhymes and the legal machinery does not.

separating an application for payment from an invoice. In construction the application usually comes first and the invoice follows the certified sum, so the same money appears twice in two document families.
an unlabelled engagement: a price emailed by a trade, accepted by reply, with no order and no terms — the commonest real subcontract in small works.

a purpose-coherent package file whose members are individually unremarkable — an order, three insurance certificates, a RAMS pack, six applications and a retention schedule. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's files name a private individual, a property they are buying or own, a lender and a sum of money, which is one of the more directly identifying combinations in the whole catalogue. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating an OPINION from a MEASUREMENT, which is the boundary with construction_property.site-survey. A structural engineer's inspection report measures crack widths and then concludes; the reliance furniture is what decides it.

separating WHICH SIDE holds the document. A mortgage valuation is commissioned by a lender, paid for by a buyer, seen by a broker and filed by all three, and the addressee block states one name in one role without saying whose filesystem this is.

separating a professional valuation from an estate agent's marketing appraisal. Both give a figure for a property; only one is given under a professional basis with a liability limitation, and agents' appraisals are deliberately written to look like the real thing.
an unlabelled specialist letter: two paragraphs on a firm's letterhead saying a wall is not moving, with no ratings, no figure and no form furniture.

a purpose-coherent transaction pack whose members are individually unremarkable — a valuation, a damp report, a search result, a quote for remedial works and an email chain, assembled for one purchase decision. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row holds a named person's identity documents, their income, their credit history and the address they live at — the densest concentration of protected personal data anywhere in the construction schema, and mostly about someone who is not the holder. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: which SIDE the holder is on. A tenancy agreement, a deposit certificate and a gas record are identical in the landlord's file, the agent's file and the tenant's file, and the document does not say whose. This is the seam with the landed finance.household-property, which holds the household's own side, and it is stated reciprocally on both.

separating the LETTING side's apparatus from the occupier's own copy of the same tenancy — the determination immediately above, applied to individual documents. Note what this is NOT: the size of the portfolio. A managed portfolio and one accidental landlord's single flat produce corpora of very different shape, but scale is a threshold and cannot be the test; a one-flat landlord who referenced a tenant, protected a deposit and served a notice is squarely this row. Corpus shape is context for a human reviewer, never a discriminator.
separating a tenancy agreement, which is an executed instrument the legal safety schema protects, from the management activity around it that this row is about.
an unlabelled tenancy file: a scanned signed agreement with no filename, an email chain about a leak, and three bank screenshots.

a purpose-coherent tenancy file whose members are individually unremarkable — an agreement, a certificate, an inventory, a ledger and a notice, sharing nothing but a tenant and an address. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: every file in this row names a private individual and the address they live at, usually together with a phone number and sometimes a photograph of the inside of their home. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating a JOB from a PROJECT. The documents rhyme — both have quotes, photographs, certificates and invoices — and the discriminant is the machinery around them rather than the subject: no contract administration, no valuations, no programme, no packages, and a corpus of five files rather than five hundred.

separating the TRADE's copy from the CUSTOMER's copy of the same invoice and certificate. The documents are identical and the filing consequence is opposite: one is a business record about many customers, the other is a household record about one home.

an unlabelled job: a photograph of a handwritten quote on a duplicate pad, a text-message thread agreeing a price, and a bank notification — the commonest real job file in the trade world and the hardest in this row.
separating a job's before-and-after photographs from a household's ordinary phone photographs, which are the same device, the same day and often the same rooms.

a purpose-coherent job file whose members are individually unremarkable — a quote, two photographs, a materials receipt, a certificate and an invoice, sharing nothing but an address. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: claim material is prepared against a named opponent, frequently reviewed by lawyers, and is among the most commercially damaging material a construction business holds. Any model step runs after P7 and under the user's policy. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

the central determination for this row: separating a VARIATION (a change the client wants, to be paid for) from a DEFECT (something built wrong, to be put right free). The same item is presented as each by the two sides, in good faith, and both readings are written down.

separating a CONTEMPORANEOUS RECORD from CLAIM MATERIAL made out of it. A diary page, a photograph and a delivery note become exhibits when a claim is built; the bytes do not change and the purpose does. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
separating which SIDE the holder is on. A claim submission and a claim response are the same document family with the roles reversed, and the letterhead is often a consultant's rather than a party's.

an unlabelled instruction: an email saying 'yes go ahead with the extra sockets' that is legally an instruction and looks like nothing at all — the commonest real variation in small works and the hardest file in this row.

a purpose-coherent claim bundle whose members are individually unremarkable — three diary pages, a weather report, a programme extract, two photographs and a subcontractor's quotation, assembled for one argument. This row is 00's own example shape: “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

reading a claim bundle through 00's OWN purpose-packet procedure rather than through any mechanism invented here. 00 states the questions to ask of a content-incoherent group directly: “whether the files plausibly serve one shared workflow, whether the group is purpose-coherent despite topic diversity, which members appear to be supporting materials rather than unrelated records, and whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose”. The last clause is the one this row needs most, because a claim bundle deliberately contains comparator files from OTHER contracts, and those are precisely members that conflict with the proposed purpose. A bundle folder name is evidence of purpose and nothing else: “Purpose may be supported strongly by an existing user-created folder name or explicit language in a form or portal.” and “It is a purpose clue and a review aid, not a basis for automatic semantic propagation.”
in every case above, abstention is the required outcome where the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

context_terms: proposed for r6, not design. 00 states the pattern-plus-context shape for course codes only and lists none of these.

naming a work in the maker's own vocabulary when the folder is called `New Folder 2` and the files are `Untitled-1.psd` through `Untitled-9.psd`
judging whether an export set is a delivery, a portfolio upload, or a backup of the same thing three times
deciding whether a photographed or screenshotted reference image is inspiration for this work or a member of another domain entirely
deciding whether a model is a creative asset, BIM/construction model, engineering/manufacturing model, scientific visualization, game asset, or code-generated output
matching differently named source scenes, textures, caches, exports and previews when manifests, embedded links, metadata or review references establish one asset family
deciding whether a render is an authored output, supplied client material, downloaded reference, portfolio image, photograph, or screenshot
deciding whether a review, delivery, acceptance, or license applies to the whole package or only named files, variants, platforms, territories, or time windows
deciding whether an archive member inherits package context; archive paths and neighboring files do not by themselves write facts onto every member

deciding whether a folder holding a brief, a spreadsheet of costs, a font licence, forty JPEGs and a signed PDF is ONE campaign or one download afternoon - 00's purpose-coherence question, asked of the group dossier and never of a lone JPEG

separating the campaign FOR a launch from the launch itself when both name the same offering, the same date and sit in the same folder - the reciprocal of business_operations.go-to-market's own fold question
judging whether a set of resizes is a delivery of this campaign, a portfolio re-export of a campaign that already ran, or a competitor's work saved as reference

reading a spec grid that is present but unlabelled - a folder of files whose only campaign evidence is that their pixel dimensions happen to be a known ad-unit set, where a wallpaper pack would look identical to a size-blind reader
deciding whether a market token on a stem is an adaptation of this campaign (this row) or a translation job with its own counterparty and delivery (creative.translation-project)
recognising a campaign whose flight has already ended, where the only remaining evidence is a retrospective case-study PDF that is now the maker's portfolio piece
deciding whether the building or scheme named in a brief is the subject of the visualisation, the client, the site owner, a depicted precedent, or merely a reference

deciding whether a .skp, .blend, .3dm, .max, .rvt or IFC-like file is a visualisation scene, a construction/BIM authoring model, a survey/model import, or a code/engineering artifact; extension alone is insufficient
matching a model, texture pack, camera file and rendered stills when filenames differ but scene metadata, view labels, asset links and manifest references establish one source-to-output chain
separating a client approval of photorealistic views from approval of drawings, planning submission, construction issue, lease material, or a marketing listing
deciding whether a render is an authored project output, a downloaded reference, a portfolio case study, a photograph of a built site, or an image supplied by another party
deciding whether an approval or licence covers all views, only named images, a competition entry, a marketing campaign, or a time/territory-limited use

Whether a chapter-shaped ordered run is one book, an anthology assembled from separately-authored pieces, a periodical's back-issue set, or a course reader - all four produce ordered same-stem text runs and only the surrounding apparatus separates them.

Whether a complete book apparatus belongs to a work being MADE or a work being READ. This is the row's hardest live judgement and the reason its principal collision fixture is a purchased ebook: a retail EPUB's front matter is more complete than any draft's.

Whether a long structured non-fiction draft is a trade book or a degree thesis when both apparatuses are partially present - a revised dissertation on its way to a trade publisher genuinely holds both, and 00 permits that: 'One file may hold facts from more than one domain without losing information.'

Whether a proposal, partial or synopsis is evidence of MAKING the work or of SELLING it, which decides between this row and `creative.submission-query`. The addressee block and the presence of a query letter are the readable discriminators; the LLM reads them, it does not guess from the filename.
Whether an interview recording, archival scan or reading note is source material bound to this work by an exact title reference, or an independent record that merely shares a subject with the book.

deciding whether a document is an operative identity standard for the holder's organisation, a client-facing proposal, a public reference guide, or a one-off campaign brief; the model must cite the role and governance language or return unknown
deciding whether approval applies to the identity system or merely to one campaign asset; the exact object, revision, approver role, and effective or superseded language must be identified
deciding whether a supplied logo pack is controlled organisational identity material or a downloaded reference/template library when provenance and permitted-use language are absent
deciding whether a heterogeneous archive is one identity-system packet when member filenames differ but the manifest and repeated system identifier establish shared governance
separating a client engagement's identity deliverables from the durable identity system itself when the same manual is attached to a statement of work

deciding whether two organisation names describe commissioner and maker, the maker and a subcontractor, two brands depicted in the work, or merely sender and recipient; a model must cite the role-bearing text or return unknown

deciding whether an inbound commission enquiry became an accepted engagement; a request, budget suggestion or meeting invitation is not acceptance without a reply, scope, work product or other relationship evidence
distinguishing client feedback from internal art direction when an email says only 'please revise' and the sender role is not labelled
distinguishing a delivered client master from a portfolio copy, publication asset, DAM download or backup; the handoff context, not identical bytes, supplies the engagement evidence
deciding whether a purpose-coherent packet of brief, references, working sources, proofs, approval and exports is one commissioned job despite content and format diversity

separating an in-house creative request from a general internal project: an internal requester may be a client operationally, but the packet still needs a creative artifact moving through review to delivery

separating the creative work record from commercial and legal administration embedded in the same packet; one signed scope may be evidence for several schemas without transferring fees, obligations or legal effect into creative facts

distinguishing paid or client-commissioned work from a personal collaboration when identical cameras, filenames and editing tools were used and only prose in the brief or correspondence states the counterparty relationship
deciding whether a mixed folder of brief, releases, captures and exports is one shoot or several jobs copied together, without propagating a client or project label to sparse members
distinguishing a photographer's production packet from a retailer's delivered product-catalogue assets: the former owns the making chain; the latter owns the selected item-keyed selling asset
deciding whether an annotated image is a client proof, an internal retouch note, a portfolio image or a personal photo with markup
reading non-standard or multilingual release and call-sheet forms after the material has already entered the potentially-sensitive local handling path

deciding whether a folder of dated drafts, images and a spreadsheet is a continuing programme or a single bounded burst around one launch - the boundary against creative.ad-campaign and business_operations.go-to-market, asked of a group dossier and never of a lone file

deciding whether a document naming a real customer and quoting a named employee is an approved published case study or an unapproved interview write-up, when the two are byte-similar and only the approval is missing
deciding whether an article is brand-owned programme material or the writer's own bylined piece, when the same person wrote both and keeps them in the same folder
deciding whether a frontmatter-carrying .md is a blog post or a documentation page belonging to a software project
deciding whether an analyst-report-shaped PDF titled as a State-of-the-industry report is this programme's own published gated asset or a competitor's publication that was downloaded to read
naming the programme in the maker's own vocabulary when the folder is called Content and the files are Draft, Draft2, Draft-final

deciding whether a same-stem export set was assembled for external handoff, internal review, publication upload, portfolio use, or backup; the model must cite a recipient-facing manifest, transmittal, acceptance, rights, or custody statement

matching an unstructured email acknowledgement to one exact package when the message says only 'received' or 'looks good'; adjacency and thread membership support a hypothesis but do not identify the accepted bytes
distinguishing acceptance of creative quality from operational receipt, legal acceptance, payment approval, or permission to publish; each event may coexist but none substitutes silently for another
reading a free-text readme that mixes technical opening instructions, asset provenance, font or stock restrictions, and delivery notes, while keeping unsupported legal conclusions unknown

deciding whether editable source files were transferred as deliverables, lent temporarily, placed in escrow, or merely retained by the maker; custody verbs and return or deletion obligations are decisive

separating rights granted by the maker from third-party restrictions merely disclosed by the maker; a stock licence, font EULA, model release, and client usage licence have different parties and effects

deciding whether a package belongs to a larger client engagement without copying a client, project, stage, or rights fact onto sparse binary members; group membership is permitted without fact propagation

Deciding whether a work-listing spreadsheet is a SHOW CHECKLIST or a standing COLLECTION INVENTORY - the same columns can serve both, and the discriminator is the presence of a show, a run, wall assignments or a lender column rather than a single owner.

WHETHER A NAMED PERSON IS A SOURCE OR A PARTICIPANT-AS-PRODUCT. This is the single most consequential judgement on the row and no deterministic signal settles it, because the filenames are identical. The evidence the model should be handed is whether the same name ALSO appears in a published-shaped artifact of the same neighbourhood - show notes, cover art, an episode title, a cast list, a masthead. If it does, the identity is the product and the neighbour (`creative.podcast-episode`, `creative.film-production`) is right. If the working material names a person whom the published piece does not name, or generalises the person to a role - a city engineer who asked not to be named - which is an illustrative construction here and not a quotation, the protection posture below applies. The model must be able to return uncertain: "the LLM must be able to say that a group is coherent while still marking particular members as uncertain."

WHETHER AN OBTAINED BUNDLE IS MATERIAL FOR A WORK OR THE RECORD OF A MATTER THE PERSON IS PARTY TO. A disclosure response addressed to the corpus owner about the corpus owner is `legal` or `government.public-records-foi`; the same bundle requested about a third party, sitting beside a draft and a fact-check, is this row's raw material.

WHETHER A FOLDER OF OTHER PEOPLE'S ARTICLES IS BACKGROUND FOR A STORY OR A READING PILE. This is the commonest false positive in the whole row and it must resolve to Reading Inbox by default; only an explicit binding to a live slug moves it here.

PURPOSE-COHERENCE ACROSS A FORMAT-INCOHERENT SET. This is 00's own shape applied to a story instead of an application: "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent. A content-similarity system will tend to split them; a human may intentionally keep them together because they were submitted as one application package." A story's material is audio, spreadsheet, scan, screenshot and prose; every content-similarity method available will scatter it, and a purpose reading is the only thing that holds it together.

WHETHER A DRAFT RUN'S SUBJECT MAKES IT REPORTING AT ALL, when the material set is absent. Reporting cannot be inferred from a piece's topic, and a prose draft about a water utility is not journalism because it is about a water utility.

Reading a flatplan out of a layout file where the grid is drawn rather than tabulated, and separating it from a contents page, which looks similar and is a finished artefact rather than an allocation.
