Deciding whether an anonymised manuscript is a peer-review artefact or simply a document whose author metadata happens to be absent - the absence of an author block is not evidence of anonymisation, the same way missing EXIF is not proof of a screenshot.
deciding whether an audio file is a podcast episode, a music session, a sound-design asset, a lecture, a meeting recording, or an audiobook chapter when the filename and metadata are generic
deciding whether a pitch or guest booking became a recorded episode; an invitation, calendar event, or unaccepted proposal does not establish production
linking a transcript or show notes to an episode when titles changed between draft, edit, and release, while preserving unknowns rather than copying a nearby title
distinguishing a public release from a private test upload, scheduled draft, takedown, or platform cache; words such as final, live, or published need the platform record or explicit status context
separating the episode's editorial identity from a guest's career record, a client's content-marketing campaign, or a code/repository artifact embedded in the same delivery packet
determining rights scope from a release or licence without inferring ownership, exclusivity, or perpetual publication from a signature or filename
deciding whether a timeline/session is a film, commercial, social edit, podcast, music track, lecture, personal video or software-generated render when the surrounding purpose is not labelled
distinguishing camera originals or still photographs from editorial source media when the same files are also plausible members of photos or shoot-day media
matching a review note to the exact cut or export when filenames, timecodes, attachment names and embedded thumbnails disagree
deciding whether a master is approved for release, approved only for internal review, or merely named FINAL in a filename
deciding whether a project archive is complete when linked media, fonts, LUTs, plugins or external audio are absent
deciding whether an item labelled final or approved is a customer-approved proof, an internal design export, or a legal/commercial approval
deciding whether a printer name is the production vendor, a paper or ink supplier, a client, or merely a logo appearing in a reference document
joining a press report, email and exported PDF when names differ but the job identity is expressed in prose or a scanned purchase-order attachment
separating a delivered printed object record from a design portfolio image or photographed finished work

EDITION or PRODUCTION RUN - the load-bearing judgement and not a lexical one. A closed edition of thirty individually numbered, individually designated objects and a commercial run of five hundred interchangeable posters use the same nouns (print, run, proof, press, paper, quantity) and often the same workshop. The discriminating structure is whether the copies are ADDRESSABLE INDIVIDUALLY (numbered, each with its own disposition) or FUNGIBLE (a quantity in an order line beside a unit price). Only a reader can tell.
whether a fraction-shaped token is an impression number, a date fragment, a page marker, an aspect ratio, a score or a scale.

whether a document called a proof is a printmaking proof standing outside a numbered run, a prepress contract proof approving a commercial job (creative.print-production), or a design revision shown to a client (creative.revision-round).

whether an artisan's process log - a firing schedule, a dye lot sheet, a binding structure note - attaches to an ENUMERATED edition or is a standing studio record with no closed set behind it. This is exactly where this row narrows itself, and the answer is usually the second.
whether a documentation image documents the corpus owner's OWN object or someone else's, which decides between this row and Reference Clips and cannot be read off the pixels.
whether a numbered set is a physical edition at all or a digital issuance that borrowed the vocabulary - a token drop, a numbered digital download, a serialised software licence.

Deciding whether a folder holding one novel's proofs, jacket and print spec is a publisher's production set or an author's archive of what the publisher sent them. The bytes are identical and the discriminator is the presence of production-side apparatus that an author never generates - a schedule with other titles on it, a P&L, a printer purchase order, a distribution feed. Where none is present, prefer creative.book-manuscript or abstain.

Separating a title production set from a print job that merely happens to be a book-shaped object - a self-published print run, a conference proceedings, a commemorative volume. The reading turns on whether a PRODUCT identity and a distribution record exist, not on whether the object has pages and a spine.
Reading catalogue and sales-sheet copy, which is marketing prose about a work and is easily mistaken for the work itself, or for reading material the corpus owner saved.

Interpreting an ordinal round word ('first pass', 'second revises', 'blues', 'F&Gs') in context, because the same words appear in creative.print-production and in creative.revision-round with different meanings.

Judging whether a foreign-language edition file belongs to this title's production set or to a separately held translation engagement, which is a real seam against creative.translation-project rather than a formatting question.

Whether a body of dated folders is a working archive at all, or a one-off card dump that was never catalogued — the difference is a pattern across many folders, which is exactly the judgement 00 reserves for the model layer while keeping the underlying signals deterministic.

Whether a catalogue-shaped database belongs to a stills archive or to some unrelated application that also ships a SQLite file beside a media folder. Nothing in the bytes settles it under metadata-only indexing; the surrounding filenames may, and the honest outcome is often abstention.

Whether an archive is a professional practice's working store or a serious amateur's personal library. The files are identical. This matters only because it decides between this row and the photos schema's situations, and it is the one question in the row that no signal answers — recorded as an open question rather than guessed.
Whether a folder slug names a client, a location or an occasion. Reading a slug as a client would be the row quietly minting a creative fact it has no field for.
a production-day folder whose only explicit signal is prose in a production report or email, with no standard call-sheet heading
deciding whether a set photograph documents a production day or is an ordinary personal/event capture when the image has no slate, crew, production or project context
mapping informal clip, reel and card naming conventions to one shoot day when the date is present only in neighboring documents

Deciding whether a file of continuous prose is a COMPLETE work or a section of a longer one, when there is no compile container, no ordered run and no full-manuscript sibling. This is the shared frontier with creative.book-manuscript and the correct outcome is frequently that neither fires. 00: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product's goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

Distinguishing a personal essay from an admissions personal statement when both are untitled first-person prose in the same folder. The discriminator is an ADDRESSEE and it usually exists only inside the text, which is exactly the case 00 hands to the model: it "may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain" and "must return unknown where support is insufficient."

Judging authorship DIRECTION on a folder of typeset PDFs - the holder's own published pieces versus a collection of other people's writing kept for reading. Surface features are identical; the evidence is a bio note, a recurring byline, or a ledger row, and where none exists the material is reading material.

Reading editorial correspondence for its outcome - a form rejection, a personal rejection, a revise-and-resubmit and an acceptance are the same length and the same sender, and the difference is idiomatic language rather than a labelled slot.

deciding whether an audio file exists to sit under a picture, to be a song, to be a spoken programme, or to be an inventory component, when the filename is a device default and the metadata is generic
deciding whether a described sound in a prose note is a spotting request, a client comment on a delivered mix, or a line of a screenplay's action description
deciding whether a run of same-stem takes is foley, ADR, a music overdub or a rehearsal, when no track-name vocabulary survives in the filenames

deciding whether a self-recorded library file was made for a specific job, harvested from one, or recorded speculatively - the three are indistinguishable in the bytes and only the surrounding corpus can suggest it
deciding whether a full-length export is a mix, a stem, an M&E or a reference bounce when the departmental token is abbreviated, missing or in another language
deciding whether raw production dialogue contains private speech recorded between takes, which governs handling before any transcript is contemplated
distinguishing a deliberate reusable library from a download-session pile when both contain fonts, textures, mockups and licence PDFs
deciding whether descriptive keywords are collection metadata or merely words in filenames; tags are not licensed creative facts in this placeholder
separating a reusable template from the project created from it when both retain the vendor preview and similar names
deciding whether an asset embedded in one project remains independently governed or is merely a project dependency
reconciling a licence that covers a bundle with member files whose names do not carry the product identifier

Whether a packet offers a WORK or a PERSON. A gallery submission and a design-job application both contain a CV, a covering letter and a portfolio PDF. Only the letter's ask separates them, and it must be read, not guessed from the filename.

Whether an enclosed sample is a MEMBER of this packet or the standing portfolio artefact that lives with career and was merely attached. The same bytes can be both across time, and the row must not re-file the standing copy.

Whether a set of statement, bio, CV and image list is one submission or the reusable master apparatus from which many submissions are cut - 00's shared-material problem, where 'A transcript may be part of several application packets; a resume may support multiple recruiting processes'.

Whether an inbound declination refers to this offered work, to a different work sent to the same market, to a job application, or to an unrelated commercial refusal. Rejection prose is nearly identical across all four.

Whether an acceptance has ENDED this situation - a signed offer of representation, a contributor agreement or a schedule turns the world into an engagement or a published title, and the packet becomes historical rather than active.

Whether a folder of format-incoherent files is one submission or one afternoon of downloading market guidelines, which 00 forbids treating as proof: 'A session should never be treated as proof of topic'.

deciding whether a run of dated same-stem forms is a report SERIES (separate occasions of one production) or a version FAMILY (drafts of one document) - the single judgement this row exists to get right, and one that filename and hash evidence alone answer wrongly
deciding whether an annotated play text is a prompt copy or a reader's annotated edition, when the annotation is handwritten and reaches the extractor only through OCR

deciding whether a cued run sheet governs a staged work with characters and scenes, or a corporate or conference event with agenda items and named speakers - both carry cue tokens, times, a caller and a rehearsal

deciding whether a production's paperwork is the corpus owner's PRODUCTION (they mounted it, so all departments are present) or their ENGAGEMENT in it (they performed or designed in it, so only their department is present)

reading a departmental note on a report - "tab needs re-dressing", "understudy on from Act 2" - to judge whether it is an ordinary technical note or a health or incident record that changes the file's posture
naming the production when the folder is called `SHOW` and the members are `plot.xlsx`, `sched v4.pdf` and `book.pdf`

deciding whether two same-stem documents in two languages are a SOURCE and a TARGET (this row), two contemporaneous columns of ONE instrument executed bilingually (legal), the same person's own document maintained in two languages (career, academic), or a market ADAPTATION that shares a campaign stem (creative.ad-campaign). The observation is identical in all four; only the surrounding purpose separates them, and 00 puts exactly this class of file in the model's hands - "the product uses the LLM where it provides genuine value—interpreting natural language, vague documents, multilingual content, and purpose-based groups"
judging whether a bilingual two-column table is a translation working file or a language-learning study sheet, when the governance columns are absent and both are simply two columns of paired text

reading a foreign-language document that carries NO bilingual partner in the corpus and deciding whether it is a delivered target with the source held elsewhere, an original work by a bilingual maker, or reading material. This is the commonest ambiguity in the world and the honest answer is usually Review Later
deciding whether a translation memory belongs to a client, to a subject field, or to the practice as a whole - a question about the maker's business, not about the file
recognising a relay or pivot translation, where the same file is the TARGET of one job and the SOURCE of the next, so that any single-direction reading of the pair is half wrong

separating a certified translation packet (this row, plus a protective posture) from a plain copy of somebody's identity document that happens to have a foreign-language original (identity, and this row must not activate at all)
deciding whether a research document is discovery for an interface, market research, academic research, or a general product strategy record when the title is broad
matching an unlabelled screenshot, board, or prototype link to a product and lifecycle stage when the file contains only screen copy and no project identifier
deciding whether a Figma, Sketch, XD, Framer, or presentation artifact is a working prototype, a static presentation, a portfolio case study, a downloaded template, or a handoff copy
distinguishing usability evidence from stakeholder preference: a participant task, observed outcome, and cited interface state are stronger than a comment saying that a screen feels confusing
deciding whether a component library is the product team's governed design system or a stock asset library, based on variants, usage rules, ownership, and links to product screens
separating a product requirement from a general software ticket when the ticket mentions a page or button but has no user problem, flow, screen reference, or acceptance evidence

deciding whether an approved screen is approved for research, visual direction, engineering implementation, or release; the lifecycle event must remain unknown when the approver and artifact are not identified

whether an embedded-firmware package is principally a repository/code artifact, a released configuration component of a physical product, or legally both

whether a test report was written to close a means-of-compliance item against a published code paragraph, or to verify an internally authored requirement, when the trace is prose rather than a labelled column

whether an audit report concerns approval of an organisation and its procedures or approval of a product and its design
whether a document citing an airworthiness code paragraph is compliance evidence, a received copy of the code itself, or a legal or insurance argument that merely cites it
whether a manual or instruction set is an approved part of the type design or an internal working procedure that happens to describe the same task

whether a mesh file is a manufacturable definition of a designed item, a supplier catalogue component, a downloaded object to print, or a render asset, when the only evidence is triangles and a filename
whether a native container is a design item's own geometry or a purchased component imported into the corpus from a vendor catalogue
whether a surface or master model is form exploration owned by industrial design or the controlled geometry a downstream assembly and drawing derive from
whether a `.dwg` is a two-dimensional released sheet or a three-dimensional solid model saved in the same vendor container
whether a parametric script that emits geometry is principally a repository artifact, a design definition, or legally both
whether a defeatured, meshed idealisation belongs to the model it was derived from or to the analysis study that created it

whether the object of a disposition is the released definition (all future units) or one produced quantity (a lot, a serial range, material on hand) — engineering change versus nonconformance disposition, when both use the same use-as-is / rework / scrap vocabulary
whether a change order amends a contract's price, scope and dates or a design's definition, when one document carries both a commercial and a technical section
whether minutes carrying a change agenda actually record dispositions on identified items, or only attendance, discussion and actions
whether a supplier's product-change notification has been adopted as an internal change or is only correspondence received and filed
whether a marked-up print is change evidence or a personal annotation on a reading copy
whether an unnumbered draft was ever dispositioned, when the file carries the form structure and none of the decision slots are filled
whether a `revision` word in prose means a design revision, a document edit, a code commit or a contract amendment
whether a calculation justifies a real fixed work, is a worked example in teaching material, is a software validation case, or is an estimator's sizing check made to price a job

whether a drawing is design information belonging here or an issue/transmittal record belonging to construction_property.drawings-revisions, when the same sheet carries both a detail and a revision cloud
whether a steel drawing full of marks is a design connection detail or a fabricator's shop drawing produced under a works order
whether a geotechnical PDF reports findings, adopts design parameters, or does both in one document — the common case, and the reason this row and site-survey may both hold it
whether an assessment concerns a new designed work, an existing asset under a maintenance regime, or a defect dispute
whether a workbook's code references are the authority for its results or merely a reading list
whether a structure is being designed as a reusable product (a modular unit, a crane, a mast type) or as a one-off fixed work at a place

whether a signed completion-shaped certificate transfers an ENGINEERED SYSTEM to an operator or closes a BUILDING CONTRACT at a property - the surrounding evidence is a tag and test results in one case and contract parties and a contract sum in the other, and the certificate itself often shows both

whether a functional test proves the design (verification against a requirement identifier) or proves the installation (acceptance of a located instance against its design definition), when the traceability is prose rather than labelled slots
whether an as-built markup is the FINAL reconciled record for a handover or one issue in a controlled revision sequence still under change control
whether a spreadsheet of equipment is a handover asset schedule, an operator's live asset register, a procurement list or a spares order
whether 'commissioning' names the technical proving of a plant, a domestic appliance safety record, an artistic commission, or the funding of a piece of work
whether a punch or defect list belongs to acceptance of a delivered installation or to warranty-period failures already in the operator's hands
whether a title-blocked sheet controls a reusable designed item or is contract information for one site or premises, when the block names a project but no item and no parts list exists
whether a tabular list keyed to a drawing is an associated list at that drawing's revision or an authoritative product-structure bill of materials, when the indenture columns are absent or ambiguous
whether a revision designator is a released-issue letter under change control or an informal draft counter someone typed into a filename
whether a sheet carrying feature control frames is the controlled drawing, a ballooned reference copy inside an inspection record, or a page of a published tolerancing standard

whether a schematic or board sheet set belongs to this row's title-block situation or to the electrical-schematic and pcb-layout rows, when the only structural difference is the content of the drawing frame
whether a scanned or photographed sheet is a controlled issue or a marked-up working print someone drew on
whether a release directory is the holder's own controlled release or a vendor update the holder merely downloaded for a device they own
whether a .bin, .img or .fw member is an executable image, a filesystem image, a configuration or settings backup exported from a device, or a data blob that merely shares the extension
whether a version string names the firmware, the hardware revision, the bootloader, the mobile companion app, or the release tooling, when the manifest labels are ambiguous
whether a test report verifies a firmware requirement on target hardware, validates end-user behaviour, or records a production programming step
whether a compatibility statement is an authored engineering effectivity or marketing copy on a support page capture
whether an image is a component of a controlled physical product baseline, a repository build artifact, or legally both - the question the engineering schema row already flags as an LLM case
whether a colour-standard token governs a moulded or finished part surface (this row) or printed artwork on a substrate (graphic design and print production)
whether an image set is a concurrent option set awaiting downselect or a sequential revision chain in which the last member supersedes
whether a photoreal render is an appearance decision record for an unreleased item, a marketing or launch asset, or an architectural or interior visualisation

whether a grip, reach or comfort study is appearance-and-form human-factors evidence for an identified design item, generalizable research, or product-discovery user research with no design item at all
whether a surface model is the appearance definition or the released engineering geometry, when the same container holds both
whether a board of reference imagery belongs to an accepted project as a design input or is saved visual inspiration with no project relationship
whether an appearance approval was issued by the design authority establishing the standard or by a supplier submitting production parts against it

whether a technical write-up is an invention disclosure, a design rationale for a controlled item, a research result, or a process-improvement write-up that its author never intended as an invention record
whether a patent document on disk is the holder's own filing, a cited reference the holder submitted, or a third-party patent downloaded to read
whether a dated and witnessed notebook page is being kept as conception evidence for a specific invention or is ordinary laboratory record-keeping
whether a drawing set is a patent figure set or a controlled engineering drawing set when the sheets have been exported without their frames
whether a source listing is repository content, an appendix filed with an application, or both
whether an email thread about deferring a publication concerns an invention filing or an unrelated embargo

whether a document specifies a material/process (this row) or specifies what a system must do and how conformance will be shown (engineering.requirements-specification), when the same 'shall' language and the same verification-method column serve both

whether a received PDF is a published standard or code issued by a standards body or regulator (engineering.standards-library) or the specification of one product or material issued by its producer (this row), when only a cover page is legible
whether a properties table is a specification's acceptance limits or a certificate's measured results, when the document reports both a limit column and an actual column
whether a supplier datasheet is being held as a live procurement control or as background reading with no accepted engineering association
whether a coating or material study is normative (fixes what shall be used) or investigative (asks what happens), when a report contains both a recommendation and an experiment
whether an approved-materials list is engineering governance over specifications or a purchasing/stock catalogue whose codes merely resemble specification identifiers
whether a layer-named file set is a board fabrication release or a plotting, printing or garment-cutting export from a different tool family that also speaks in layers and coordinates
whether a parts table beside a placement table is the layout's own release BOM, an assembly house's procurement list, or a costing sheet
whether a .brd, .pcb or .net file is a board layout, an older or unrelated CAD/plotting format reusing the same suffix, or a text file that merely shares the extension
whether a board release belongs to a product design item, or to a one-off test coupon or evaluation board whose object is knowledge rather than a product
whether an assembled-board photograph documents a prototype build, an inspection finding, or nothing filable at all
whether a stackup and impedance document is this board's design definition or a fabricator's capability datasheet held as reference material
whether a firmware image sitting in the same release folder is a repository artifact, a controlled component of the board's released configuration, or both
whether a schematic of pumps, valves and pipework is process apparatus for a plant or building services distribution for one property
whether an equipment list is the design register of tagged items for a unit, an as-installed asset register, a procurement enquiry list or a spare-parts holding
whether a marked-up drawing records a design change to the definition or a field correction captured during commissioning
whether a heat-and-material balance is a design deliverable bound to flowsheet stream numbers or the reported output of a simulation run whose object is the run itself
whether a control narrative describes intended plant behaviour as design definition or documents an implemented controller configuration held in a repository
whether a pilot-plant or bench dataset supports a process design decision for a specific plant or is knowledge-producing research about the chemistry
whether a hazard study is a design-stage study of a proposed plant or a periodic revalidation of an operating one
whether an issued certificate's certified object is a product placed on a market, an organisation's management system, a measuring instrument, a consignment, a premises, or a person's competence
whether a test report's acceptance criteria are an external rule's clauses or the project's own requirements, when the trace is prose rather than a labelled column
whether a clause checklist is closing a conformity assessment that ends at issue or feeding a continuing operating approval
whether the phrase certificate of conformity denotes a product-regulatory instrument or a document travelling with a shipment or a production lot
whether a declaration is the maker's own conformity claim for the finished product or a supplier's incoming declaration held as material-content evidence
whether a marketing model designation and an internal item number in the same file refer to the same design item

whether a departure from the definition is a prototype deviation that will be designed out, a change that should become an engineering change order, or a manufacturing nonconformance requiring a QMS disposition, when the record states the difference in prose rather than in a labelled disposition slot

whether a build sheet records a one-off article built to an unreleased definition or a serialised unit of released production, when the record carries a serial but no revision status and no acceptance limits
whether a machine program is a job that was actually run against an owned design or a job prepared from a downloaded third-party model that was never made
whether a witnessed dated notebook page records build steps and observed behaviour, records conception of an invention, or records a research protocol run
whether a photograph of a machine, a bench or a part is build evidence, an appearance-model record, a maintenance record, or an unrelated snapshot
whether a rework list on a board is prototype bring-up or field repair of a shipped unit

whether a scored table's scored objects are technical failure modes of an item or process step, or organisational exposures of a company — the column names are frequently identical and only the objects in the rows discriminate

whether a document analysing failures is prospective (hypothesised, not yet occurred) or retrospective (an investigation of an occurrence), when neither an occurrence identifier nor a hypothetical framing is in a labelled slot
whether a workshop's unlabelled minutes record a failure-and-hazard analysis session or an ordinary design review, when no worksheet rows were transcribed into the file
whether a document titled with a method name is an analysis OF something or a procedure describing HOW the organisation performs that method — the latter is a management-system document
whether a guide-word worksheet's subject is a designed system being defined or a specific installed plant governed by a contract
whether an analysis's detection-control column is merely citing a verification activity or whether the file is in fact the verification report itself

whether a report's computed answer is a prediction about a designed item's behaviour or a code-compliance verdict for a fixed work, when the demand-versus-capacity language is identical and only the cited authority differs
whether a spreadsheet titled as a study is a numerical simulation post-process, a statistical capability study on measured parts, a financial scenario run, or a research parameter sweep

whether a three-dimensional container is an as-designed definition, a defeatured analysis idealisation of the same item, or a rendering asset, when the exchange format is shared and the stem is shared
whether a case or run directory is principally a repository artifact under source control or a simulation case whose dictionaries happen to be text
whether a physics-solver run supports a design decision, a failure investigation, a research claim, or a visual effect
whether an unlabelled contour or streamline image is a post-processed result of a study present in the corpus, a screenshot of somebody else's, or an illustration copied from a standard or a paper

whether a review gates the technical maturity of a designed item (this row) or the budget, benefits and change-readiness of a programme (business_operations.project-delivery) when both packs use the same criteria-table shape
whether a heading reading Design Review marks a recorded formal review with criteria and a disposition, or an informal team walkthrough whose minutes are ordinary meeting notes
whether an action register belongs to one review event or is the programme's standing action log carried forward across many meetings
whether a decision approving a set of engineering changes is a gate disposition, a change-board disposition on affected items and revisions, or genuinely both
whether a pass/fail summary table inside a pack is verification evidence in its own right or a citation of a verification report that lives elsewhere
whether a go/no-go on a research programme turns on design maturity of a defined item or on whether a scientific question was answered

whether a normative document is a published consensus standard (this row), a producer's product or material specification (engineering.material-specification), or the holder's own internal specification, when only a cover page or a scanned first page is legible
whether a national annex, country deviation sheet or adoption notice is a separate library member with its own designation or a bound appendix of the base standard
whether the word 'code' denotes a design or building code, a source-code repository, or a body of law
whether a design manual, handbook or data compilation is a normative document held for compliance or a textbook held for reading (research.reading-library)
whether a document that quotes clause text at length is the standard itself, a compliance checklist written against it, or a training deck about it
whether a regulator-issued code is being held as an engineering reference or as a legal instrument in a matter

whether a pass/fail table verifies a design requirement, inspects a manufactured unit against a drawing, accepts an installed instance at a site, or reports a research experiment, when the trace links are prose rather than labelled slots
whether a document titled validation validates a product against a user need, qualifies a production process, or validates a computer system
whether a protocol is a reusable standing method held for future use or the record of one executed run
whether an analysis report is verification-by-analysis evidence closing a named requirement or an exploratory design study with no requirement in view
whether a document on a laboratory's letterhead is test evidence, a calibration certificate for an instrument, or a certificate of conformity
whether a test summary inside a design review deck is the verification evidence itself or a governance summary of evidence held elsewhere

readings: an unlabelled prose letter from an institution whose subject is an account action - a closure notice, a rate change, an overdraft warning - with no labelled slot anywhere. 00 lists 'unlabeled forms' among the reasons rules alone are insufficient, and permits the model to judge whether a document 'appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain'.

an OCR'd screenshot: deciding it shows a banking or payment portal, or a receipt, rather than a generic image. 00 names this exact ambiguity: a PNG 'may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure', and the parallel worked case is an admissions screenshot returned to its group rather than filed as an image.

a spreadsheet with no title, no header row, and columns of bare numbers: whether it is a personal ledger at all. 00 names 'a spreadsheet with unclear purpose' among the material that reaches residual review, and 'a spreadsheet with unclear purpose' is a needs_llm case before it is a residual one.

whether a heterogeneous set of documents is purpose-coherent as one tax-year filing packet or one loan application packet - the group-coherence question, answered from a dossier with citations, never a free-form filing decision.

a multilingual or non-domestic institution's record whose document-kind term has no gazetteer entry and no labelled slot; 00 names 'multilingual documents' among the cases fixed patterns cannot capture.

an unlabeled founder-maintained spreadsheet with names, security labels, quantities, percentages, and several calculation tabs but no capitalization heading: deciding whether it is a cap table, a scenario model, a shareholder contact list, or an ordinary finance model. The model receives only a compact evidence packet and must cite the workbook structure.

an OCR'd dashboard screenshot: deciding whether the screen is an issuer or employee equity portal, a brokerage portfolio, a crypto exchange, a fundraising calculator, or an article about stock. OCR content, not PNG format or missing EXIF, must resolve the question.

a mixed legal closing set containing board consents, SAFEs or purchase agreements, side letters, charter amendments, signature pages, and a cap-table snapshot: deciding which members form one financing or issuance packet and which are unrelated corporate records. Group coherence is reviewable; no member gains another member's facts.

a platform-generated or appraiser-authored report where the producer name is prominent and the underlying security issuer appears only in prose or a table. Language interpretation may resolve the organization roles, but a model must return unknown when it cannot cite the subject-company evidence.

an unusual, multilingual, or non-U.S. share register, option certificate, warrant, convertible instrument, or valuation report whose field labels are not in the proposed context terms. This is language interpretation, never licence to create a jurisdiction field or jurisdiction-specific schema.

an email saying that equity is ready, changed, vested, or cancelled but omitting a labelled instrument summary. The model may decide whether it is a durable equity record or only a portal notification; the sender domain and the word equity alone remain possible clues.

a valuation deck or investor update that mentions enterprise value, common stock, dilution, and share classes: deciding whether it is the company's formal valuation record, a fundraising presentation, or commentary about another company. A model cannot promote a cited number into a Finance fact because no canonical amount or valuation field exists here.

an unlabelled prose notice from a venue about an account action - a delisting, a network migration, an account-restriction or a withdrawal-freeze letter - with no labelled period, account or transaction slot. 00 lists "unlabeled forms" and "unusual professional artifacts" among the reasons rules alone are insufficient, and scopes the call: "an LLM receives only compact evidence packets for files or groups that remain ambiguous, have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation."

an OCR'd screenshot of a wallet or exchange app: deciding from the OCR CONTENT that it shows an account or transfer record rather than a generic capture. 00 names the ambiguity for exactly this class of image - a PNG "may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure" - and the format never decides it.

whether an export carrying no venue string belongs to an accepted account series, is a second venue, or is not this situation at all. That is the group-coherence question, answered from a dossier with citations: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

separating this situation from a blockchain software project. A repository can contain an addresses file, a token configuration and a transaction fixture that read exactly like holdings evidence; 00's own instruction is structural rather than semantic - "Code-related files should rely heavily on local structural evidence, including repository roots and package files, rather than forcing semantic analysis to infer a project from arbitrary code text" - so the model is asked only where the structural markers are absent or contradictory.

a spreadsheet with no header row and columns of asset-shaped tokens and bare numbers: whether it is a personal holdings sheet at all. 00 names "a spreadsheet with unclear purpose" among the material that reaches residual review, and it is a needs_llm case before it is a residual one.

a multilingual or non-domestic venue's record whose document-kind term has no gazetteer entry and whose slots are unlabelled; 00 names "multilingual documents" among the cases fixed patterns cannot capture.

a document that discusses an asset rather than reporting a holding - a research note, a whitepaper, a pitch deck. 00's ranking discipline applies rather than first-match acceptance: "It should rank candidate matches instead of accepting the first match".

whether a management agent, law office, accountant, reserve consultant or portal provider authored a record for an association or is itself the institution the record belongs to. The model resolves labelled roles from bounded regions and must leave institution unknown when the association relationship is only implied

whether prose called rules, declaration, policy, resolution or notice is an operative association record, a generic template, a buyer guide, a news article or a different organization's governance document. The model may interpret the role-bearing clauses but cannot invent that the holder is a member

an OCR-damaged assessment statement, architectural decision or violation notice whose association, management agent, unit and mailing-address roles are partially merged. The model may use layout and nearby labels, but must abstain rather than promote the most frequent organization or address

whether a property identifier is the member's unit or lot, the association's mailing address, a manager's office, a utility service address or a property mentioned in a board discussion. The labelled role decides; a repeated address does not

whether a heterogeneous download is one association relationship, one annual meeting packet, one special-assessment project, one architectural application or one enforcement matter. The model receives a bounded dossier with direct anchors, sparse candidates and conflicts; 00 requires that 'A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.'

whether a manager email is a durable association record, ordinary community news, a maintenance conversation, a solicitation or correspondence in a contested matter. Sender domain and an association signature block support review but never settle the file's function alone

whether a reserve or budget workbook is an association-issued member record or the holder's own bookkeeping work. Repeated vendor names and money columns are shared; the reporting-entity and governance context must be resolved

a multilingual or unfamiliar common-interest-community record whose local terms for association, assessment, meeting, governing instrument or unit have no catalogue entry. The model may map observed structure to record_type, but it cannot import a jurisdiction's legal conclusion

whether a contractor invoice or store receipt is evidence of one property improvement rather than an ordinary household purchase. Explicit service-address or job-reference text may settle it; otherwise an accepted improvement packet can support reviewable membership but cannot write a property or business-use fact onto the receipt

an OCR’d deed, title plan, survey, inspection or compliance certificate whose labelled slots are partly lost. The model may interpret the document kind from bounded regions, but it must return unknown when it cannot separate the subject property from an issuer, mailing or neighbouring address

whether a condition report is a tenancy inventory, a sale listing, an insurance-loss schedule or a generic home-inspection checklist. Room names and photographs occur in all four; the role-bearing heading, issuer and completed report structure decide

whether a heterogeneous group is one acquisition, sale, tenancy or improvement packet. The model receives direct anchors, context-supported members and conflicts, and may propose membership only with citations

whether a prose contractor letter, property-manager email or warranty denial is part of a property lifecycle when it lacks a labelled form structure. A person name, address or money figure alone cannot settle the relationship

a multilingual or unfamiliar registry, tax, inspection or permit record whose document-kind labels are not present in the local term catalogue. The model may map the observed structure to record_type, but cannot invent a jurisdiction rule or property field

whether a damage photograph or contractor-portal screenshot joins a repair packet. Capture evidence activates Photos independently; the property association remains a reviewable group membership unless the file’s own OCR carries the necessary property-and-work structure

which of the three organization names on a certificate is the carrier, which is the named insured and which is the certificate holder, when the layout is unusual, the OCR is noisy, or the broker's own letterhead sits above all three. This is the template's defining model question and it is a role question, not a topic question - 00's ground for it: 'The system must separate roles that happen to contain the same entity type.'

whether a policy document belongs to the firm or to a person at the firm. An owner-operator's vehicle, a home office, or a sole trader's professional liability sits on the seam, and the named-insured token is sometimes a personal name doing business under a trade name. 00 lists 'unlabeled forms' among the reasons rules alone are insufficient.

whether a heterogeneous set of documents is purpose-coherent as ONE renewal submission or ONE claim file - 00's own shape, 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent' - answered from a bounded dossier with citations, never as a free-form filing decision.

unlabelled prose correspondence from a carrier or a broker whose subject is a coverage action: a reservation-of-rights letter, a non-renewal notice, a coverage-position letter, a subrogation demand. These carry an organization name, a policy number in the reference line and no labelled slot anywhere else.

an OCR'd screenshot: deciding it shows a broker portal or a carrier's policy list rather than a generic image. 00 names this exact ambiguity - a PNG 'may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure'.

a multilingual or non-domestic policy whose coverage-line term and form conventions have no catalogue entry; 00 names 'multilingual documents' among the cases fixed patterns cannot capture, and R5 ships one jurisdiction's values.

deciding the HOLDER ROLE when identical bytes may sit with the landlord, the tenant, an applicant, an advocate, a repairs contractor, a managing agent, a leaseholder, or a regulator; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved

separating a SOCIAL landlord's tenancy file from a private landlord's or agent's file when the agreement furniture is nearly identical and the tenancy-type and rent-setting language is the only discriminator

deciding whether a public body's housing material is landlord-side operation or authority-side administration of a housing programme, a committee cycle, a planning case, or a grant — the same department can hold all of them

distinguishing a household's hardship record held for a HOUSING duty from the same household's record held for a social-care, benefits, or safeguarding function by another office
deciding whether a repairs or compliance document is the landlord's stock record or the attending trade's own job file when both name the same dwelling and the same defect

reading a mixed sign-up or re-let packet in which agreement, offer, inventory, compliance certificate, benefit form, and identity copies travel together and each member retains its own schema evidence

distinguishing a live response's situation report from an after-action or archival copy retained for reading or teaching
reading non-English and mixed-language partner reporting, national counterpart correspondence and field forms whose labelled role vocabulary is not covered by structural rules
abstaining whenever an authority-side or partner-side role cannot be cited from the evidence: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding the HOLDER ROLE when identical bytes may sit with the legislature, a member's office, a submitting witness, a lobbying or advocacy organisation, a government department preparing a response, a journalist, a law firm, or a citizen reader; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved

separating a legislature from a body that borrows its furniture: a company or charity board, a standards committee, a union conference, a student union council, a professional association's general meeting, or a model-parliament classroom exercise

reading a municipal or devolved body that is administratively one organisation but acts in two capacities — legislative when it enacts an ordinance or by-law by reading and roll call, administrative when it delivers a service

abstaining whenever the chamber apparatus is absent: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding whether a condition note attached to an image is an object condition report or a photographer's or shipper's damage note

deciding whether a collections policy or board paper is the keeping institution's collections governance (this row) or its general charity or corporate governance (nonprofit.governance, business_operations)
reading a scanned or handwritten catalogue card through OCR well enough to see register structure rather than merely seeing an old card
separating an institution's custody records from a private collector's inventory when both list objects, makers, dates, and values

deciding the ESTATE-CUSTODY ROLE when identical bytes may sit with the managing public body, a conservation charity or trust, a private estate owner, a contractor, a concessionaire, a tenant farmer, a campaigner, a researcher, or a visitor; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved

separating a public land-managing body from a conservation charity, national trust, community land trust, commercial forestry or leisure operator, or a parks-branded contractor when the branding, plan structure, and statutory vocabulary are nearly identical

deciding whether a plan-shaped document is an operative management plan for a held parcel or a consultation draft, a research thesis about the site, an advocacy report, or a reading copy of another body's plan
recognizing an unlabeled compartment prescription, warden narrative, condition-assessment rationale, or works specification whose function is expressed only in prose

deciding whether a permit, consent, or licence file is estate-side (the land manager granting use of its own parcel) or regulator-side (a licensing authority deciding a third party's application), when both carry an authority block, a case reference, and reasons
judging whether a coordinate-bearing table or geospatial layer discloses a protected feature location, and abstaining from any remote processing when it might
abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite estate-side custody of a specific place; “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding the HOLDER ROLE where a permit, licence, conditions schedule, inspection report or enforcement notice exists in two custodies with the SAME reference on both copies; the reference discriminates nothing and the interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier

separating a CONTINUING PERMISSION from a one-off administrative determination when both are called a decision - a consent that is spent when the works are built is not this row even when the authority is the same office
separating a public-realm or activity licence from an approval of building works when the same authority, the same site address and the same reference shape appear on both
recognizing an unlabeled officer report, suitability note, review recommendation or hearing minute whose function is expressed only in prose
deciding whether a representations bundle is a licensing consultation or ordinary complaint correspondence with a public office
deciding whether a permission-referenced return or sample result is licensing compliance or the post-determination monitoring stream that belongs to a neighbouring row

abstaining when custody, permission-continuity or authority status cannot be cited: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.” and “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”

deciding whether an unlabelled prose document is a design-and-access, heritage, planning or marketing statement written to support a specific land-use proposal, or a generic development brochure about the same site: "It must return unknown where support is insufficient."

deciding whether a site plan showing a boundary on an ordnance base is a planning red-line application plan or a land-ownership title plan, when the title number and the application reference are both absent from the visible text
reading a photographed or OCR'd notice, portal screen or committee slide to judge whether it shows a determination case or an unrelated council service

judging whether a numbered condition named in a later file refers to a planning consent, a building-regulations approval, an environmental permit or a contract clause, when only the bare number is written
identifying that a heterogeneous packet is purpose-coherent for one land-use proposal: "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent."
distinguishing a policy-making document about where development should go from a determination document about whether this development may happen here

deciding whether an option-set paper is authority-side policy appraisal or a corporate, consultancy, campaigning or academic options paper with the same furniture; the discriminator is the appraisal CRITERIA (public value, statutory objective, distributional effect) plus an authority-side sign-off, not the presence of numbered options

recognising an UNLABELLED options paper — a prose submission that argues three courses of action and recommends one without ever numbering them, or a briefing whose option structure exists only in its argument

separating the department's own product from the proceeding it feeds: a government response to a committee report, a response-to-comments in a rulemaking docket, and a consultation response analysis are each produced by this corpus and filed by a sibling once they enter that proceeding; custody and the anchoring identifier decide

deciding whether a co-operation instrument is an intergovernmental arrangement between administrative bodies (this row), a treaty or state-to-state instrument, an international programme agreement, or an ordinary commercial contract with a public counterparty

distinguishing a draft that has not been released from a published final when the two differ only by a watermark, a status legend, a redaction, or a version token — and abstaining when release state cannot be evidenced

judging whether an evidence review or literature synthesis was produced or commissioned for a live policy question, or is reading material collected around a topic; a commissioning statement, a terms-of-reference reference, or an appraisal that cites it are the evidence
interpreting appraisal and submission structures in languages and administrative traditions whose labelled section vocabulary the deterministic rules do not cover
abstaining whenever the evidence names a topic but no authority-side producer and no appraisal structure; “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding the HOLDER ROLE when identical bytes may sit with the regulator, the registrant, the registrant's employer, a complainant, a representative, a journalist, or a researcher. A renewal notice, a certificate, and a published determination are the same bytes on all of those disks

separating a STATUTORY regulator from a voluntary membership association, a private certifying body, or a trade institute when both publish a register, issue registration numbers, run renewals, maintain a code of conduct, and expel members for misconduct. distinguishing regulation of a NAMED PERSON from permission granted to a business, premises, installation, vehicle, or activity when both use grant, refuse, vary, suspend, revoke, inspection, and enforcement vocabulary
recognising an unlabelled triage rationale, case note, investigator narrative, or registration-assessment reasoning that expresses its function only in prose
deciding whether a document about a registrant's health is regulator-held case evidence or that person's own medical record, and abstaining when custody is unresolved
deciding whether an inspection or standards report about a PROGRAMME or INSTITUTION is professional-entry accreditation or person-level regulation, when the same standards vocabulary appears in both

deciding the HOLDER ROLE when identical bytes sit with the inviting authority, a respondent organisation, a campaign that coordinated the responses, a consultancy engaged to analyse them, a supervising department, a journalist, or a citizen reader; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved

separating a public consultation from a body that borrows its furniture: a company's customer-satisfaction or user-research survey, a membership association's ballot on rule changes, a standards body's public review of a draft standard, an employer's staff engagement exercise, a landlord's tenant survey, and a university's course-feedback round all publish a question set and collect free-text answers

separating THIS row's discretionary invitation-and-outcome exercise from a comment period that is a legally structured stage of a neighbouring proceeding — a rulemaking docket, a planning application's neighbour representations, a committee call for written evidence — where the shared identifier belongs to that proceeding rather than to a consultation of its own

judging whether a near-identical text cluster is a campaign of independent submissions or an ordinary duplicate family, which changes both the grouping outcome and whether the members may be summarised together

judging whether an analysis document reports what respondents said or decides what the authority will do; the second is the neighbouring policy or rulemaking world even when it cites the same reference

deciding the HOLDER ROLE when identical bytes may sit with the notifying clinician, the reference laboratory, the public-health authority, the inspected premises, an employer, a school, a journalist, an epidemiological researcher, or the named person; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved

separating a public-health authority from a hospital infection-prevention team, an occupational-health provider, a health charity, an accreditor, a professional college, or a commercial laboratory when clinical and statutory vocabulary is identical on both sides

deciding the OPERATING MODE for material that is genuinely both surveillance and emergency response: a standing programme with a reporting cycle versus a declared activation with operational periods and situation reports
recognizing an unlabelled outbreak narrative, cluster summary, health-protection duty-log entry, or investigation note whose function is expressed only in prose with no form furniture

judging the AGGREGATION STATE of a table — identifiable, pseudonymised, or aggregate — from column semantics rather than from the file's own claim about itself, and abstaining rather than concluding that a pseudonymised line list is anonymous

deciding whether a mixed folder is authority-side programme administration or a recipient-side collection of appointment letters, vaccination records, screening invitations, and result notices belonging to one person or household
interpreting multilingual notification forms, screening invitations, and public-health notices whose labelled role vocabulary is not covered by deterministic structure rules
abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite an authority-side population-health role; “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding DIRECTION OF CUSTODY when the tender reference, the specification text and the deadline appear identically on the authority's copy and the bidder's copy; only the surrounding population — one response versus many, receipt register versus submission confirmation, approval block versus internal bid/no-bid note — settles it, and it must be settled from a bounded local dossier

separating a regulated public competition from a private organisation's RFP that has copied the same furniture (timetable, weighted criteria, clarification window) but has no notice, no procedure name, no publication and no standstill

separating a purchase from a grant where the call, the received submissions and the scoresheet are structurally identical; the instrument at the end decides — a specification with deliverables and acceptance versus funding for the recipient's own purposes

recognizing an unlabeled internal document — a market-engagement note, a business case, a route-to-market options paper, a debrief script, a lessons-learned note — whose procurement function is expressed only in prose
deciding whether a mixed archive is one competition's file or a procurement team's whole year, and refusing to invent a competition where a forward pipeline register lists many

judging whether a body that runs a regulated competition is inside the state at all — a state-owned operator, a utility, a university, an arm's-length company and a charity buying under a funder's conditions all issue notice-shaped packs
abstaining whenever direction, instrument or body cannot be evidenced; “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

deciding WHICH SIDE holds a disclosure bundle when the released copy is byte-identical for the authority, the requester, a journalist, a campaigner, a lawyer, and a researcher; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when custody is unresolved
recognizing an unlabeled public-interest-test note, harm assessment, or exemption rationale whose function is expressed only in prose with no headed slots

separating an access-regime request from a subject-access or personal-data request in which the requester asks about themselves; the latter is a named person's own record and routes away from this row
deciding whether a redacted bundle is an authority's disclosure workflow or a legal, research, or reading packet after identifiers have been minimized
distinguishing an authority's disclosure schedule from a litigation or discovery schedule that itemises documents and withholding reasons in the same columnar shape
deciding whether a hybrid, arms-length, contracted-out, or quasi-public body is answering as a public authority at all; abstain rather than guess
judging whether an item inside a released bundle is a member of this request or merely a similar record held elsewhere in the corpus
abstaining whenever no external request workflow can be cited, however much access vocabulary is present
whether a received document is a comment ON this proposal or an unrelated piece of correspondence that merely quotes the proposal reference
whether an item is held in the body's docket custody or is the regulated party's own retained copy of the same bytes

whether a permit-shaped document is a decision on one named applicant or a rule of general application wearing permit vocabulary (a general permit or class licence)
whether an internal draft is pre-decisional working material or the published version of the same text

whether a document belongs to the consultation mechanics (question set, response form, response-analysis summary) or to the instrument chain (draft text, bound impact assessment, response-to-comments, made instrument)

whether a body that is not obviously a public authority — a delegated standards body, a self-regulatory organisation, a professional regulator — is exercising a delegated rulemaking power or acting as a private association

deciding the ADMINISTERING TIER when identical bytes may sit with the district office, one of its schools, a school the district does not operate, a state education department above it, a parent, a teacher, a union, a vendor or a journalist; interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when the tier is unresolved

deciding whether a per-school table is an operative allocation, return or roster produced BY the authority, or a published performance or spending comparison downloaded ABOUT districts for reading
deciding whether a mixed packet is authority-side administration or a household's collection of school letters, report cards, forms and consent slips that happen to name the same district

interpreting multilingual or jurisdiction-specific education-administration forms whose role vocabulary — trust, academy, board, division, authority, county office, directorate — is not covered by deterministic structure rules
