context_terms: your responses cannot be linked to you

readings: whether unlabelled prose is a personnel case narrative rather than an ordinary management note, legal advice, clinical record, or project retrospective; protected content must use a local model or explicit-consent route rather than a default cloud dossier

whether a heterogeneous packet is purpose-coherent as one joiner, leaver, review, consultation, or investigation process when its members include policy extracts, emails, meeting notes, forms, and evidence from other schemas

whether a resource plan is an establishment/headcount plan or a project delivery allocation. Posts, grades, vacancies, reporting lines, and continuing workforce capacity support HR; named work packages, milestones, and a bounded project's end support business_operations

whether a health-related document is the employer's administration of fitness, absence, adjustment, or incident duties or the individual's own clinical record. The safe response to ambiguity is protection and abstention, not copying clinical facts into HR
whether a policy-like document is the governing policy itself or an employee-specific acknowledgement or case application. The former belongs to business_operations; the latter may activate HR
whether a grade-and-range table is the holder's own operative structure or a published, market, or cited table reproduced inside a report, a recruitment advert, a vendor deck, or a news article

whether a workbook carrying both a period-cost tab and a range tab is a budget submission or a reward instrument. The deciding structure is whether the grid resolves to an approved period budget line or to a grade ladder
whether a plan-like document is the operative bonus, equity, or benefit instrument for a bounded year or the standing compensation philosophy and pay policy that governs every year
whether an individually addressed statement of pay is a member of an employer-generated batch or the individual's own employment record held in a personal corpus

whether pay-equity workings are a reward-design exercise or a workforce-analytics or statutory reporting product. Both readings are protected and abstention is the correct answer when the evidence does not decide

whether a demographic cut describes the organisation's OWN workforce or is a benchmark, market-research or peer dataset about other employers. Identical column shapes occur in both; only the population statement, employee identifiers or an internal system header settle it
whether a document is the governing equality or equal-opportunities policy, which is a business_operations record, or programme delivery and monitoring carried out under it, which is this row

whether protected-characteristic data describes employees or job APPLICANTS. Applicant-stage monitoring is a recruiting corpus; this row holds it only when the artefact is the employer's aggregate monitoring or statutory reporting instrument

whether a low-count cell is a deliberate suppression artefact or an unsuppressed re-identifying figure. Aggregation is not proof of safety here; the safe response is to protect, keep the judgement local, and abstain rather than summarise the cells

whether an inclusion or belonging measure is a demographic cut of one engagement wave, whose instrument and response file belong to the engagement-survey sibling, or a standalone monitoring instrument fielded for this programme
whether a heterogeneous packet is purpose-coherent as one reporting obligation when its members include a data extract, an analysis workbook, legal advice, a narrative draft, and a signed return

whether an unlabelled note is a case narrative or an ordinary management one-to-one, a coaching note, or a project retrospective. This is protected content: use a local model or an explicit-consent route, never a default cloud dossier

whether a performance improvement plan is a step in a formal capability procedure (procedure cited, review period, stated consequence of failure, warning-equivalent status) or an output of the annual review round, which belongs to the performance-cycle row

whether an investigation concerns employment conduct, clinical care of a named patient, or a system or event. The three produce structurally identical reports and only the subject under review separates them

whether a grievance and a disciplinary that reference each other are one case with a counter-allegation or two cases that must not be merged. The safe answer is a reviewable candidate link, not a merge

whether a consultation pack is a formal collective consultation with representatives or an internal restructuring proposal that has not yet been put to anyone, which belongs to organisation design and headcount planning
whether an occupational-health report was commissioned by the employer for an absence or capability process or is the individual's own clinical record that happens to name their employer
whether a heterogeneous packet is purpose-coherent as ONE case when its members include policy extracts, emails, rosters, recordings, and medical evidence drawn from other schemas

whether a Likert-shaped export is workforce listening or customer, market, product, event, or academic research. The cut columns decide it and they are often abbreviated; a local model must read the header semantics rather than the file name, and must not resolve the question by reading the free-text comments

whether a survey on the workforce is engagement listening or an individually attributable instrument — 360 or multi-rater feedback, a manager effectiveness review tied to one named subject, a training course evaluation tied to one session. The presence of a single named subject or a review outcome moves it off this row
whether a heterogeneous wave packet is purpose-coherent as one listening cycle when its members include vendor collateral, communications, policy extracts, a results deck and a spreadsheet of actions

whether a results narrative is this employer's own wave or a benchmark, vendor case study, industry report, or academic paper reproducing the same item wording. Item wording is shared across the whole field and is not ownership evidence

whether free-text comment content has crossed into individual employee-relations, health, or safety material that must be handled under the stricter posture even though the file as a whole is aggregate

Whether an unlabelled onboarding checklist is about an EMPLOYEE crossing the employment boundary or a CLIENT, CUSTOMER, VENDOR, TENANT, PATIENT or SOFTWARE USER being taken on. The vocabulary is identical - onboarding, welcome pack, checklist, access provisioned, kickoff, first 30 days - and only the subject of the tasks discriminates. A counterparty organisation with an engagement, KYC, credit or contract anchor is business_operations.customer-account-management or vendor-management; a natural person acquiring an employment status is this row.

Whether an induction deck is joiner-scoped delivery or a general training curriculum. A deck that exists only because someone started this week is this row; a course with modules, a completion roster spanning tenured staff, and a development framework is hr.training-development, even when its first module is titled Induction.

Whether an exit narrative is a leaver PROCESS record or an employee-relations CASE narrative. Candid criticism of named managers, a termination reason, an allegation, or a settlement discussion pulls it toward hr.employee-relations regardless of the checklist it was filed beside.

Whether a heterogeneous joiner packet is, in 00's words, "purpose-coherent despite topic diversity, which members appear to be supporting materials rather than unrelated records, and whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose." A right-to-work passport scan does conflict: it is identity's own evidence and its protection must run first.
Whether a probation or thirty/sixty/ninety-day review is the closing act of this row's process or the opening act of hr.performance-cycle. Unsettled by the design docs; see open_question NJ-ONB-3.

Whether unlabelled prose describing a first week - a personal diary, a manager's notes, a blog draft - is an employer-side process record at all. Most such prose is not, and abstention is the correct answer.

whether a resource plan is an establishment plan or a project delivery allocation. Approved posts, grades, vacancies and continuing capacity support this row; named work packages, allocation percentages, milestones and a bounded end date support business_operations.project-delivery. This is the single hardest call on the node and both rows name the same fixture

whether a boxes-and-arrows hierarchy is a workforce establishment or a legal-entity group structure. Jurisdictions, share percentages, incorporation numbers and holding relations make it a corporate record; grades, FTE and reporting lines make it a workforce record

whether a structural analysis is DESIGNING the establishment (a proposed target state is present) or REPORTING on the workforce population (a time series over an existing population). The presence of a proposed column, not the subject matter, decides it

whether a structure document is a published current-state chart or an unannounced proposal, because the second requires protection even when it names no individual at all - a distinction the hr default cannot make because it keys protection to employee-identifying content

whether a heterogeneous consultation pack is purpose-coherent as one reorganisation when its members include policy extracts, union correspondence, legal advice, spreadsheets and slide decks from several schemas

whether a sheet of names against amounts is a pay run or one of its many look-alikes: a commission or bonus schedule, a contractor payment list, an expense reimbursement batch, a grant stipend roster, a prize or honorarium list, or a donation acknowledgement run

whether a benefits document is the EMPLOYER'S administration of a plan or the individual's own policy, claim or statement. Ambiguity here resolves to protection and abstention, not to copying a plan or health fact into an employer record

whether a run is live payroll or a parallel-run, migration or year-end-rollover test extract from a payroll system. Test extracts carry real employees and real bank details and must inherit the live posture, not a lower one, whatever the filename says
whether an archive's members belong to one pay run when they split across register, ledger-journal, bank-file, statutory-filing and employee-statement roles that this row does not all own

whether the employer reading holds at all, or the corpus is a bookkeeper's or bureau's work for a CLIENT employer, where the same files are a professional engagement's deliverables rather than the custodian's own workforce record

whether unlabelled running notes are cycle-bearing check-in notes or ordinary management, project, or personal notes. Notes are usually sparse and should join an accepted group without acquiring a subject or cycle fact

whether a goals or OKR workbook's per-person tab is a performance instrument or a delivery allocation. Person-as-owner plus a review period and a rating scale supports this row; work packages, dependencies and a project end date support business_operations
whether a document titled review, evaluation, scorecard or assessment assesses a PERSON at all, rather than a business unit, product, vendor, supplier, candidate, project or piece of written work
whether an improvement plan is routine development coaching or the opening step of a formal capability or disciplinary process, which changes the owning row and raises the protection posture

which members of a review packet are subject-visible and which are moderation-only. This must be decided locally from the author-role and distribution slots; a protected packet must not be sent to a cloud model to answer it

Whether a document is the GOVERNING RULE or the TEACHING OF IT. A policy and its awareness course quote each other almost verbatim; the discriminating structure is approval, version control, scope and effective date on one side versus learning objectives, an audience, an activity and an assessment on the other. Where a single PDF contains both - a policy with a quiz stapled to the back - both may hold and neither copies the other's facts.

Whether a course is delivered to the organisation's OWN STAFF or to its CUSTOMERS. This is the whole of the absorbed soft.training-material coverage and the vocabulary is identical: onboarding, curriculum, modules, enablement, certification, completion. Only the audience discriminates, and the audience is frequently stated only in a speaker note or an invitation.

Whether an induction item is joiner-scoped delivery or a general curriculum whose first module happens to be titled Induction. hr.onboarding-offboarding has already argued this seam from its side and named the same fixture; this row accepts that framing.

Whether a heterogeneous cohort packet is, in 00's words, "purpose-coherent despite topic diversity, which members appear to be supporting materials rather than unrelated records, and whether any member conflicts with the proposed purpose." A 360-degree feedback report inside a leadership-programme pack does conflict: it is an assessment of a person and hr.performance-cycle's evidence, and its protection must run before the packet's.

Whether an exemption, deferral or adjustment marker in a completion matrix records an administrative waiver or a health, disability, pregnancy or religious circumstance. The safe response is abstention and protection; the marker is retained as a literal observation and never resolved into a reason.
Whether unlabelled prose is course content, a conference talk, a reading item, a product manual, or a consultant's deliverable. The model may abstain.

whether a headcount table measures the actual population or plans a future establishment. Approved-post, vacancy, effective-from and sign-off columns move it to hr.org-design-headcount; a closing balance reconciled from an opening balance keeps it here

whether a utilisation or capacity sheet measures a workforce population over a period or a project's delivery against its scope. Billable hours against work packages and a bounded end date are business_operations; employment status and movement over a period are this row

whether a given cut of an aggregate table is small enough to identify a person. The model must abstain and route to protection rather than assert de-identification - `00`: "It must return unknown where support is insufficient." No threshold is stated here and none may be invented

whether free text inside a metrics packet - exit-interview verbatims, survey comments, case summaries pasted into a slide - is protected member content that the packet's aggregate posture does not cover
whether a workforce dashboard describes the user's own organisation or is a vendor demonstration, benchmark, or published market study about somebody else's workforce

readings: an OCR'd photograph of a card whose text is unlabelled and partial: deciding it is an identity document rather than a generic image. 00's parallel case is the opaque capture that 'may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure' - only evidence decides which. STANDING CONSTRAINT on every entry in this list: for this domain the model path is closed by default. 00: protected material 'should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default', and PR-2 puts P7 classification before any model path, so these are local-model or explicit-consent judgements, never a cloud dossier.

whether a heterogeneous set of files is purpose-coherent as ONE immigration or visa submission rather than an admissions packet or an unrelated pile. 00 permits exactly this judgement - the model 'may identify a shared purpose across a heterogeneous packet' - and the two packet kinds share document kinds (ID, transcript, certificate, form, photo), which is why the discrimination needs language and not a pattern.

an unlabelled civil record in prose or in a foreign-language layout (a certificate whose issuing authority is stated only in running text) - 00 names 'multilingual documents' among the reasons rules alone are insufficient. Same closed-by-default constraint applies.

deciding that an image or archive is credential-bearing when nothing is labelled - a photograph of a written-down recovery phrase, a screenshot of a key. The safe outcome is abstention into protection, which 00 already licenses: 'conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification.'

an angled, cropped, damaged, multilingual or partially legible card whose OCR lacks clear labels. Every case in this list is protected before interpretation and is eligible only for a local model or a model path explicitly permitted by user policy; it is never a default cloud dossier

distinguishing a civil-status certificate retained as current identity evidence from the same certificate retained as genealogical or historical research. The file's own use and accepted group context matter, but context must not copy a holder fact onto it

distinguishing a government identity credential from a professional licence, healthcare coverage card, vehicle registration, academic credential or financial record when all carry a name, issuing organization, identifier and validity date

a screenshot of a digital identity wallet or mobile credential. OCR and visible issuer/document structure can justify protection, but a screenshot cannot establish cryptographic validity or current status

a contacts CSV or scanned directory with non-standard headings, where the model must decide whether it is an address-book export, a CRM report, an event roster or an employer directory without exposing its rows outside the permitted model boundary

a mixed archive or packet containing an identity copy beside application, onboarding, loan, family-history or immigration records. The model may judge packet membership from a bounded local dossier but may not turn the packet's purpose into an identity fact

deciding whether an unlabelled photograph or screenshot is a handwritten account-recovery secret rather than a word puzzle, quotation, language exercise or ordinary note. For this safety row, needs_llm means a local model or an explicitly authorized path after P7; raw OCR and suspected secret spans never enter a cloud dossier, and abstention remains correct.

distinguishing a manually maintained account-access inventory from a bookmarks list, signup tracker or subscription inventory when the exact R2 credential-header conjunction is absent. A local model may interpret headings and column roles, but it may not read secret values to answer the question and may not mint service, username or credential-type facts.

distinguishing a genuine saved password-reset record from generic security guidance, a phishing example, a simulated-awareness exercise or quoted documentation when native sender/subject structure and body language conflict. The model judges document role, not link safety, sender authenticity or whether a token remains valid.

judging whether a readable mixed archive manifest represents one credential backup kit or merely co-locates unrelated configuration, certificates and account records. The manifest is a candidate-set clue; the model may propose reviewable membership with citations and may not inspect or unpack protected members.

deciding whether a partially redacted export still functions as a credential store when password cells have been removed but password-manager structure, login records and recovery material remain. A redacted sample is not automatically safe, and an empty password column is not automatically a credential store.

resolving multilingual recovery or password-manager labels when structured slots are present but the local rule catalogue does not support the language. The model path remains closed to default cloud use; if no permitted local interpretation exists, the safe result is protection plus abstention.

whether a heterogeneous collection of identity copies, bank evidence, school or employer letters, photographs, forms, and notices serves one immigration application rather than an admissions, recruiting, travel, or general-records packet. The result is a reviewable group membership; it does not create purpose or any other fact on a sparse member.

a multilingual or unusually formatted authority notice whose function is stated only in prose and whose authority, decision, or requested action cannot be resolved from labelled slots. The model must cite locally extracted evidence and return unknown when the function remains ambiguous.

an OCR capture of an application portal, digital immigration status, electronic travel authorization, or case-status page: deciding whether it is an official status record, a generic travel page, an admissions portal, a payment screen, or an informational page. This is a local-model or abstention path by default; the entry is not permission to send raw OCR, identifiers, or the screenshot to a cloud model.

a letter from an adviser or lawyer discussing an application, refusal, review, or appeal without a government notice attached. It may support Identity and Legal on disjoint evidence, or it may belong only to a practitioner's matter file; a law-firm letterhead and the word visa do not settle the holder-side situation.

a school or employer document that can serve both its original administrative purpose and an immigration submission, such as an enrolment certificate or employment support letter. The model may judge packet membership from explicit submission language while retaining the school or career reading and copying no packet fact.

whether several applications are one linked family packet or separate cases when a notice names dependants, sponsors, or derivative applicants inconsistently. Shared surnames, addresses, or download sessions never merge them; the model may abstain and preserve separate protected records.

whether a request, decision, or entry record belongs to the same application lifecycle when the authority changes its reference format or the document omits the earlier reference. Semantic similarity alone cannot establish the link; conflicting applicant, authority, or permission evidence makes the file an outlier.
