readings: DECIDING THE SIDE, which in this family is the whole question and is frequently unrecoverable from the bytes. Practitioner or client; our side or the other side; counsel or opposing counsel; the firm the holder works at or the firm the holder retained. The same client-care letter, the same engagement terms and the same bundle exist on both sides and differ only in which signature block is the holder's. Interpretation may use a bounded local dossier only and must abstain when the side is unresolved: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Separating a practitioner-side matter file from the holder's OWN legal matter. This is the schema's sharpest under-firing risk and it is `legal.personal-legal-matters`' whole node from the other direction. A firm name, a caption, a matter reference and the word client are on both; the practitioner-side ANCHOR - an intake screen, an allocated matter reference belonging to the holder's own firm, a time record, work product produced by the holder - is what separates them, and a folder name never does.

Separating a legal representation from a consulting engagement. The landed neighbour already states this seam and the model must not contradict it: scope, fees, confidentiality, deliverables and two-organisation signature blocks occur on both, and only explicit counsel, representation, legal-services, tribunal or legal-work-product structure carries the legal side.

Separating the FIRM RUNNING ITSELF from the firm running a matter. A law firm's partnership accounts, its own office lease, its recruitment, its marketing, its IT asset register and its professional-indemnity renewal are business_operations, hr and finance material that happens to be produced by lawyers. The model may route here only if it can name a matter and a client; a firm name on the letterhead is the never-alone token, not the answer.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose - an attendance note, a file note of a telephone call, a strategy email in running text, a handwritten-then-scanned advice note. 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient, since real collections contain unlabelled forms and unusual professional artifacts.

Distinguishing an operative matter document from a downloaded exemplar or a study copy: a published opinion, a model form, a practice-note precedent, a law-school problem question, a bar-course sample bundle. Topic will not separate them - "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works - and this family's exemplars are unusually convincing because the profession publishes its own templates.

Deciding whether a heterogeneous bundle is ONE matter or several, when the same parties recur across a dispute, an appeal, an enforcement and a related transaction. Cross-matter bridging by party name or subject similarity is forbidden regardless of what the model concludes.

Interpreting jurisdiction-specific or multilingual professional artefacts whose labelled roles no approved pattern covers. The route is local interpretation or abstention; this row defines no jurisdiction catalogue, no court list and no legal rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension.
Abstaining whenever the matter-and-role pair cannot be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

Deciding whether an appellate brief or judgment in the corpus is THE HOLDER'S FILED COPY or a DOWNLOADED EXEMPLAR. This family's exemplars are the most convincing in the entire roster because appellate courts publish the real thing: the bytes of a filed brief and the bytes of the same brief downloaded by a stranger are identical, and the only local discriminators are a counsel block naming the holder's side, a matter reference, and record citations whose targets exist in this corpus. Topic will not separate them - "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works.

DECIDING THE SIDE, AND IT IS HARDER HERE THAN ANYWHERE ELSE IN THE FAMILY, because the roles REVERSE relative to the proceeding below: the party who won at first instance is the respondent above, the caption may or may not re-order the names, and a cross-appeal makes both parties both. The schema's abstention rule governs: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Deciding whether a document is a MEMBER OF THE RECORD AS COMPILED or merely a trial-file document of the same name. The compiled record is frozen at certification; a motion filed below in the same matter, with the same reference, is a member only if the index says so. Matter-reference grouping actively misfires here and the model must not repair it by inference.

Separating an APPEAL from a post-judgment application in the SAME court - reconsideration, rehearing, setting aside, a new trial, a stay pending appeal, an application to correct the record. These carry the decision-appealed vocabulary and the deadline pressure without ever leaving the first tier, and only the second tribunal identifier separates them.

Separating a court or tribunal appeal from an INTERNAL, ADMINISTRATIVE OR COMMERCIAL appeal - a benefits or immigration first-tier objection, a tax objection letter, a planning or licensing representation, an insurance internal review, an academic grade appeal, a platform account appeal. All are called appeals and several have a decision, a reference and a deadline; none has a two-tier judicial identifier pair or a compiled record.

Recognising UNLABELLED PRACTITIONER PROSE about an appeal: an advice on prospects written as a letter, a file note of a conference on whether to appeal, a running-text email weighing grounds. 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient, since real collections contain unlabelled forms and unusual professional artifacts.

Interpreting jurisdiction-specific and multilingual appellate structures whose labelled roles no approved pattern covers - leave versus permission, appendix versus record versus core bundle, cassation and revision systems where the tier relation is stated differently. This row defines no court list, no tier catalogue and no jurisdiction rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension.

Deciding whether two proceedings are TIERS OF ONE DISPUTE or two separate matters, when the same parties, counsel and subject recur across a dispute, an appeal, an enforcement and a related action. Bridging by party name or subject similarity is forbidden regardless of what the model concludes.

Abstaining whenever the tier pair cannot be cited from the artefact itself: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

Deciding whether an unlabelled prose first-interview note is pre-opening intake or a post-opening attendance note. The grammar is the only evidence - a note that records what the person wants, what they were told about costs, and what still has to happen before the firm can act, versus a note that reports a step taken IN an existing file.

Separating a prospective-client due-diligence pack from an employee right-to-work or contractor onboarding pack when both are ID scans plus a per-document checklist with a certifier. The structures are near-identical; the deciding slot is whether the form asks what work the person WANTS DONE FOR THEM or what work they will DO FOR THE HOLDER.
Reading a screen capture or scan of a web intake submission through OCR, where the labelled slots survive only as visual layout.
Reading an intake pack archive's manifest to judge whether its members form one intake episode, without unpacking it merely to improve classification.
Judging whether an unsolicited enquiry email from a stranger is intake material at all, when the practice never replied and no disposition exists.

WHICH SIDE THE HOLDER IS ON, and it is the interpretation this row turns on. Identical binder bytes sit in the practitioner's corpus, the client's, the counterparty's, the lender's and the broker's. Only the surrounding labelled roles decide, and where they are absent the model must return unknown and the file must go to Review Later rather than be assigned a side.

WHETHER A STATUS MATRIX IS A COMPLETION AGENDA OR A PROJECT PLAN. A responsibility-and-status table over deliverables is also the ordinary shape of `business_operations.project-delivery` and of a deal task list. The interpretive question is whether the rows are DOCUMENTS FOR EXECUTION with signatory slots, or workstreams with owners and due dates.

WHETHER AN ENUMERATED INDEX IS A CLOSING INDEX OR A DILIGENCE INDEX. A data-room index is also a sectioned, numbered table of documents. The interpretive discriminators are direction and tense: a diligence index describes documents DISCLOSED for inspection and carries access, request or Q-and-A columns; a closing index describes documents DELIVERED at an event and carries execution status. Where both readings survive, `law_practice.due-diligence` and this row are both candidates and neither writes a fact.

WHETHER SCANNED EXECUTION PAGES BELONG TO A COMPLETION SET AT ALL. OCR of a wet-ink page yields names and a date and nothing that binds it to an event. Membership needs the index or the agenda to claim it.

PURPOSE COHERENCE ACROSS A CONTENT-INCOHERENT SET, which is 00's own licence and the reason this row groups the way it does: a closing set contains board minutes, a share transfer form, a deed, a bank mandate, a solvency statement, an identity copy and a filing receipt. 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.' A content-similarity reading will split them; the completion event is what holds them.

Deciding whether an unlabelled prose memo that discusses whether the practice may act is a screening record or an internal opinion about a client's own conflict of interest - the second is `law_practice.opinions-advice` and its subject is the client's position, not the firm's ability to act.

Reading an OCR'd practice-management search screen to determine whether the visible table is a conflicts search result, a client list, a matter list or a time report, when the on-screen column headers are the only structure available.

Separating a barrier record from an ordinary IT access-permission ticket when the ticket names a matter code and a list of people but carries no screening or ethical-wall language and no effective date.

Judging, on a combined new-matter-opening form, whether the dominant labelled structure is the intake collection or the conflicts search and decision, when the form carries both and neither is decisive.

DECIDING THE SIDE, inherited from the schema and worse here because both sides circulate near-identical redlines. Buyer markup and seller markup of the same SPA differ only in which comparison header and which issues-list OWNER column match the holder's own apparatus. Where the side is unresolved the model must abstain: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Separating a practitioner-run negotiation from the holder's OWN contract being negotiated - the founder negotiating their own sale, the employee reviewing their own offer letter with counsel's redlines they received as client. The practitioner-side anchor is the schema's: an allocated matter reference belonging to the holder's firm, a time record, work product the holder produced. Absent that, this is `legal.personal-legal-matters` or career material and the row must abstain.

Separating a LEGAL negotiation from a CONSULTING or commercial markup of a statement of work. Scope, fees, confidentiality, deliverables, tracked changes and two-organisation signature blocks occur on both; explicit counsel or representation roles, a legal-services scope, a playbook with walkaway positions, or a clause-keyed issues list with side-owned legal positions carry the legal side. Where only the engagement paper exists, the honest outcome is Review Later.

Separating a LIVE negotiation draft from a KEPT precedent or a published model. Bracketed placeholders across all party positions with blank execution blocks are `law_practice.precedent-bank`'s; filled party names plus an open execution block plus comparison or issues apparatus are this row's. One leftover `[TBC]` in a schedule of an otherwise populated draft does not demote it to a precedent.

Deciding whether two instrument stems are one negotiation or two - a main agreement and its disclosure letter, an SPA and its tax deed, a master services agreement and a statement of work. Bridging by matching party names or clause text similarity is forbidden; only an exact cross-reference or user decision authorises multi-membership.
Reading unlabelled negotiation prose - a running-text summary of open points, a scanned marked-up page, a handwritten markup photographed then OCRed - where no column set exists to detect.

Abstaining whenever the instrument-stem-and-clause-apparatus pair cannot be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

WHOSE SIDE, which is the hardest reading in this row and the one that decides between someone else's transaction and the holder's own home. Byte-identical search returns, register extracts and completion statements exist on both sides of the practitioner/principal fork. The discriminator is apparatus, not content: a matter or file reference, a client ledger, a firm letterhead addressed TO a named client, a fee narrative. If the corpus shows the holder as the ADDRESSEE of everything and produces none of it, this row must not fire.

ACTING FOR THE BUYER, THE SELLER, THE LENDER OR THE LANDLORD, which changes what the same document means. A report on title flows to a buyer; replies to enquiries flow from a seller; a certificate of title flows to a lender; a licence to assign flows from a landlord. The role is usually stated in an addressee line or a heading and should be read literally or abstained on - never inferred from which documents are present.

REGISTERED TITLE VERSUS AN UNREGISTERED CHAIN. Where no register exists the anchor is an abstract or epitome of title - a numbered schedule of historic deeds with dates and parties - and the parcel leg must be satisfied by that schedule instead. This is a genuine structural variant, not a jurisdiction to be guessed at.

THE ENQUIRY-PACK VERSUS THE DILIGENCE-REPORT READING on the same words. A report on title over ONE parcel addressed to an individual purchaser is this row; a report on title over a PORTFOLIO addressed to a corporate acquirer as a chapter of a diligence exercise is `law_practice.due-diligence`'s. Same phrase, different world.

THE ARRIVED-COPY PROBLEM. A planning permission, a building-regulation completion certificate, an energy certificate, a guarantee and a gas-safety record all arrive INSIDE an enquiry pack as copies. They keep their own homes and their own schemas; they do not become this row's evidence, and their presence in a folder does not make the folder a conveyance.

WHICH SIDE OF THE RECORD THE HOLDER IS ON - the family's central ambiguity and the one that decides between this row and `business_operations.board-governance` / `business_operations.corporate-regulatory-filings`. The same minute, the same register page and the same confirmation statement exist in two custodies: the entity's own, and the provider's. Only reading for a matter, engagement, service or client framing settles it, and where it is absent the answer is Review Later, not a guess.

WHETHER A REGISTER PAGE IS THE MAINTAINED LEDGER OR A PURCHASED REGISTRY EXTRACT. Both list officers with dates. The maintained ledger carries entry AND cessation columns and unfilled future rows; the extract carries a registry retrieval stamp, a purchase or transaction reference, and a snapshot date. See the collision fixture.

WHETHER A CONSTITUTIONAL DOCUMENT IS A DRAFT, AN ADOPTED-BUT-UNSIGNED CONFORMED COPY, OR AN EXECUTED INSTRUMENT. The third is `legal`'s and `legal` runs first; the first is this row's; the second is genuinely contested and is a NEEDS-JOSEPH item.

WHETHER A MULTI-ENTITY SCHEDULE IS AN ENTITY INVENTORY OR A CAP TABLE. Both are workbooks of names, dates and percentages. Reading whether the rows are legal persons with jurisdictions or holders with instrument counts is a semantic judgement no filename supports.

WHETHER A NAMED NATURAL PERSON ON A REGISTER IS A PUBLIC OFFICER ENTRY OR A PROTECTED ADDRESS ENTRY. A register of directors' residential addresses and a beneficial-ownership register hold home addresses that the corresponding registry copy suppresses; the two look identical in structure and differ only in the column set.

DECIDING WHETHER THE ARTEFACT IS THE RECEIPT OR THE DOCUMENT, which is this row's own boundary against its siblings and is unresolvable from vocabulary. A conformed pleading is one file carrying two things: a stamp zone (this row) and a pleading body (`law_practice.pleadings`). The model must be able to say which layer it is citing, and when it cannot, the document's own body wins because the stamp is the weaker claim.

DECIDING WHICH SIDE FILED. The same notice of electronic filing reaches the filer and every other counsel of record, byte-identical apart from a recipient block. Whether the holder's firm lodged the document or merely received notice that the other side did is frequently unrecoverable, and the answer changes nothing about protection but everything about grouping. Abstain when it cannot be cited: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

SEPARATING A FILING RECEIPT FROM AN ORDINARY TRANSACTIONAL CONFIRMATION. A fee receipt, a portal payment confirmation and a courier delivery notice have the structure 00 assigns to the transactional residual. The binding to a proceeding is the only discriminator, and it is often present only as an unlabelled reference line.

SEPARATING A DOCKET EXTRACT RETRIEVED FOR AN ACTIVE MATTER FROM ONE DOWNLOADED OUT OF INTEREST. A public docket for a famous case, a docket pulled for research, and a docket pulled for the holder's own filing are the same artefact. Purpose is the only test that works; topic will not do it.

READING AN UNLABELLED OR JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC SERVICE RECORD - a prose attendance note recording personal service, a handwritten server's log, a bailiff or sheriff return in another language, a stamp whose registry markings no approved pattern covers. This row defines no court list, no registry gazetteer and no jurisdiction catalogue, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension here.

DECIDING WHETHER A NOTICE FOR A SEALED, RESTRICTED OR REDACTED FILING MAY BE EXCERPTED AT ALL. The notice frequently names a document the holder is not permitted to circulate. Local interpretation of the minimum necessary slot set, or abstention: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

DISTINGUISHING A REGISTRY STAMP FROM A SCANNER, FAX OR MAILROOM STAMP. All four apply a dated overlay in the header zone. Only one is asserted by a receiving authority, and the difference is in the issuer identity inside the band, not in the fact that a band exists.

WHICH SIDE THE HOLDER IS ON, which is the schema's standing question and is sharpest here because the same served bundle exists in the accused's own hands, in defence counsel's hands, and in the prosecuting authority's hands. The model reads explicit role slots - who is addressed, who signed, who allocated the reference, who is described as instructed - and abstains rather than inferring a side from a firm name or a folder.

WHETHER A NAMED PERSON IN A DOCUMENT IS THE CLIENT OR A THIRD PARTY, which decides whether this row's use-restriction rule attaches. A previous-convictions schedule and a psychiatric report look identical whether the subject is the accused or a complainant; the discriminating evidence is an addressee, instructing-party or subject slot, and where it is absent the answer is unresolved, not a guess.
WHETHER AN INTERVIEW RECORD IS A DETAINED-PERSON INTERVIEW OR AN INVESTIGATORY INTERVIEW CONDUCTED FOR A CLIENT, read from the role trio present on the page rather than from the word interview.

WHETHER AN ARTEFACT IS THE SERVED COPY OR THE HOLDER'S OWN WORKING COPY of the same document, because they are not duplicates and must not be collapsed. Read from a service endorsement, an exhibit stamp, a page-numbering scheme applied by the serving side, or an annotation layer.

STRUCTURE ONLY, NEVER NARRATIVE. On any artefact this row identifies as client work product, the model may read section headings, role slots and reference lines and must not read, summarise, embed or quote the account itself. This is the operational form of this row's second privacy rule, and it is a recognition constraint, not merely a display one.

SEPARATING AN OUT-OF-COURT EXAMINATION FROM THE TRIBUNAL'S OWN RECORD OF A HEARING. This is the row's sharpest over-firing risk and it is `law_practice.hearing-transcripts`' whole node from the other direction. Both are reporter-produced verbatim Q-and-A with page-and-line numbering and a certificate. The deciding evidence is a JUDICIAL PRESENCE in the header or body - a bench line, a presiding officer, rulings on objections made in the moment, opening and closing addresses - together with the presence or absence of an errata slot the witness may sign. Neither the word transcript nor a reporting company's footer decides anything.

DECIDING WHETHER A SIGNED WITNESS STATEMENT REALLY BELONGS WITH SWORN EXAMINATIONS AT ALL. The roster directs the legacy absorption and this row performs it, but the seam is genuinely thin and is surfaced rather than smoothed (see open_question): a statement is drafted, often by the practitioner, and only signed by the maker, whereas a deposition is the maker's own unedited words. The model must not treat drafting authorship as the test, because 00 forbids the destination use of that slot and because both artefacts carry the same producer metadata.

SEPARATING AN EXAMINATION FROM AN INVESTIGATION INTERVIEW. `law_practice.investigation` holds interview records that are also one person's account of events, and they defeat topic-based separation completely. The discriminators are structural: an investigation note is taken BY the investigator, is usually a summary rather than verbatim, has no oath, no officer, no page-and-line coordinates and no slot in which the interviewee corrects and signs. Where an interviewee HAS signed a verbatim record under an attestation, the two rows genuinely contest the file and the model should abstain rather than guess.

DECIDING WHETHER THE HOLDER IS PRACTITIONER-SIDE AT ALL. A certified transcript is served on every party and downloaded by non-parties; the same bytes sit in the practitioner's matter file, in the deponent's own records, in an expert's working set and in a journalist's folder. The schema's default pair is absent from the file itself, so this row's activation says nothing about the holder's role, and the model must not infer one. Where the holder appears to BE the deponent, `legal.personal-legal-matters` is the more specific home.

RECOGNISING AN EXAMINATION IN AN UNLABELLED OR JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC FORM - an examination for discovery, an examination under oath on an insurance claim, a statement taken under caution, a commission or letters-rogatory examination abroad, a taped interview transcribed by a secretary, a scanned and OCR'd stenographic original. Local interpretation or abstention only. This row defines no jurisdiction catalogue and no procedural rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension here.

SEPARATING AN OPERATIVE EXAMINATION FROM A TRAINING OR PUBLISHED EXEMPLAR. Advocacy courses, bar review providers, reporting companies and trial-skills programmes all publish complete sample transcripts with real-looking certificates. Topic will not separate them - purpose is the only test that works - and the exemplars in this family are unusually convincing because the profession publishes its own.

DECIDING WHETHER SEVERAL VOLUMES, DAYS, MEDIA SEGMENTS AND A ROUGH DRAFT ARE ONE EXAMINATION OR SEVERAL. A person may be examined twice in one matter, once in each of two related matters, and once as a fact witness and once as a corporate representative. Bridging by the person's name alone is forbidden however confident the model is - that is a privacy rule as much as an accuracy one.

ABSTAINING WHENEVER THE CERTIFICATE-OR-ATTESTATION SLOT CANNOT BE CITED. 00: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement." and "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

WHICH SIDE PROPOUNDED, and it is unrecoverable from typography. The request instrument and the answering instrument are set in the same style, on the same caption, by the same word processor; the served copy of the OTHER side's requests sits in the holder's file identically to the holder's own. Only the propounding/responding party designations resolve it, and where they do not the correct outcome is a candidate for local review, not a guess.

Separating a discovery demand from its four structural twins: a due-diligence request list, an audit prepared-by-client list, a regulator's information request, and an information-rights (FOI or subject-access) request. All four are numbered demands for another party's documents with a per-item status column. This is the row's central interpretive burden and the reason its existential never_alone strike is written the way it is.

Deciding whether a produced corpus is THIS side's outgoing production, the OTHER side's incoming production, or the client's collected-but-not-yet-produced material. The same archive, the same load file and the same control numbers occur in all three states, and the three have different privacy consequences.

Reading a review or load file emitted by an unfamiliar platform whose column names are abbreviations. The row defines no platform catalogue and no column gazetteer; local interpretation of the header row or abstention are the only routes.

Deciding whether a custodian column names a person as a FACT or records a processing attribution. It records a processing attribution. The row states this because the temptation to promote a custodian column into a person fact - and then into a folder level - is the most likely way this material would leak.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose about the exercise: a running note of what was pulled from which mailbox, a handover note on where the second-pass review stopped, a scribbled search-term negotiation. 00 names unlabelled forms and unusual professional artifacts among the reasons rules alone are insufficient.

Deciding whether a redaction is APPLIED to the bytes in hand or merely PROPOSED in an accompanying schedule. The two produce identical filenames and the difference is a disclosure difference, not a filing one.

Distinguishing an operative discovery instrument from a study or exemplar copy - a procedure-course handout, a form-book precedent, a bar-course sample bundle. Topic will not separate them; "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works, and this row's exemplars are the same words as its operative files.

Abstaining whenever neither the demand pair nor a volume-or-range anchor can be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

WHICH SIDE THE HOLDER IS ON, and it is unrecoverable from typography. Buyer counsel, seller counsel, lender counsel and the target's own counsel all hold a request list, a data-room index and a findings report, and the circulated copies are frequently byte-identical. Only the surrounding labelled roles and the holder's own matter apparatus resolve it; where they do not, the model must abstain: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

Separating a diligence request list from its four structural twins: a discovery demand instrument, an audit prepared-by-client list, a regulator's information request, and an information-rights request. All four are numbered demands for another party's documents with a per-item status column. The interpretive discriminators are the deal-side roles, the corporate-function category set, and the in-data-room vocabulary - never the word request.

Deciding whether an enumerated index is a diligence index, a seller disclosure-bundle index, or a closing-binder index. Same numbered shape; different columns and different tense. Where both readings survive, this row and the neighbour are both candidates and neither writes a fact.

Deciding whether a Report on Title (or an IP, tax or employment diligence chapter) is a chapter INSIDE a corporate acquisition or the SUBJECT of a single-parcel conveyance. Topic will not separate them; "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works.

Separating practitioner-run diligence from the holder's OWN company being bought or sold, or from a consulting commercial diligence with no legal-services scope. Scope, fees, confidentiality and two-organisation signature blocks occur on both; explicit counsel or representation roles, a matter-reference-keyed time record, or legal work product carry the legal side. Where only the commercial paper exists, Review Later.

Distinguishing an operative diligence artefact from a study or marketing copy: a firm's published sample red-flag memo, a training-course data-room index, an anonymised case study, a bank's pitch deck. This family's exemplars are unusually convincing because the profession publishes its own templates.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose - a running note of what was pulled from which folder, a handover on where the Q-and-A stopped, a scribbled severity call on a findings page - where no column set exists to detect.
Abstaining whenever neither the deal-side role pair nor an inspection-index column set can be cited.

Deciding whether a stated date on a valuation letter is a DEATH date or a period end. The two are typographically identical and the difference decides the row. The surrounding sentence, the addressee role and the presence of a death certificate or grant reference in the same folder settle it; nothing in the number does.

Separating a deceased person's ordinary pre-death financial run from the administration set that follows it. The same institution, the same account and the same account holder appear on both sides of the death date; only the addressee role and the valuation-instant framing change.
Reading a will or codicil for whether the file is a LIFETIME planning artefact or an ADMINISTRATION artefact. The instrument is identical; the discriminator is entirely in what surrounds it.

Reading an estate-account-shaped document for whether it accounts for a bounded administration or for one year of a continuing trust. The ledger grammar is shared; the period-versus-instant framing and the governing-instrument reference separate them.

Resolving whether a contentious document - a claim against the estate, a will challenge, a family-provision application - is administration work product or a proceeding. If it carries a tribunal caption or an execution block it is `legal`'s on `legal`'s evidence, and the sibling proceeding rows are the practitioner-side home.

Deciding whether a chattels photograph was taken as valuation evidence or as an ordinary family photograph of the same object. Only an accompanying valuer's schedule item reference decides it, and where that is absent the file stays photos'.

DECIDING WHETHER A STAMPED PAGE WAS PRODUCED OR TENDERED, which is this row's whole seam with `law_practice.discovery` and is frequently unrecoverable from the bytes. A control-number stamp is applied at production to everything; an exhibit designator is applied to the small subset that is put before a decision-maker. The same page often carries both, and a page carrying only the production stamp is the neighbour's.

DECIDING WHETHER A COMPILATION IS AN EXHIBIT SET OR A HEARING BUNDLE. Both are paginated multi-document PDFs with an index. The bundle's index runs over the whole case including pleadings, statements and authorities and its pagination is continuous across the volume; the exhibit set's index runs over tendered items only and its ordering is the designator namespace. Where the index does both, `law_practice.trial-preparation` holds the compilation and this row holds the schedule.

READING AN INKED, HANDWRITTEN OR SLIP-STICKER DESIGNATOR from a scan, and deciding whether a partially legible token belongs to this proceeding's namespace or to another matter's. Abstention is the correct outcome: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

SEPARATING AN EVIDENTIARY EXHIBIT FROM A CONTRACT ANNEX. In transactional drafting the schedules to an agreement are routinely called Exhibit A, Exhibit B, Annex 1. The word is identical and the structures are opposite: an annex is bound INTO its host instrument and is referred to by the host's own clauses; an exhibit is a foreign document with a designator written ON it and is referred to by a schedule outside it.
SEPARATING A PRACTITIONER'S EXHIBIT SET FROM A PARTY'S OWN CLAIM FILE, which is the seam a landed construction neighbour already stated from its side and which this row must not contradict.

PRESERVING THE HOST DOMAIN. An exhibit is almost always another schema's evidence wearing a stamp. The model must not let the designator erase or overwrite the photograph's capture facts, the statement's institution and account structure, or the medical record's own protection - and must not copy the designator's proceeding onto the host as a fact.
Abstaining when the namespace cannot be closed: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

SEPARATING A REPORT PRODUCED FOR PROCEEDINGS FROM A REPORT PRODUCED FOR A CLIENT. This is the row's central and hardest question and it is owed reciprocally to `construction_property.survey-valuation`. A surveyor, an accountant, a physician and an engineer all write reports with a qualifications section, a methodology, limitations and a signature. The discriminating evidence is the DECLARATION SLOT, the instructing-solicitor block and the materials-considered enumeration; the discipline, the letterhead and the professional-body line discriminate nothing.

DECIDING THE SIDE, inherited unchanged from the schema and sharper here. Our specialist, their specialist, or a single joint appointment instructed by both. The same report, the same CV and the same joint statement exist in both parties' files and differ only in which instructing block is the holder's. Where the side is unresolved the model must abstain: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

SEPARATING THE PRODUCER'S OPINION FROM COUNSEL'S ADVICE. Both are reasoned professional documents inside a matter. The seam is structural and stated for `law_practice.opinions-advice`: counsel advises the instructing side and has no qualifications section, no materials-considered enumeration and no duty declaration to a tribunal; the specialist's document has all three and is produced in order to be disclosed. Topic will not separate them - "Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for."

RECOGNISING UNLABELLED PRODUCER PROSE - a preliminary view given in running text, a scribbled inspection note later scanned, a telephone attendance note recording a specialist's oral opinion, a slide deck used to explain a model. 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient.

DISTINGUISHING AN OPERATIVE REPORT FROM A TEACHING OR SAMPLE COPY. This discipline publishes its own exemplars more freely than most - model instruction letters, sample reports in practice guides, training-course specimen joint statements, published academic papers by the same authors. A specimen carries the declaration wording too, because that is what it is teaching.

DECIDING WHETHER RAW TECHNICAL MATERIAL BELONGS TO THIS ROW AT ALL. A data set, a scan, a model file or a photograph set is material CONSIDERED, not material produced. It keeps its own schema's evidence and this row claims no primacy over it; where that schema is a safety domain, its protection runs first.

ABSTAINING WHEN ONLY THE ROLE WORD IS PRESENT. A file named for a specialist, a folder named for a discipline, a CV with no instruction and no report around it: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

DECIDING THE SIDE, inherited from the schema and HARDER HERE THAN ANYWHERE ELSE IN THE FAMILY, because in a family matter neither party is an organisation. Elsewhere the side can sometimes be resolved from a company name in a signature block; here both parties are private individuals with the same surname on the same former address, and the only discriminator may be which of two mirror-image sworn statements the holder's firm drafted. Abstention is the correct outcome: 00 requires that a model "must return unknown" when its cited evidence is insufficient.

Separating this row from the holder's OWN family matter. This is the schema anchor's under-firing fixture and it is a family-law file, which makes it this row's problem before anyone else's: every practitioner-looking token can be present while the holder is the client. The discriminating evidence is where the practitioner-side apparatus is, never a firm name, never a matter reference, never a folder called Divorce.

Deciding whether a child's school report or medical letter is an EXHIBIT in this matter or the holder's own child's record. The bytes are identical; only the exhibit index, the matter reference or an explicit disclosure request separates them, and the wrong answer in either direction is a serious one.

Separating a real sworn means statement from a blank court form, a firm precedent, a training exemplar or a law-school problem. "Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for." is the only test that works, and this world's blank forms are unusually convincing because they carry every labelled slot of the real thing.

Deciding whether one household's papers are ONE matter or several. Finance, children and protection between the same two people are commonly separate proceedings with separate references, deliberately kept apart. Bridging them by shared surname, shared address or shared child is forbidden regardless of what the model concludes.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose - an attendance note of a distressed telephone call, a chronology typed in running text, a handwritten-then-scanned file note. The route is local interpretation from a bounded dossier or abstention.

Interpreting a party-made recording, message export or screenshot bundle offered as evidence, where the speakers, the consent position and the relevance are all unstated. The product identifies a media file and abstains; it decides no admissibility, no legality and no speaker identity.

Interpreting jurisdiction-specific or multilingual family artefacts whose labelled roles no approved pattern covers. This row defines no court list, no form catalogue, no jurisdiction rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension.

A rough or realtime transcript delivered as a bare text dump with no cover page and no certificate - the grid may be partial or absent, and only the turn grammar and the content survive. This is the row's most frequent real file and its weakest evidence; it should join a candidate group with a sitting whose cover IS evidenced rather than activating on its own.

Distinguishing a hearing record from an out-of-court examination record when the cover is missing, which is the case the catalogue itself calls formally near-identical. The residual discriminators are internal and unreliable: interventions attributed to a court officer, argument addressed to the tribunal, or the absence of the deponent-signed correction mechanism.

An ex tempore ruling delivered orally and captured INSIDE a day's transcript. The passage is a judgment in content and a transcript in form; deciding whether a separately supplied file is the transcribed ruling or the later settled judgment is a judgement about apparatus, not vocabulary.

Matching an audio or video file to the sitting it records when only the filename connects them - and the temptation to resolve it by transcribing is exactly what 00 gates: "Audio and video files should yield duration, container and codec metadata, creation time, embedded tags, subtitles or captions where present, and—only under an explicit privacy and compute policy—speech-to-text transcripts."

Whether an in camera, closed-session, protected-witness or sealed marker covers the whole document or one portion of it. The product must not resolve this by inference in either direction; an unresolved marker is a reason to protect the whole file and surface it, never a reason to conclude the remainder is open.
Whether the holder is the practitioner side or a party in person, which the face of a transcript never states - a transcript is produced for whoever ordered it and reads identically for all of them.

Deciding whether a heterogeneous folder is one applicant's assembled dossier or an unrelated pile of the same person's records, when the only anchor is an evidence index and the members are content-incoherent. This is 00's own licensed case - "The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent." - and it must be run as 00 runs it, from a bounded dossier of anchors and short excerpts, with the validator rejecting any conclusion that the excerpts do not support. It must never be run by sending the declaration or the identity documents themselves.

Deciding whether a covering letter is a representative's submission letter to an authority or the applicant's own covering letter, when the letterhead is generic. The observable seam is whether the letter writes about the applicant in the third person while signing in a professional capacity, versus writing in the first person. This is language interpretation that no rule resolves, and abstaining to Review Later is the correct cheap error.

Deciding whether a country-conditions document, a policy note or a published determination is a working member of one case's evidence dossier or an unfiled copy of public reading material, when no exact case reference appears on it. Absent an accepted anchor the answer is the residual, not the case.

DECIDING WHOSE PROCESS IT IS — the family's sharpest under-firing risk. The same terms of reference, interview note, evidence log and findings report exist in an employer's own grievance or disciplinary case (`hr.employee-relations`), in a compliance or internal-audit engagement (`business_operations.compliance-audit`), in a consulting forensic engagement (`career.consulting-client-engagement`), and in a practitioner-side matter conducted FOR a client. Only the commissioning-and-investigator slots plus the presence of practitioner-side matter apparatus resolve it, and where they do not the correct outcome is Review Later: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Separating an investigation interview from a deposition, a sworn witness statement, and a police or regulator interview of the practice's own client. Topic will not separate them; the attestation block, the direction of questioning, and the officer or rights-advisement slots will.
Separating an investigation evidence log from a discovery production volume and from a trial bundle index. Shared exhibit labels decide nothing.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose about the enquiry: a running note of who was spoken to, a scribbled scope change, a handover on where document review stopped. 00 names unlabelled forms and unusual professional artifacts among the reasons rules alone are insufficient.

Distinguishing an operative enquiry record from a study or exemplar copy — a bar-course sample investigation pack, a firm know-how precedent, a textbook specimen. Topic will not separate them; "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works.

Deciding whether a heterogeneous pack is ONE enquiry or several when the same subjects recur across related complaints. Cross-enquiry bridging by subject name is forbidden as a privacy rule, not only an accuracy rule.

Abstaining whenever neither the terms-of-reference pair nor an investigation-reference anchor can be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

DECIDING WHETHER THE RIGHT IDENTIFIER MEANS THE HOLDER IS ACTING, WHICH IS THIS ROW'S WHOLE QUESTION AND IS USUALLY UNRECOVERABLE FROM THE BYTES. Every official number in this world is public and is printed identically on the file a firm of record holds, on the file the applicant's in-house team holds, on the file an opponent's firm holds, on a competitor's watch-list download, and on a copy an undergraduate saved from a search engine. Only the correspondence-address and docket slots resolve who is acting, and they are absent from most published versions. Abstain when they are absent: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Separating an AS-FILED application from the PUBLISHED version of the same application. The text is frequently byte-identical, and the difference is a legal event that happened on a date and is not written in the content. Getting this wrong in the permissive direction is the row's worst failure, because the unpublished draft is the most disclosure-fragile document in the entire `law_practice` family - publishing its content is not an embarrassment, it can extinguish the property right the file exists to obtain.

Separating PROSECUTION from ENFORCEMENT and from EXPLOITATION. The same right identifier appears on an office action, on an infringement complaint, on a licence agreement, on a freedom-to-operate opinion and on a due-diligence schedule. Prosecution is the exchange WITH THE OFFICE about whether the right exists; the others are about a right that already does, and belong to `law_practice.pleadings`, `law_practice.transactional-deal`, `law_practice.opinions-advice` and `creative.licensing-rights`. Topic will not separate them - "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works.

Separating an EX PARTE examination exchange from an INTER PARTES office proceeding - an opposition, a cancellation, a re-examination or an administrative trial. The second has two named parties, a captioned style, service on the other side and a decision, and is `law_practice.pleadings` and `law_practice.orders-and-judgments` material even though it happens inside the same office and carries the same right identifier. This row claims only the ex parte half and concedes the rest.

Separating the PRACTITIONER acting for a client from a HOLDER who filed their own application. A sole founder or small company that files without an attorney produces a filing receipt, an office action and a response carrying every token this row recognises, with the applicant's own address in the correspondence slot and no docket number. That is `legal.personal-legal-matters` or the holder's own business record, and no amount of official structure makes it practitioner-side.

Separating a practitioner's own professional credential from a right's identifier. An IP practitioner's registration number sits in a signature block on almost every document this row touches; it identifies a PERSON, not a right, and routing on it would be the schema's struck practising-certificate token wearing a number.

Recognising unlabelled practitioner prose in this world - a strategy note on whether to appeal a final rejection, an email weighing a divisional against an abandonment, a scanned handwritten interview note recording what an examiner indicated would be allowable. 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient.

Deciding whether several documents are ONE right's family or several rights. Continuations, divisionals, national-phase entries and related marks in different classes recur with near-identical text, near-identical drawings and the same proprietor. Only an EXACT priority or parent-application reference in a labelled slot may bridge them; textual and drawing similarity may not, however convincing.

Interpreting office artefacts from any jurisdiction, office or language whose labelled slots no approved pattern covers. The route is local interpretation or abstention. This row defines NO office list, NO country-code gazetteer, NO form-number catalogue and NO classification scheme; jurisdiction is never a field and never a dimension.
Abstaining whenever the acting-of-record pairing cannot be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

DECIDING WHETHER THE APPARATUS BELONGS TO A LIVE MATTER OR TO A TEACHING COPY. This is the row's sharpest over-firing risk and its collision fixture: the profession publishes its own model motions, and a Trial Advocacy or CLE exemplar carries a caption, a relief slot, a numbered argument and a table of authorities - every structural item this row claims. Only 00's purpose test separates them, since "purpose answers what the file was for", and the operative discriminator is the schema precondition: a real matter reference recurring across artefacts, and a counsel block naming the holder's own firm.

SEPARATING A REQUEST DOCUMENT FROM AN ASSERTION DOCUMENT when the labels are unhelpful, which is common in unlabelled or translated practice. A statement of case asserts the parties' own allegations and closes on a prayer; a request document asks the tribunal to order something and argues for it. Where neither the relief slot nor the assertion structure is legible, the model abstains and the caption alone carries the file to `legal`.

SEPARATING THIS ROW FROM `law_practice.appeals` WHERE THE TIER IS THE ONLY DIFFERENCE. An appellate stay, extension-of-time or expedition application is a request document in every structural respect; the landed neighbour claims it on the two-tier proceeding-identifier pair and this row concedes it. The model must read the heading zone for a second, lower proceeding identifier and an on-appeal-from line, not the word motion.

SEPARATING THE FILED SUBMISSION FROM THE INTERNAL RESEARCH THAT BECAME IT. Ninety per cent of the text can be identical. Only the apparatus differs - caption, relief slot, authorities table, attestation - and where a draft carries none of it yet, `law_practice.legal-research` holds it and this row does not.

DECIDING WHETHER A PROPOSED ORDER IS AN ENCLOSURE OR A PRECEDENT. A blank-execution instrument with a caption is this row's; a blank-execution instrument with bracketed placeholders where parties belong and no live proceeding is `law_practice.precedent-bank`'s. A firm that keeps a caption-bearing standard-form order in its know-how bank defeats the test on the bytes alone, and the model must abstain rather than guess.

ABSTAINING WHENEVER THE MATTER-AND-ROLE PRECONDITION CANNOT BE CITED, however complete the apparatus looks. A downloaded public filing satisfies every structural item on this list and establishes nothing about the holder; correct abstention is the successful outcome here and the row is written to make abstention easy rather than to maximise capture.

Deciding whether the holder GAVE or RECEIVED the advice. The same opinion letter exists in the author's file and in the addressee's file and differs only in which signature block is the holder's. This row is the giver's side; `legal.personal-legal-matters` is the holder-as-advisee side; abstain when the side cannot be cited.

Separating an addressed opinion from the internal research note that produced it, when a note carries a covering line naming a reader. `law_practice.legal-research` owns the authorities survey and the internal analysis; this row owns the document a named outsider may rely on. The presence of a reliance restriction is the intended discriminator, but a terse internal advice may carry one and a sloppy opinion may omit it.

Separating a legal opinion from a consulting or advisory deliverable when BOTH carry an addressee block and a no-third-party-responsibility clause - the collision this row treats as its headline, because the use-limitation clause is universal across professional deliverables and is therefore worthless as evidence on its own.

Deciding whether a copy of a court's own opinion is reference reading, an authority relied on by an accepted matter, or an exhibit. Topic will not separate them; the design's own test is the only one that works - `Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.`

Recognising advice given in unlabelled prose - an attendance note recording oral advice, a strategy email in running text, a scanned handwritten note. The design names this class among the reasons rules are insufficient. Such a file is a `law_practice.matter-correspondence` member unless the addressed-and-reliance structure is present.
Deciding whether a later short letter is a bring-down of a named opinion, a withdrawal of it, or an unrelated covering letter that happens to cite a date.

Judging whether a second opinion reviewing another adviser's advice is this row's artefact or a critique filed as work product, when the reviewing document has an addressee but no assumptions section.
Abstaining whenever the addressee's role cannot be resolved from the artefact itself. `Correct abstention is a successful outcome`.

Separating a practice's KEPT precedent from a PUBLISHED model form, practice note, seminar paper, textbook precedent or regulator's specimen document. The schema anchor already names this as the family's hardest case and says why the exemplars are unusually convincing: the profession publishes its own templates. Surface, layout, clause numbering and drafting notes are identical on both sides; what separates them is a publisher and an official form code on one side against a firm template marker and a local owner on the other, and neither is reliably present.

Deciding whether a blank official court, registry or agency form is a kept precedent or reading material. `law_practice.family-law` routes it from its side to this row OR to Reading Inbox, and does not resolve which - correctly, because a downloaded blank form carries no evidence of why it was kept.

Reading a precedents pack delivered as an archive whose members are mixed, where the pack's own character does not transfer to every member. 00's archive path licenses inspecting the manifest, not concluding membership.

Judging whether a document described as sanitised or de-identified actually is - whether a party name survives in tracked changes, comments, a footer file path, or document properties. This is a real-bytes question and the row's activation depends on it.
Interpreting jurisdiction-specific or multilingual professional forms whose labelled slots no approved pattern covers, and internal know-how prose that carries no labelled structure at all.

The offered-versus-granted distinction, which is the row's most frequent hard case. A costs estimate that LISTS funding options - private retainer, legal aid, conditional fee, insurance, union funding - contains the words but no determination, no allocated reference and no limitation. Deciding that a document offers rather than grants requires reading, and where it is unresolved the answer is Review Later, not this row.

Whose means are being assessed. An income, capital and dependants declaration paired with an eligibility outcome has the same structure whether the subject is a firm's client, the holder's own household applying for student aid, or a benefits claimant. The role of the assessing party and whose file it sits in is the discriminator and it is usually prose.

Whether an hours or matter-count table is matter-anchored or organisational. A table with one row per matter, an authority reference and a fee-earner is this row's; a table counting volunteer hours by attorney across a firm for annual reporting is an organisational report and belongs to `business_operations`.

Unlabelled advice-session and clinic notes. A free-text note of a one-hour session at a duty scheme or a clinic may be the only artefact of an entire episode, with no matter reference, no authority reference and no determination. The LLM may propose the note for local review; it may not manufacture a funding fact from it.

Free prose that describes the arrangement - 'we are acting without charge', 'the Agency has granted a certificate limited to counsel's opinion' - where the structural slots are absent. Prose may support a candidate; it cannot substitute for the determination, reference or limitation.

DECIDING WHETHER THE HOLDER IS THE AGENT OR MERELY HOLDS A COPY, which is this row's whole question and is frequently unrecoverable from the bytes. The same acknowledgement reaches the filing agent, the client's in-house team, a co-regulator on a shared portal, and anyone who downloaded a public decision. Only the agent slot, the matter reference and surrounding practitioner apparatus resolve who is acting. Abstain when they cannot be cited: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

SEPARATING A PRACTITIONER'S CLIENT SUBMISSION from an ENTITY'S OWN RETURN held in the entity's corpus. Byte-identical confirmation statements, sector returns and registry receipts appear in both worlds. The discriminating evidence is a matter or engagement anchor, a filed-by-agent authorisation held as the agent's record, or a time-recording row keyed to a matter - never the form number and never the authority name.

SEPARATING A REGULATORY SUBMISSION from a COURT FILING. Both are transmissions to a public authority with acknowledgements and deficiency notices. A tribunal caption, a docket entry, a proof of service on an adverse party, or a notice of electronic filing from a court system carries the court-filing-record / `legal` side; an applicant-and-agent form, a merger or licence notification, or a sector return filed for a client carries this side. Topic will not separate them.

SEPARATING THIS ROW from IP PROSECUTION. An application to an IP office IS a registry submission on a client's behalf - the parent schema's own work_type phrase - and the sibling `law_practice.ip-prosecution` already claims the ex-parte examination exchange that creates a transferable registered right. The discriminator this row can actually cite is the ABSENCE of that sibling's claim-amendment listing and dual-docket right-identifier pairing, plus the PRESENCE of an authorisation / notification / clearance / compelled-return shape that creates no transferable IP right. The seam is recorded as NJ-REG-1 rather than smoothed.

SEPARATING A PRE-ANNOUNCEMENT CLEARANCE PACKET from PUBLIC READING MATERIAL. A published decision, a public register extract and a guidance PDF share vocabulary with a live merger filing. "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works; a public decision alone is Reading Inbox.

SEPARATING THE FIRM'S OWN COMPLIANCE PROGRAMME from CLIENT REGULATORY WORK. An AML policy, a CPD log, a professional-indemnity proposal and an SRA or state-bar questionnaire about the FIRM are the firm running itself - business_operations, hr, career or finance - and this row does not reclaim them under the legacy `law.compliance-programme` label.

RECOGNISING UNLABELLED PRACTITIONER PROSE in this world - a strategy note on whether to notify, a covering letter negotiating an extension, a scanned handwritten attendance note of a call with a case officer. 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient.

INTERPRETING JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC OR MULTILINGUAL AUTHORITY ARTEFACTS whose labelled slots no approved pattern covers. The route is local interpretation or abstention. This row defines NO regulator catalogue, NO form-number gazetteer and NO jurisdiction list; jurisdiction is never a field and never a dimension.
Abstaining whenever the agent-and-submission pairing cannot be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

WHICH SIDE THE MONEY IS FLOWING. A bill issued by the holder's practice to a client, a bill the holder's practice RECEIVED from counsel, and a bill the holder received as a private client of some other firm have the same slots, the same narrative style, the same disbursement schedule and often the same layout vendor. Only the issuer and billed-to roles, read as prose, separate them, and where they cannot be read the answer is Review Later - not a guess in either direction.

WHETHER A NARRATIVE COLUMN IS A WORK NARRATIVE AT ALL. 'Attendance on client', 'review of records', 'drafting' and 'consideration of papers' are recognisable as chargeable-work prose; free-text columns in a project tracker or a consultant's activity log are not, and the difference is register rather than structure.

WHETHER A REDUCTION IS AN ASSESSMENT OR A WRITE-OFF. A struck, reduced or nil line may be a practice's own commercial write-down (this row's) or an external assessing body's determination (`law_practice.pro-bono`'s, where a funder set the rate). The line looks identical; the presence of a determining authority that is not a party is the discriminator and it is usually prose.

WHETHER AN AGGREGATED TABLE IS STILL MATTER-ANCHORED. A workbook may summarise by matter (this row's), or by fee earner, team, period or practice area (an organisational return). The seam is where the ROW STOPS BEING A MATTER, and reading the first column's grain is the only way to find it.

DECIDING THE SIDE, which is inherited from the schema and is worse here, because a deal has more than two sides. Buyer's counsel, seller's counsel, target's counsel and lender's counsel all hold a working group list, a CP tracker and a disclosure letter, and the documents are frequently byte-identical because they were circulated to everyone. The only discriminator is which organisation's row in the working group list matches the holder's own apparatus. Where the side is unresolved the model must abstain: a model that cannot cite sufficient evidence "must return unknown".

Separating a practitioner-run deal from the holder's OWN company being bought or sold. A founder selling their company holds a codename, a working group list, a CP tracker and a disclosure letter too - as the recipient. The practitioner-side anchor is the schema's, not this row's, and this row inherits it: an allocated matter reference belonging to the holder's own firm, a time record, work product the holder produced. Absent that, this is `legal.personal-legal-matters` or `business_operations` material and the row must abstain rather than treat someone's own sale as a client file.

Deciding whether a codename is a DEAL at all. Codenames are used for reorganisations, product launches, strategy offsites, redundancy programmes, fundraising rounds and office moves. Only the role enumeration settles it, and topic will not: "purpose answers what the file was for".

Deciding whether two codenames are one deal or two - a bid that failed and a later bid for the same target, a main acquisition and its financing, a carve-out inside a group reorganisation. Bridging by matching party names, subject or similarity is forbidden regardless of what the model concludes.

Distinguishing an operative deal document from a study or marketing copy: a firm's published deal precedent, a training-course sample SPA and disclosure letter, an anonymised case study, a bank's pitch deck naming a codename it invented. This family's exemplars are unusually convincing because the profession and its advisers publish their own transaction templates.
Reading unlabelled deal prose - an attendance note of an all-hands call, a running-text summary of open points, a scanned marked-up page of a schedule - where no column set exists to detect.

Interpreting jurisdiction-specific or multilingual transaction artefacts whose labelled roles no approved pattern covers. This row defines no jurisdiction catalogue and no legal rule, and jurisdiction is never a field or a dimension.
Abstaining whenever the codename-and-role pair cannot be cited: "Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement."

DECIDING WHETHER AN INDEX IS A HEARING COMPILATION OR A TRANSACTION COMPILATION. A closing or completion binder index and a trial bundle index are structurally identical - member descriptions, tab numbers, continuous pagination, volume markers. The discriminator is the ANCHOR EVENT, and it is often one header line: a court or tribunal name with a hearing or listing reference points here; a completion or closing date with a deal or project name and a signatory schedule points to `law_practice.closing-binder`. Where the header is absent, neither row should fire and the artefact is Review Later.

DECIDING WHETHER AN ENUMERATING TABLE IS PREPARATION OR PRODUCTION. A disclosure review log and a bundle index are both tables of documents. The discriminator is what the row DECIDES: a reviewer identity plus a responsive, privileged or coding decision is `law_practice.discovery`'s; a tab, an order position and a compilation page is this row's. A table with both columns is a production set being converted into a bundle and needs the LLM to say which structure the artefact is FOR.

DECIDING WHETHER AN ORDERED SET OF SUBMISSIONS IS A FILED ADVOCACY DOCUMENT OR A WORKING OUTLINE. A skeleton argument, written case or opening note filed with the tribunal - caption, filing mark, service list - is `law_practice.motions-and-briefs`' or `law_practice.pleadings`'. An unfiled outline whose structure is an ordering of points against bundle references and a witness sequence is this row's. This seam is genuinely fine, both neighbours are unlanded, and it is raised as NJ-TP-2 rather than settled here.

READING A COMPILATION'S MEMBERSHIP WITHOUT INHERITING ITS MEMBERS' WORLDS. Whether a page range inside a volume is a medical record, a bank statement or an identity document is exactly the judgement this row must NOT act on for placement, and must be able to make for protection. The distinction is stated in sensitivity_why and it is the row's hardest LLM-facing rule.

TELLING A GENUINE CHRONOLOGY FROM A PROJECT TIMELINE OR AN INCIDENT LOG. Both pair dates with events. The discriminator is the SOURCE REFERENCE COLUMN pointing into other case material plus a matter or listing anchor; a dated event table with no cross-references and no listing is an operations or project artefact and is not this row's, whatever the filename says.

readings: an unlabelled prose letter that is legally operative without looking like an instrument - a plain letter terminating a tenancy, demanding payment, or revoking consent. It has no heading, no form field and often no signature block, and 00 names exactly this class among the reasons rules are insufficient: 'real file collections contain vague filenames, indirect language, multilingual documents, screenshots, unlabeled forms, unusual professional artifacts, and user-specific workflows that cannot be captured reliably by fixed patterns alone'

deciding whether instrument-shaped language is the HOLDER'S legal matter or boilerplate they merely saved (terms of service, EULA, privacy policy, an open-source licence). The vocabulary is identical on both sides; only the reading of who is bound separates them

an OCR'd screenshot of a court e-filing page, a government notice or a signature-service confirmation - deciding it is a proceeding record rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is admissions, a screenshot reading 'Your Columbia University application has been submitted'; this is the same shape with a tribunal or filing service in place of a school

whether a heterogeneous set of files is purpose-coherent as ONE matter or transaction - a closing packet holding a deed, a disclosure, a note and an ID copy. 00's own words for that condition: 'The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent'
a multilingual or foreign-notarized instrument whose document kind has no recognisable labelled slot in the corpus language

PRECONDITION: Legal protection is already active, P7 has run, and this schema still has no Legal fields. Protected material is excluded from cloud prompts by default; any permitted model review is local or explicitly authorized and redacted. The model may propose only template plausibility, group coherence or an outlier decision with exact citations, never legal advice or an instrument's validity, effect, status, parties, wishes or dispositive outcome
an unlabelled letter of wishes, funeral instruction or family letter whose estate or end-of-life purpose appears only in prose and which may be personal guidance rather than a legal instrument

whether two near-identical files are a draft, executed copy, codicil, restatement, revocation or unrelated template. A model may identify cited differences for review but must not declare which one is current or governing

whether an ambiguous use of will, living will, directive, trust, estate, attorney, agent or beneficiary describes a testamentary instrument, a health-care instrument, an account record, a lawsuit, an IT estate, or ordinary prose

whether a corpus holds the person's own estate documents or a practitioner's client matter. Matter-management structure, billing, work product and multiple clients point to legal.practice-matter-file; possession, a folder name or one firm letterhead decides nothing
a foreign-language, historical or unusual instrument whose functional roles are visible but whose document-kind vocabulary is not in the deployment's one injected jurisdiction catalogue

whether a mixed archive is one coherent estate-plan or administration packet when the manifest is incomplete, while retaining every member as its own file and leaving conflicting people, estates, accounts or instrument references visible
whether correspondence about a death or estate belongs to routine administration, an adversarial will contest, a tax filing, a financial account workflow, genealogy research, or no accepted situation
an OCR'd portal screenshot or photographed page whose visible content may be an executed estate instrument, an adviser checklist, a public sample form, a clinical order, or a finance portal

whether a trust certification, beneficiary form or account-registration document carries disjoint Legal and Finance evidence, without letting an account number, institution, beneficiary name or trust label count once for both schemas

handwritten or voice-derived wishes only after an explicit privacy and compute policy authorizes the relevant extraction. Without an authorized transcript or sufficient legible text, the correct result is abstention

a complete-looking agreement with clear obligations but no reliable indication whether it is a blank form, a negotiation draft, a final unsigned record or the holder's operative copy. The model may describe the document shape from cited evidence and must return unknown on legal status

a click-through, account-opening or online-service record where published terms and a user-specific acceptance event are separate files. The model may connect the records only when the dossier identifies the same service and terms version; it may not infer assent or enforceability
a multilingual agreement, a handwritten lodging arrangement or a low-quality OCR scan whose party roles and operative terms require bounded language interpretation
an exchange of letters or email that may record agreed terms without a formal instrument. The model may surface it for review but may not declare that a contract was formed

whether the holder is a party keeping their own agreement, an employer keeping another person's agreement, or a legal practitioner keeping negotiation apparatus for a client. Custody and party role determine the template boundary and cannot be inferred from a signature block

an agreement-shaped document whose subject could instead be employment, equity, lending, insurance, research participant data, association governance, vehicle administration or study-abroad housing. Shared names, amounts and signature blocks must be allocated to neither side until the subject-specific structure is read

an unlabelled demand, termination, complaint or response letter whose operative force is expressed only in prose. A bounded local or explicitly permitted model may distinguish a genuine dispute step from an ordinary customer complaint, negotiation draft or emotional note; it must cite the operative sentence or return unknown

a published judgment, law-school case, research download or news attachment whose court caption is byte-for-byte indistinguishable from a personal filing but has no direct holder relation.
