readings: PRECONDITION on every entry in this list: this is protected material, so a model step runs only after P7 classification and only under the user's policy - 00: "Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default", and where a model is genuinely needed, "If a model needs text containing sensitive content, the user should see that requirement and choose whether to allow a local model, a cloud model, a redacted prompt, or no model use." A local model under fully-offline or local-model mode is the default reading of every line below
an unlabelled clinician narrative - a letter, a note, a discharge summary written as prose with no labelled result table and no patient block

an OCR'd portal screenshot: whether it is a patient-portal page rather than a generic image. 00's worked parallel is the admissions confirmation screenshot, and its own warning is that "IMG_4821.png may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure"

separating medical TOPIC from a personal health record - a nursing lecture, a health article, a de-identified teaching case. 00 gives the model exactly this class of determination: it "may determine whether an extracted document appears to be an application essay, research artifact, recruiting document, travel record, or other supported domain"

whether a record is about the holder or about another person in the household. The model must abstain rather than assert a subject - 00: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown"
a discharge summary, lab report, or claim in a language whose labelled-slot vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover

a packet in which a medical document is a supporting member of a non-medical purpose - a school health form inside an admissions packet, an accommodation letter inside an academic file. 00's shape: "an ID, transcript, resume, personal statement, award certificate, and portal screenshot may be content-incoherent but purpose-coherent as an application submission"

an ordinary visit summary, lab report, prescription, or discharge record naming one patient but no holder, proxy, guardian, or carer. The model may judge only whether bounded local context suggests the dependant situation; it must return unknown rather than assume the corpus owner is or is not the patient.

an informal caregiver medication schedule, symptom diary, home-care log, or message thread where names, pronouns, and relationship language are unlabelled. Family vocabulary and possession are not proof of the people or authority involved.

distinguishing a proxy, personal representative, guardian, carer, emergency contact, guarantor, policy subscriber, next of kin, clinician, and mere message recipient when a form places several names around one patient. The model may cite role labels but cannot turn a role into a legal conclusion.

a multilingual or non-standard record whose patient and representative roles are stated in prose or unfamiliar labels rather than stable slots. This is a local-model or explicitly policy-permitted path; raw names, relationships, diagnoses, and identifiers are not a default cloud dossier.

a newborn, maternity, or family discharge packet that contains separate records for a birthing parent and infant, plus shared encounter or household details. The model must preserve the two patient zones and abstain rather than copy one person's facts onto the other.

a minor or adolescent record with confidential, withheld, redacted, age-sensitive, capacity-sensitive, or service-specific sections. The model can identify that access boundaries are discussed; it cannot infer an age threshold, applicable law, capacity, consent, or what the holder is entitled to see.

a mixed school, IEP, admission, insurance, legal-authority, and health packet. The model may propose reviewable group memberships from independently evidenced members but may not let packet purpose activate a sparse member or copy patient, school, authority, or claim facts across files.

a portal screenshot where OCR finds a patient name, another person's name, and access language but navigation, truncation, or redaction obscures their roles. Capture evidence may activate Photos independently; it cannot settle the medical role distinction.

a human-versus-veterinary record when the clinical structure is real but species and patient role are unclear. The target covers child and dependant-adult human records, not an animal merely described as a dependant or family member.

PRECONDITION: Medical is already protected and this schema has no clinical fields. A model may only propose template plausibility, group coherence, or an outlier decision with citations; it may not write a diagnosis, provider, patient, date-of-service, record-kind, medication, or other medical fact. Protected material is excluded from cloud prompts by default; any permitted model path is local or explicitly authorized and redacted under the user's policy
an unlabelled clinician narrative, referral letter, discharge letter, or scanned paper record whose provider, patient, and clinical-document roles are expressed only in prose
an OCR'd portal capture whose screen origin is supported but whose content could be a clinical record, an insurance claim, a generic appointment page, a health article, or a message thread

whether the named patient is the corpus holder rather than a child, dependant adult, or another household member when the file lacks a direct self-versus-proxy marker. The model must return unknown rather than infer a family relationship; template selection remains user-confirmed

whether a structured export is a provider-authored clinical summary for this situation, consumer or device telemetry for medical.wearable-health-exports, or claims and coverage data for finance.insurance-healthcare

whether dense clinical prose is the holder's own record rather than medical coursework, a public health article, a de-identified teaching case, an ethics packet, or a research notebook. Topic alone is not record status

whether a mixed records-request archive is one coherent personal record packet when the manifest is incomplete, while preserving each member as its own file and leaving conflicting subjects or providers visible
a multilingual or unusual clinical layout whose patient and provider roles cannot be established by the labelled structures covered by the local rule catalogue

a combined employer, insurer, legal, or research form with an attached clinical page: determine which zones support which situation and whether the file is multi-plausible, without allowing one shared name or date to count twice

a consultation recording after an explicit privacy and compute policy has authorized speech-to-text. Without an authorized transcript or a user confirmation, the filename and container metadata are insufficient and the correct result is abstention

whether an unfamiliar vendor schema is a personal wearable or health-app export, a generic account backup, a home-sensor log, or an application data dump. This is a local-model or abstention path by default, with citations to locally extracted structural evidence

whether structured health material is longitudinal device telemetry for this template or a provider-issued clinical record for medical.personal-health-records. Source and function matter more than file format, and a mixed export may remain one protected packet without choosing a deeper template

whether a measurement table belongs to a person's account export, a research dataset, or both. Project identifiers, a codebook, and analysis inputs support Research; account-export provenance and device-sourced personal records support this row; generic columns support neither

whether OCR from a health-app dashboard screenshot establishes a personal measurement record rather than a fitness article, training plan, advertisement, or mockup. Positive screen-origin evidence activates Photos independently and never weakens Medical protection

whether a whole-account archive contains separable protected and non-protected member families. The model may propose review boundaries from a manifest dossier but may not unpack the archive, inspect raw values remotely, or declare a member safe from its folder name

whether a sparse email or index file belongs to a nearby export packet when the archive carries the direct anchor. Group membership may be suggested without activating Medical from the email alone and without copying the service or account relationship as a fact

whether two periodic exports are duplicates, versions, or distinct snapshots. Matching app names and overlapping dates are not enough; exact hashes, an explicit export identifier, or an accepted archive-family relationship must do the work

whether localized or translated metric names express the same structural role when the deterministic catalogue does not cover the language. Raw labels stay local and the result is unknown when the role cannot be cited

readings: Deciding the SIDE, which in this family is the whole question and is frequently unrecoverable: funder or grantee, donor or recipient, member or association, volunteer or coordinator, service provider or service user. Interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when the side is unresolved.

Separating this schema from business_operations when the association's SELF-RUNNING record is in front of it. The default answer is business_operations. The model may only route here if it can name the non-exchange party; charitable branding on a budget, a policy or a set of minutes is not that party.

Recognising an unlabelled grant narrative report, impact or outcomes account, case note, safeguarding concern written in prose, or theory-of-change document whose function is expressed only in narrative and whose vocabulary overlaps a marketing deck.

Distinguishing operative association records from a downloaded exemplar - a model grant application, a published annual report of a different charity, a sample safeguarding policy, an NGO research paper. Topic will not separate them: “purpose answers what the file was for” is the only test that works.
Deciding whether a donor, member or beneficiary list is the association's own register or a purchased, scraped or shared mailing list, which changes both the routing and the protection owed.
Interpreting multilingual or denominational register and grant vocabulary whose labelled roles are not covered by deterministic structure rules.

Separating a nonprofit grant lifecycle from research.grants-funding's award lifecycle when a university's charitable arm holds both; and abstaining rather than guessing, because the two structures genuinely converge.
Abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite a non-exchange party: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

Deciding the SIDE on an acknowledgement, which is this row's defining unresolvable and is frequently unrecoverable from the bytes: the association keeps the acknowledgement it issued, and the giver keeps the identical page as their own tax substantiation. The letterhead and the charity number are on both copies and discriminate neither. Abstain unless a signature block, a covering email, a file's position in an outbound batch, or an accompanying register resolves the side.

Separating a GIFT from a restricted GRANT when a trust or foundation award letter carries a non-exchange sentence AND a report-back obligation in the same document. The reporting and expenditure-reconciliation obligation is what moves it to nonprofit.grant-reporting; the word grant does not, and neither does the funder being a foundation.

Separating a corporate SPONSORSHIP from a corporate GIFT, where the deck vocabulary, the logo placement and the tiering language are identical. A stated package of branded benefits at a stated value is an exchange and belongs to business_operations.partnerships-bd; an unconditional corporate gift with an acknowledgement is this row's. The model must be able to name the benefit, not merely fail to find one.

Recognising an unlabelled case for support, major-gift proposal, stewardship letter or impact report written to donors, whose function is expressed only in narrative and whose vocabulary is indistinguishable from a marketing deck's.

Deciding whether a list of named people is the association's OWN donor or supporter register or a purchased, rented, appended or scraped prospect list, which changes both the routing and the protection owed and is very often decided by a vendor footer rather than by the columns.

Distinguishing an operative appeal from a downloaded exemplar - another charity's appeal letter kept as a swipe file, a published annual report used as a benchmark, a fundraising-regulator code of practice, a sector benchmarking study. Topic will not separate them: “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”
Deciding whether a pledge carrying a naming, recognition or reporting clause has stopped being a gift and become an instrument, in which case legal co-activates and protects first.
Abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite a printed non-exchange or benefit-valuation element: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

The row's whole existential question, and it is a judgement no rule settles: whether the payment on the page BUYS RIGHTS or BUYS GOODS. A subscription that confers a class, a vote and a standing in the body is this row; a subscription that confers a magazine, a discount and a renewal price is a customer relationship and is business_operations. The vocabulary is identical on both sides and the discriminating evidence - a class carrying differential voting rights, a constitutional reference, a meeting entitlement - is often present only once and in small print.

Deciding the SIDE, inherited from the schema and sharper here because both sides hold rolls: the association holding its own register, against a federation holding the affiliated bodies' registers, against a member holding their own card and notice. A roll in a corpus does not say whose roll it is.

Separating a members' general meeting from a board or trustee meeting when the instrument is unlabelled - a small association's committee, council or executive frequently uses the same document furniture as its AGM, and in the smallest bodies the two constituencies are nearly the same people. Default to business_operations.board-governance and route here only on an evidenced membership constituency.

Recognising an unlabelled roll: an exported table with generic column names, a scanned sign-in sheet, a handwritten book photographed page by page, or a roll flattened into a PDF with the class column lost in layout.

Distinguishing an operative roll from a downloaded exemplar - a model constitution, another society's published member list, a governing body's specimen affiliation form, a template AGM notice. Topic will not separate them; "purpose answers what the file was for" is the only test that works.

Judging whether a member list is the association's own register or a purchased, scraped, inherited or shared mailing list, which changes the routing and the protection owed - inherited from the schema and applying with full force to this row's central artefact.
Abstaining whenever standing cannot be evidenced: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.", and for this row that abstention is common and correct.

Deciding CUSTODY, which is this row's whole question and is frequently unrecoverable from the bytes: institution-side register, subject-side certificate, depositing archive's accession copy, or a genealogist's downloaded image. The nonprofit schema's side problem appears here in its sharpest form because a register page is byte-identical in all four hands.

Separating this row from the institution's SELF-RUNNING record. The default answer is business_operations. A council, vestry, board or committee running a governance cycle in a religious body is business_operations.board-governance however religious its vocabulary; this row may only take a file that carries register or rite structure.
Recognising an unlabelled or handwritten historical register in prose or in a non-Latin script, where the rite label and the officiant slot are conventional rather than printed.

Distinguishing an operative institutional record from devotional, study or published material - a sermon, a lectionary, a hymn book, a denominational handbook, another body's annual report. Topic will not separate them: purpose is the only test that works, and most of this row's tempting false files are reading material.

Interpreting rite vocabulary across traditions and languages, where the deterministic labels above are English-and-Christian-shaped and the same structure exists under entirely different words. Abstention is required rather than a guess.
Deciding whether a pastoral note has crossed into clinical or safeguarding territory, and routing to the stricter side rather than adjudicating.
Abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite the register structure: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

Deciding the HOLDER SIDE of a grievance, disciplinary or collective-agreement packet that names both the association and the employer - union case file versus employer personnel file versus instructed legal matter. Interpretation may use only a bounded local dossier and must abstain when the side is unresolved, on 00's own rule that “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
Separating a statutory industrial-action ballot from an ordinary members' meeting ballot when the employer-addressee block is missing or the question text is ambiguous.
Separating check-off remittance schedules from the association's own staff payroll and from a member's personal bank statement showing a union subscription.
Recognising an unlabelled casework narrative, bargaining update, or workplace bulletin whose function is expressed only in prose and whose vocabulary overlaps campaign or HR material.

Distinguishing operative union records from a downloaded exemplar - a model recognition agreement, a published national CBA of a different sector, a regulator's guidance on balloting. Topic will not separate them: “purpose answers what the file was for” is the only test that works.
Abstaining whenever the evidence cannot cite an employer counterparty: a plain branch roll, a union constitution, or a conference programme is not this row.

readings: an opaque image whose only usable evidence is OCR text, where the question is what the capture is OF — 00: it "may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure"
naming an event a user would recognise when metadata gives only a device, a date span and a coordinate cluster
deciding whether a photographed page is a document capture whose facts belong to another active schema rather than to a photo event
reading a non-Latin or handwritten capture where OCR text needs interpretation before any field can be filled

naming the occasion a user would recognise when the metadata gives only a device, a date span and a coordinate cluster — 00 bounds the model to exactly this: only after coherence is supported, "it proposes a concise human-readable display label and a group category"
deciding whether one continuous run is one occasion or two — a day out inside a longer trip — where camera identity and time never break
deciding whether a camera photograph whose subject is a document belongs to this situation at all, or whether its facts belong to another active schema once OCR has run
confirming a place from an OCR'd sign, menu or landmark when no GPS fix exists, where the reading is language interpretation rather than a lookup

naming the flight a person would recognise when telemetry gives only a platform, a time span and a path — 00 bounds the model to exactly this and only once coherence is supported: "it proposes a concise human-readable display label and a group category"
deciding whether one afternoon's media is one sortie or several — batteries flown over the same site are contiguous in place and broken in time, and the break is not self-interpreting
deciding whether the material is a client deliverable rather than a personal capture, where the evidence is language in an adjacent brief, quote or report rather than anything in a metadata slot

deciding whether an aerial frame whose subject is a survey plot, a structure or a crop block also carries a research reading, which is a judgement about what the frame is OF and not about how it was made
reading a log or sidecar whose column labels are non-Latin or vendor-idiosyncratic, where interpretation precedes any field being filled
deciding whether a scan is a photograph of people and places (this situation) or a photographed document that belongs to another active schema, when OCR returns only handwriting
naming an event a family would recognise from a caption that gives a place and a first name but no occasion word — the value must still be one the user accepts
reading handwritten or non-Latin verso text before any date, place or person candidate exists at all
judging whether a decade-level date in a caption describes the depicted scene or the moment the caption was written
deciding whether a batch of undated scans is one occasion or several, when the only shared evidence is the scanning session

deciding whether a recording is something the holder made or something they consumed, when the embedded tags are absent or generic. This is the interpretive question this situation turns on, and the deterministic signals cannot answer it: a downloaded film and a forty-minute home movie present the same container, codec and duration. 00 bounds the call to exactly this kind of file — "an LLM receives only compact evidence packets for files or groups that remain ambiguous, have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation"

naming an occasion a user would recognise from a caption track, an accepted transcript, or a set of tags, when the metadata gives only a device and a date — 00 permits the label only after coherence is supported: "it proposes a concise human-readable display label and a group category"
deciding whether a recording of a lecture, an appointment or a meeting carries another active schema's facts as well as this situation's capture facts, and which fields belong to which reading
interpreting a caption or authorized transcript in a language or register where the text needs reading before any field can be filled

deciding whether a transcript is private correspondence or a thread whose facts belong to another active schema — a support thread with an order number, a landlord thread with a lease attached, a recruiter thread with an offer. 00's own eligibility for the call: files that "have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation", and the reading here is language interpretation, not a lookup

judging whether an image that arrived through a messenger is a photograph someone took, a screenshot they forwarded, or a photographed document — the metadata that would decide it is gone, so what is left is the content, which is 00's stated screenshot discipline applied to a stripped file: "A screenshot is always a screenshot of something"

proposing a label for a bundle a user would recognise, while abstaining where the only available label is a person's name — the model may propose "a concise human-readable display label" only once coherence is supported, and a person-shaped label is a suggestion for the user, never a fact
reading a non-Latin or code-switched transcript, where the language must be interpreted before any field can be filled

deciding what the captured document IS once OCR text exists, which is the whole point of running OCR here — 00 states the principle for the neighbouring case and it holds identically for a photographed page: "A screenshot is always a screenshot of something", and "OCR should therefore run when a file yields no usable text and no usable metadata, including scanned PDFs, confirmed screenshots, and opaque images without EXIF." The model's job is to say which roster schema the recovered text makes plausible, citing the OCR region; it is not to name a folder
a photographed page in a non-Latin script or in handwriting, where the OCR output needs interpretation before any field on any schema can be filled

separating a photographed page from a photographed whiteboard, notebook spread or poster, where the frame is dense text but is not a document — the deciding evidence is content, not density, and conflicting signals abstain

judging whether a set of scans is one purpose packet rather than a scanning run that happened in one sitting — 00's own case is a bundle of scans: "A ZIP file named submission.zip may contain a transcript, personal statement, resume, certificate, and form, which is meaningful evidence of a purpose-defined application packet even when the outer archive name is vague."

deciding what the capture is OF, once OCR text exists — 00 lists the possibilities and refuses to let the image alone answer: a file "may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure"

reading a non-Latin or low-quality capture whose OCR needs interpretation before any field can be filled — one of 00's own adversarial cases, "screenshots with unreadable OCR"
concluding that nothing connects the capture to anything, which must remain an available answer — 00: "The model must be allowed to conclude that no meaningful association exists."

deciding whether an unfamiliar bundle is a platform export at all, when the manifest layout resembles a known export shape without matching one — 00's own eligibility is files that "remain ambiguous, have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation"

readings: PRECONDITION, and it is stricter here than in business_operations: this family's ORDINARY DAILY OUTPUT is third-party personal data about members of the public, so a model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.” A booking sheet, a guest complaint and a returns log are not edge cases in this world; they are the world.

Separating the OPERATOR'S side from the CUSTOMER'S side, which is this schema's central determination and the one that decides whether it activates at all. A booking confirmation, a restaurant receipt, an order dispatch note and an event ticket each exist twice - once as the operator's record (here) and once as the buyer's (finance, travel, or the Receipts and Confirmations residual). Filenames are identical and both are PDFs. The operator's copy carries a POPULATION or a CYCLE: many bookings, a whole trading day, an order plus its goods-in; the customer's copy carries exactly one transaction and no operational apparatus. Where evidence does not settle which side the holder is on, this schema must not activate.

Separating a REAL trading record from a TEMPLATE, a supplier's sample, a franchise operations manual, a training exercise, or a downloaded compliance pack. A blank temperature log and a completed one are the same sheet with the readings removed, and a wholesaler's specimen price list is written to look exactly like a live one. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

A purpose-coherent trading packet whose members are individually unremarkable - a function file carrying a signed proposal, a floor plan image, a run sheet, an allergen grid, a bar stock sheet and a final invoice. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

Unlabelled operational prose: a shift handover note, an incident write-up, a complaint reply, a supplier chaser. These have no header block, no grid, no reference, and are frequently the most sensitive files in the corpus.

Reading a SCANNED OR PHOTOGRAPHED paper sheet, which this family produces more of than any other in the roster - clipboard temperature logs, signed delivery notes, handwritten count sheets, till rolls. Handwriting is often the whole content, and OCR confidence on it is low.
A document in a language whose trading, licensing, food-safety and hospitality vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output names members of the public, their contact details, dietary needs and sometimes payment-guarantee tokens. A model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

WHOSE SIDE IS THIS — the row's central determination and the one inherited most sharply from the schema. A booking confirmation, a hotel voucher and a restaurant reservation each exist twice: once as the operator's record (here) and once as the guest's (travel.bookings-confirmations on finance, or the Receipts and Confirmations residual). Filenames are often identical and both are PDFs. The operator's copy carries a POPULATION, a STATUS apparatus, a REQUIREMENTS block managed by the house, or a recurring reference inside an operator export; the guest's copy carries exactly one transaction addressed to the holder as diner or traveller. Where evidence does not settle which side the holder is on, this row must not activate.

Separating a LIVE reservation record from a TEMPLATE, a PMS vendor's sample export, a training diary, a franchise specimen confirmation, or a blank booking form. A blank covers sheet and a completed one are the same grid with the names removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

A purpose-coherent booking packet whose members are individually unremarkable: the confirmation PDF, a deposit receipt, a dietary email, a table-plan image and a cancellation note sharing one reference. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

Unlabelled operational prose — a host's handwritten note that table 12 is holding for eight, a WhatsApp screenshot about a late party, a shift handover listing expected covers. These often lack a header block and are among the most sensitive files because they name guests and staff together.
Reading handwriting on a photographed reservation book, where OCR confidence is low and the guest contact column is frequently the most legible thing on the page.
A reservation record in a language whose hospitality, covers, room-night and cancellation vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.

Whether a dated function confirmation is this row's reservation of the date or retail_hospitality.event-production's production of the day — settled by whether the artefact is capacity-and-status apparatus or minute-keyed delivery apparatus; abstain when both are absent. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it.

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output names private individuals and carries health-adjacent dietary data. A model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

SEPARATING THE OPERATOR-SELLER FROM THE CLIENT-BUYER, which is this row's central determination and the schema family's operator-side rule applied to engagements. The caterer's signed proposal, contract, BEO, allergen sheet and final account are this row. The couple's own downloaded quote, the corporate client's copy of the same PDF, and a diner's restaurant receipt are the buyer's side and never activate this world. Filenames are often identical. Where evidence does not settle which side the holder is on, this row must not activate.

Separating a REAL engagement from a TEMPLATE, a specimen banquet pack, a blank BEO, or a downloaded catering-contract pro forma. A blank function sheet and a completed one are the same grid with the prices and names removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

The purpose-coherent catering packet whose members share almost no content — a signed proposal, a floor-plan image the client approved, a function sheet, an allergen sheet, a deposit receipt and a final invoice. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.” This is the row's normal grouping case.
Unlabelled commercial prose: a chaser about the deposit, a menu-change confirmation, a tasting note, a postponement paragraph. No header block, no grid, no reference.

Reading a PHOTOGRAPHED or SCANNED signed contract or annotated BEO — the pen annotation or wet signature is frequently the only thing that makes the file the executed instrument rather than the draft.
A document in a language whose banqueting, allergen and catering-contract vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.
In every case, abstention is required when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION and it binds harder here than anywhere else in this family: an order export is a consumer address database by construction. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

THE SIDE DETERMINATION, which is this row's central call and the one that decides activation. `orders.csv` exists twice - the merchant's export of many buyers from one store, and a buyer's own order-history download covering many stores. Filenames and extensions are identical. The operator's copy carries a POPULATION of distinct recipients plus fulfilment/payout apparatus; the buyer's carries ONE recipient and none. Where evidence does not settle the side, this row must not activate.

Separating a LIVE channel record from a TEMPLATE, a supplier's specimen feed, a scraped competitor catalogue, a store-building course exercise, or a demo-store seed file. A seeded demo export is byte-shaped exactly like a real one. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Deciding whether a bundle is a STOREFRONT CONFIGURATION or a SOFTWARE PROJECT. A theme export with Liquid templates, a package manifest and a version-control marker is `code.software-project`; a settings export with shipping zones and tax overrides is this row.

Reading an unlabelled operational message: a supplier chase about a stockout, a marketplace policy-violation notice, a customer service thread about a lost parcel. No header block, no grid, and frequently the most sensitive files present.
A channel export in a language, currency or marketplace taxonomy the deterministic header catalogue does not cover.
Abstention is the required outcome in every case above. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output includes named guests, delegates, crew mobile numbers and, in the on-the-day log, injuries to members of the public. A model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

SEPARATING THE HOST FROM THE PRODUCER, which is this row's central determination and the answer this pass owes to NJ-RH-2. A venue delivering a function on its own premises, a shop running a launch night, a festival's own organising body and a company running its own conference are HOSTS and are this row. An agency, a production company or a freelance planner engaged BY a client to deliver that same event is an instructed commission whose anchor is the engagement, not the occasion, and whose paperwork carries a client-facing apparatus - a signed proposal naming a counterparty, a fee schedule, change orders, approval rounds, an invoice against milestones. Identical run sheets exist on both sides. Where the evidence does not settle which side the holder is on, this row must not activate.

Separating a REAL delivery record from a TEMPLATE, a venue's specimen pack sent to a prospective client, a supplier's sample running order, or a downloaded event-management-plan pro forma. A blank run sheet and a completed one are the same grid with the actions removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

The purpose-coherent event packet whose members are individually unremarkable and share no content at all - a brief, a floor plan image, a supplier call sheet, a run sheet, a photographed whiteboard, an invoice and a debrief note. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.” This is the row's normal grouping case and no content-similarity method will find it.

Unlabelled operational prose: a debrief note, a complaint about the band, a chaser to a supplier who did not arrive, a handover paragraph between two duty managers. No header block, no grid, no reference.

Reading a PHOTOGRAPHED or SCANNED sheet, which this row produces heavily - a whiteboard of call times, an annotated run sheet marked up during the day, a printed floor plan with pen changes. The pen annotation is frequently the only thing that makes the file the operating record rather than the plan.
A document in a language whose event, production, licensing and hospitality vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.
In every case, abstention is required when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

Deciding whether a daily-signed checklist is FOOD-CONTROL or GENERAL SITE OPENING/CLOSING. Both are recurring signed grids. The discriminator is whether the rows name food-control objects and tolerances (fridge, freezer, probe, hot-hold, food-contact surface, allergen, use-by) or general premises and trading readiness (lights, till float, door locks, standards photo). Filenames cannot settle this; “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Deciding whether a delivery sheet is a FOOD-SAFETY ACCEPTANCE CHECK or a SUPPLIER-ORDER GOODS-IN NOTE. Both arrive with a supplier logo and a date. Temperature-on-arrival plus accept/reject decides for this row; ordered-versus-received quantity columns plus an order reference decide for supplier-order. Where both structures sit on one sheet, both situations are present on disjoint columns and neither should erase the other.

Deciding whether a cold-chain or fridge log protects FOOD or MEDICINES. Drug names, a controlled schedule, a dispensary or CD cabinet identity, or witnessed destruction support `clinical_practice.pharmacy-operations`; food-business, kitchen, allergen, use-by-for-sale, or catering language supports this row. Temperature readings and batch-and-expiry columns alone discriminate neither.

Reading a photograph or scan of a completed handwritten temperature or cleaning sheet. OCR over biro readings and initials is unreliable per cell, but the RULED GRID plus target column plus initials column is legible as structure even where the numbers are not, and structure is what activates.

Reading whether an illness or allergen complaint is a FOOD-SAFETY INCIDENT (corrective action, product withdrawn, authority notification) or GUEST-FEEDBACK (rating, response, goodwill). The same guest names appear in both; surrounding structure decides.

Reading an archive manifest to decide whether a zip is one site's food-safety pack (temp logs, cleaning, delivery checks, traceability, incidents) or an unrelated compliance bundle - without unpacking it. “Compressed archives should yield their manifests without extraction, while disk images, executables, databases, encrypted containers, damaged files, and unknown binary formats should default to safe metadata-only indexing unless a dedicated extractor has been explicitly approved.”
In every case above, abstention is required when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output is unstructured natural-language grievance and praise written by members of the public, frequently naming staff. A model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

WHOSE VOICE IS THIS - the row's central determination, and the one on which it should abstain most often. Four authors produce near-identical bytes: a GUEST evaluating the holder's site (this row), an INSTRUCTED ASSESSOR scoring the holder's site against a rubric (a standards audit), the HOLDER evaluating somebody else's site (not this schema at all, and not the operator's side), and a THIRD PARTY evaluating a COMPETITOR (market intelligence). Where the evidence does not settle authorship and subject together, this row must not activate.

WHOSE SIDE IS THIS, inherited from the schema and sharpened here. A review is published, so a copy of one can be held by anybody. The operator's copy carries a POPULATION or a RESPONSE APPARATUS - many reviews, a reply column, a case reference, an internal category. A single downloaded or screenshotted review carries neither.

Separating a LIVE feedback record from a TEMPLATE, a platform's own sample export, a training exercise, a supplier's demo of a reputation tool, or a blank comment card. A blank survey and a completed one are the same instrument with the answers removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

A purpose-coherent complaint packet whose members are individually unremarkable: the inbound letter, a photograph the guest attached, a screenshot of the booking, an internal note, a scan of the voucher issued and a closing reply. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

Unlabelled operational prose - a drafted reply that quotes a review without citing it, a duty manager's account of an incident, a shift note recording that a table complained. These have no header block, no grid and no reference, and they are frequently the most sensitive files in the corpus because they narrate an allegation against a named colleague.

Recognising that a complaint has become an EMPLOYEE RELATIONS matter. The guest's letter is this row's; a witness statement, an investigation meeting invitation and an outcome letter about a named employee are not, however tightly they sit in the same folder.
Reading handwriting on a photographed comment card, where OCR confidence is low and the guest's contact details are frequently the most legible thing on it.

A review in a language whose praise, grievance, redress and hospitality vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover - a materially larger share here than elsewhere in the family, because international guests review in their own language.
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”
PRECONDITION: this row's privacy rule differs from its schema's and a model step runs under the user's policy and after P7 for the COST SIDE, not for a data subject. See `sensitivity_why`.

Separating a COST MODEL from a PRICED SELLING FACE, which is this row's central determination against `retail_hospitality.product-catalogue`. Both artefacts name the same dishes, carry money, and frequently sit in one folder. The determination is structural - does one item decompose into components with unit costs - and where a document merely lists dishes and prices, this row must not activate.

Separating a TRADING recipe from a DOMESTIC, EDITORIAL or TRAINING one. A recipe card, a cookbook page, a food blogger's draft, a culinary-school exercise and a kitchen's live specification are the same shape with the commercial side removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.” Cooking is the topic in all five; only one has a menu selling price as its purpose.

Separating a REAL costing from a TEMPLATE, a wholesaler's specimen or a franchise manual extract. A blank costing workbook has every header, every formula and no values, and a supplier's sample GP calculator is written to look exactly like a live one.

Reading a PHOTOGRAPHED OR SCANNED specification - a handwritten recipe card, a laminated kitchen sheet, a printed menu proof marked up in pen. Quantities and prices are frequently handwritten and OCR confidence on them is low, and a misread unit turns a cost model into nonsense.

A document in a language whose culinary, allergen and margin vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover; allergen terminology in particular is statutory and locale-specific and this row writes no gazetteer (R4 owns that).

Deciding whether a menu-engineering workbook is this row's cost model or `pos-reporting`'s trading-period read, where the workbook carries both. Abstention is the required outcome: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's needs_llm path runs after P7 like every row in the family, but for a DIFFERENT reason than its siblings. The material at risk here is not guest data; it is staff-facing allegation-adjacent data. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

Separating the OPERATOR'S close from the CUSTOMER'S receipt, which for this row is harder than for any other in the family because the two artefacts are printed by the same machine in the same font on the same paper. The operator's copy carries a POPULATION or a CLOSE - many transactions, a sequence number, a float, an over/short; the customer's copy carries exactly one transaction, a thank-you line and no reconciliation apparatus. Where the evidence does not settle which side the holder is on, this row must not activate.

Separating a REAL close from an EPOS VENDOR'S SPECIMEN, a training-mode session, a franchise operations manual's worked example, or a screenshot in a software project's documentation. A specimen Z-report is written to look exactly like a live one, and a training-mode close is a live one that means nothing. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Deciding whether a period trading pack is this row's session evidence or `business_operations.budget-forecast`'s variance exercise, where the pack carries both a takings summary and a budget column - and, separately, whether a menu-engineering workbook is this row's dated read or `retail_hospitality.menu-recipe-costing`'s cost model. Both are recorded as open questions rather than assumed.

Reading a faded thermal till roll or a handwritten declared-cash figure on a photographed cash-up sheet. OCR confidence on both is low, and on a cash sheet the handwritten figure is frequently the ONLY figure that distinguishes a reconciled close from an unreconciled one.

Unlabelled operational prose that belongs to a close: a shift handover note explaining a shortage, a manager's write-up of a voided transaction, an email chasing a missing banking bag. These have no grid, no sequence number and no header block, and they are the most sensitive files this row touches.
A close printed in a language whose till, tender, float and cash-declaration vocabulary the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when the evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary pack mixes STATUTORILY DISPLAYABLE instruments with PROTECTED application and review material about named individuals. A model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

WHOSE CUSTODY IS THIS — the row's central determination, shared with government.permit-licensing. Identical bytes of a premises-licence certificate, conditions schedule or inspection report exist on the authority's side and on the operator's side. The operator's pack sits beside the operator's own application drafts, fee receipts, responsible-person consents and display copies; the authority's case sits beside representations, officer reports, register maintenance and determination minutes. Where custody does not settle, this row must not activate. “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”

Separating a CONTINUING PREMISES PERMISSION from a PERSONAL CREDENTIAL, a software or content licence, a lease alienation consent, a hot-works permit to work, or a Companies House filing that happens to name the same trading style.

Separating a LIVE permission file from a BLANK application form, a solicitor's specimen pack, a franchise operations-manual specimen, a training exercise, or a downloaded guidance PDF. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

A purpose-coherent licence pack whose members are individually unremarkable: the application PDF, a scanned DPS consent, a newspaper notice clipping, a fee receipt, a hearing agenda and the issued certificate. “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”

Deciding whether a food-hygiene inspection report in the same folder is this row's permission neighbourhood or retail_hospitality.food-safety's operative diary — the report alone is not decisive; see collides_with.
Reading a photographed wall certificate or a handwritten blue-notice photograph where OCR is weak and the most legible tokens are a trade name and an address.
A licensing instrument in a language whose premises, activity-hours and responsible-person vocabulary the deterministic catalogue does not cover.
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

PRECONDITION: a model step runs only under the user's policy and after P7, and for this row the material offered to it must be the COLUMN HEADERS AND A DESCRIPTION SAMPLE, not the cost, margin or supplier columns. See `sensitivity_why`.

Deciding DIRECTION on a price list - whose selling face is this. `Trade price list 2026 - Bidfood.pdf` and `Price list - trade + RRP - effective 2026-04-01.pdf` are the same document shape, the same extension, and often the same folder. The determination is whether the holder is the issuer pricing its OWN lines outward, or the recipient of a third party's prices inward, and it is read from the letterhead, the account-number slot, the presence or absence of an RRP or margin column, and the pack-size and delivery-day apparatus that only an inbound trade list carries.

Separating a PRICED SELLING FACE from a COST MODEL, this row's reciprocal of the determination `retail_hospitality.menu-recipe-costing` was required to answer. Both name the same items, both carry money, both frequently sit in one folder. The structural test is THE COMPONENT EXPLOSION: does one named item decompose into many costed components with a yield in the same document. Where it does not, and the record is one row per item with a price, this row holds it.

Separating a LIVE range or price record from a SPECIMEN, a template, a wholesaler's sample, a franchise manual extract or a competitor's catalogue. A blank range-plan workbook has every header, every formula and no values; a supplier's sample price list is written to look exactly like a live one. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Separating a RETAIL PRODUCT SPECIFICATION from a SOFTWARE PRODUCT REQUIREMENT. `Product spec v3.docx` exists in both worlds and the id-name similarity to `business_operations.product-requirements` is a real trap. The test is whether the subject is a physical or menu line with a code, a price and a pack, or a feature set with user stories, acceptance criteria and a release.

Reading a PHOTOGRAPHED OR SCANNED selling face - a shelf ticket, a chalkboard menu, a printed price card captured on a phone - where OCR of prices and item names is the whole content and confidence is low.
Recognising the range or season token itself, which is operator-specific vernacular (`AW26`, `Spring 26`, `Core`, `Wave 2`, `Cycle 4`) and cannot be listed in advance.

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output joins a NAMED MEMBER OF THE PUBLIC to a PAYMENT INSTRUMENT and to a DISPUTE, so a model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

Separating the OPERATOR'S side from the CUSTOMER'S side, inherited from the parent schema and sharper here than anywhere else in the family, because the returns world is the one place where the two copies are near-identical documents that BOTH carry an RMA reference. The operator's copy carries an ADJUDICATION - a decision, an approver, a condition assessment, a stock consequence; the buyer's copy carries an INSTRUCTION to the buyer and no decision at all. Where the evidence does not settle the side, this row must not activate.

Separating a return CASE from the returns POLICY it cites. A policy document is written in the second person, states windows and exclusions in general terms, and names no unit, no customer and no decision. It is governance material, and “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Separating an ADJUDICATED refund from a GOODWILL GESTURE. Both move money to a customer; only the first rests on an asserted entitlement and produces a stock consequence. A goodwill credit issued to settle a complaint with no goods coming back is `retail_hospitality.guest-feedback`'s.

Unlabelled prose: a customer writing that they have posted an item back, a supervisor's note authorising a till refund, a chaser to a manufacturer about an unanswered claim. No header block, no grid, no reference - and frequently the most sensitive files in the set.

Reading a SCANNED OR PHOTOGRAPHED returns book, a signed refund docket, a till refund slip, or a customer's photograph of a fault. Handwriting is often the whole content and OCR confidence on it is low; a photograph of a broken item is not by itself a claim record.
A returns, warranty or consumer-rights vocabulary in a language the deterministic structure catalogue does not cover.
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

Deciding whether a two-quantity table is COUNTED-versus-BELIEVED or ORDERED-versus-RECEIVED. Both are quantity variances over item rows and both are common in this family. The discriminator is scope and counterparty, and it is readable but not regular: a receipt variance is bounded by ONE consignment from ONE named supplier against ONE order reference; a count variance is bounded by a POPULATION at a LOCATION on a DATE and names no counterparty at all. A model reading the header block decides this; a filename cannot.

Deciding whether a book-only export (item, description, on-hand quantity, cost, price, no count column) is the RECORDED BELIEF half of a count - and therefore this row's - or simply a product and price file, which is `retail_hospitality.product-catalogue`'s. The evidence that promotes it is an as-at timestamp matching a count date and the presence of a count sheet or variance record for the same population; absent that, it is not promoted.

Reading a photograph or scan of a completed handwritten count sheet. OCR over tally marks, crossings-out and handwritten quantities is unreliable per cell, but the RULED-COLUMN LAYOUT plus an initial slot plus a dated header is legible as structure even where the numbers are not, and structure is what activates.

Reading an archive manifest to decide whether a zip is one count's pack (sheets per zone, variance report, valuation, signed approval) or an unrelated stock-word bundle - without unpacking it. “Compressed archives should yield their manifests without extraction, while disk images, executables, databases, encrypted containers, damaged files, and unknown binary formats should default to safe metadata-only indexing unless a dedicated extractor has been explicitly approved.”

Deciding whether a variance record's named individuals are ordinary process signatures or a loss allegation against a named member of staff. The words rarely differ; the surrounding structure does, and this decision drives the residual routing rather than any fact.

PRECONDITION: this row's ordinary output names STAFF on labour plans and often carries till-exception suspicion and guest-affecting incident prose, so a model step runs under the user's policy and after P7. “Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default, should not display raw content in general group summaries, and should not be moved automatically without a user policy that explicitly permits it.”

Deciding whether a bare rota is this row's labour-against-forecast plan or `hr`'s workforce schedule. The SPLH / labour-percentage / forecast-covers column decides for this row; contracted hours, absence codes or pay rates decide for hr. Where neither is present, abstain - this is NJ-SO-1 / the parent's NJ-RH-1, not a quiet win.

Separating a TRADING-FLOOR open/close checklist from a FOOD-SAFETY daily diary and from a FACILITIES statutory calendar when the same scanned clipboard sheet mixes rows. Vocabulary of the check decides; mixed sheets are review candidates, not automatic activations.

Separating a BRAND standards visit from a REGULATORY compliance assessment when both score a store. Presence of a PBC request list, a control-framework citation or a findings-and-corrective-action register decides for `business_operations.compliance-audit`; a mystery-shopper or regional brand scorecard without those decides for this row.

Separating a REAL operating record from a FRANCHISE OPERATIONS MANUAL, a training blank, a specimen checklist or a downloaded compliance pack. A blank opening-check sheet and a completed one are the same form with the ticks removed. “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”

Unlabelled operational prose: a duty manager's handover scribble, an incident write-up naming a guest and a staff member, a chaser about a failed fridge during dinner service. No header block, and frequently the most sensitive files in the set.

Reading a SCANNED OR PHOTOGRAPHED paper checklist or rota. Handwriting is often the whole content; OCR confidence on initials and ticks is low. “A screenshot is always a screenshot of something—a receipt, application portal, conversation, code problem, document, calendar, or research figure—and without OCR the product sees only an image with a weak filename.”
In every case above, abstention is the required outcome when evidence does not settle it. “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.”

Deciding whether an unlabelled prose or handwritten sheet is a goods-in record at all. A phone photo of a paper note with a supplier logo, a date, a list of items and a signature has no header labels; only reading it decides whether it is a delivery note, a caterer's job sheet, a stock requisition or a parts list for a repair.

Deciding INBOUND versus OUTBOUND when both parties are businesses. A confirmation between two trading companies is this row when the holder is buying and is `business_operations.customer-account-management` or the e-commerce row when the holder is selling. The slot the holder occupies is often only recoverable from the letterhead and the address block, not from the filename.

Deciding whether an order-shaped document is REPEAT REPLENISHMENT against an agreed catalogue or the closing document of a COMPETITIVE SOURCING EVENT. The bytes converge; the surrounding evidence (an evaluation matrix, scored bidders, a stated award criterion) does not appear in replenishment and is what `business_operations.procurement-sourcing` needs.

Deciding whether a delivery note whose lines are all medicines carries medicine-specific custody or regulated-supply accountability, which would move it to `clinical_practice.pharmacy-operations`. Drug names alone do not.

Reading whether a shortage annotation is scoped to ONE consignment (this row) or whether the sheet is a population count at a location on a date (`retail_hospitality.stocktake`). Both are counted-against-expected tables and the count vocabulary is identical.

allocation or distribution sheet - the non-food variant, quantities pushed to receiving units against a drop
amendment notice for an existing reservation
authority inspection or rating outcome retained in the permission neighbourhood
banqueting event order / function sheet - commercial face: priced courses, per-head charge, client block
booking record - reservation, confirmation, deposit, requirements and dietary note, cancellation or no-show record
brand standards or mystery-shopper visit scorecard - scored selling-space walk
cash reconciliation - cash-up sheet, float and pickup record, declared-against-expected count, banking or paying-in record
catering engagement record - proposal, function contract, function sheet, allergen sheet, final account

channel account record - marketplace seller account status, policy notice, listing suppression, account health report
channel listing record - product and variant export, listing state change, marketplace category mapping, product feed, listing copy and seo slot
channel or ota reservation download held by the operator
channel performance record - sessions and conversion export, campaign spend against store revenue, cart-abandonment report
cleaning schedule - food-contact surfaces and equipment, signed per period
closing checklist - trading-floor close acts with initials, keyed to site and date
cost build-up - component unit costs, wastage factor, cost per portion
count instruction or count plan - the pre-count notice: population in scope, cut-off time, freeze rules, team allocation

count sheet - the ruled instrument, blank or completed, per count location, per page
credit note or claim - the document that settles the difference the goods-in note recorded
crew call and staffing allocation for the occasion
customer and subscriber list record - marketing list export, segment export, consent state
delivery acceptance check - temperature-on-arrival, accept/reject, seal or vehicle check
delivery or goods-received note - the ordered-against-received reconciliation, signed, often photographed
deposit or guarantee request tied to a booking reference
deposit receipt and payment schedule notice against the engagement
direct complaint record - inbound grievance, acknowledgement, internal account of events, final response, closure
dish or drink specification - components, quantities, method, yield, plate-up reference
e-commerce operating record - channel listing export, order export, fulfilment and dispatch record, platform settings
event brief - the occasion, the date, the expected numbers, the budget envelope, the intended shape of the day
event delivery record - brief, plan, supplier schedule, run sheet, on-the-day log, post-event reconciliation
event management plan and event risk assessment, including any temporary-occupation safety annexes
event plan and site plan - the layout, the staging and bar positions, the seating or table allocation, the egress
exception record - void, no-sale, refund, discount, price-override and manager-authorisation listing attributed to an operator
exchange or replacement record - the outbound unit issued against the returned one
final account / engagement invoice - agreed charges, extras, balance against the same occasion
food safety record - temperature and probe log, cleaning schedule, delivery check, traceability and batch record, incident and corrective-action note
fulfilment record - packing slip and pick-ticket batch, shipping label run, tracking export, backorder and preorder list
full conditions annex or operating schedule
function or catering contract - signed commercial terms, deposit, cancellation, guaranteed numbers
grant, certificate or summary for display
guest voice record - platform review export, direct complaint, survey result, operator response
hearing agenda, representations pack or review papers held by the operator
hotel or venue pms reservation export
inbound receipt and condition assessment - goods-back check, resaleable or not, missing accessories, quarantine
incident or corrective-action note - failed check, contamination, withdrawal, guest illness allegation
item or product master record - the standing identity of each selling line
labour plan against forecast trade - rota with covers or sales forecast, splh or labour-percentage column
licensing fee demand, payment receipt or acknowledgement
margin calculation - selling price against portion cost, food-cost percentage, gp percentage, price-rise modelling
menu and costing record - recipe specification, ingredient cost build-up, gross-profit calculation, allergen matrix, printed menu
menu change, pre-order or tasting confirmation tied to the engagement reference
menu composition record - the course structure and item selection a season's menu was built from
menu engineering review - dish cost and margin set against popularity, with a rank or quadrant per item
occasion-keyed guest dietary and allergen sheet - named individuals for one function
on-the-day log - timestamped entries kept while the occasion runs, including incidents
opening checklist - trading-floor open acts with initials, keyed to site and date
opening or closing food-control checks - the food-specific subset of a site's daily checks
order confirmation or acknowledgement - the supplier's reply, first place substitutions and out-of-stocks appear
order record - period order export, single order detail, discount and promotion application, cancellation
paper reservation-book scan or photographed covers sheet
payment dispute file - the acquirer or platform case, the scheme reason code, the representment evidence pack and the outcome
period roll-up of the above - a trading week or trading month assembled from its constituent closes
personal licence copy held only as a member of a premises pack

product photography and its brief - shot list, required angles, delivered assets named by item key
product specification - composition, dimensions, pack, care, origin and statutory marking for one line

public notice of application, blue notice photograph, newspaper notice

range exit or discontinuation list - the lines leaving, with their run-out and clearance treatment
range or assortment plan - the forward commitment of which lines will be sold in a season

redress record - goodwill gesture note, voucher or comp authorisation, redress ledger row

repair-under-warranty record - the merchant's own repair or the referral onward to a manufacturer

reservation book or covers diary export
return authorisation - the rma or ra record that opens a case, with reason and entitlement basis
return-to-vendor claim - the rtv consignment and the supplier or manufacturer credit sought against it
returns and claims record - return authorisation, refund decision, warranty claim, chargeback file
returns register or analysis - one row per case across a period, with reason and disposition columns
run sheet, running order or run of show - the minute-keyed timeline of the day with responsible parties, bracketed by load-in and strike
selling-face print artefact - shelf-edge labels, ticket runs, line sheets, lookbooks, printed catalogues and menus
session close - z-report, end-of-day read, session summary, x-read taken mid-session
shift handover note - trading-floor state passed between duty managers
shortage, rejection or substitution annotation - frequently the entire payload of a photographed note
site operating record - rota against forecast trade, opening and closing checks, standards audit, reactive maintenance call, the compliance pack the site must hold
site-day or site-week pack - assembled cover and contents binding the day's operating records
solicited feedback record - post-stay or post-purchase survey instrument, results export, scale legend, comment card scan
standing order or par-level sheet - the recurring template a replenishment order is generated from
stock record - count sheet, variance report, wastage log, allocation, transfer
stock valuation - the closing figure at cost and at retail, produced by the count
storefront configuration record - shipping zones and rates, tax overrides, checkout and gateway settings, redirect map, app and integration settings
supplier call schedule - the trades booked to the occasion with arrival windows, contacts and access notes
supplier order export - the ordering system's periodic dump, one row per line per order
supplier ordering record - purchase order, order confirmation, delivery or goods-received note with shortages, credit note, trade price list
table or room reservation confirmation - operator copy
temperature or probe log - fridge, freezer, hot-hold or core-temperature diary with targets and initials
temporary event notice or occasional permission
testimonial and consent record - a quotation cleared for marketing use with the author's permission attached
traceability or batch record - batch/lot received, use-by, use-out or disposal
trade price list or catalogue keyed to a supplier account, with a validity period
trading cut - department or category sales mix, hourly trade profile, transaction count and average transaction value, covers and spend per head
trading period report - end-of-day or z read, tender and cash reconciliation, department sales mix, hourly trade
training attendance for a named food-hygiene procedure - only when filed as diary evidence of who was signed off to perform a check, never as an hr personnel file
variance report - counted against book, by line and usually by value, with the loss lines ranked
variation, minor variation or transfer application and determination copy
wastage, spoilage, breakage or shrinkage log - continuous between counts, reconciling into the next one
